title: Director of Software Engineering
description:
Director of Software Engineering

Engineering - Boston, MA - Full Time

Who We Are
We believe when it comes to fashion, it’s all about the details. Our personalization platform is strategically leveraged by 250 global retail sites, representing 17,000 brands and 175 million registered users. Since 2010, we have built the world’s largest data collective connecting consumers with apparel and footwear they will love and keep.
As our data collective continues to grow, so does our team! Let’s disrupt this $3 trillion industry together.
COVID-19
While this role is based out of our Boston HQ, due to the ongoing response to COVID-19 all our employees are working on a remote basis, with a return date TBD. Once our offices are reopened, we can remain flexible and work together on a schedule that best suits your needs at the time.
The Role
We are seeking a Director of Software Engineering to lead an engineering team that is building the world's most advanced retail personalization platform. This is a high-profile position that will have exposure across the entire business, influencing the design and implementation of process, technology and product features experienced by millions of consumers daily.
Key Responsibilities
  • Build and manage three squads that own recommendation technology, consumer experience, and infrastructure
  • Manage a team of 10 to 15
  • Grow and nurture the development of an outstanding team of engineers
  • Collaborate with Product, Science, and customer facing leaders to design and execute product roadmaps
  • Drive improvements in process, technology, and execution
  • Oversee the execution of multiple projects, aligning resources, timelines, and dependencies
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to align engineering execution with business results
  • Communicate constantly; ensure transparency, collaboration, and feedback both inside and external to your team
  • Contribute to architecture and design decisions. Lead efforts to build and maintain a highly scalable software platform
Desired Skills and Experience
  • 12+ years of experience building commercial software
  • Prior experience in a leadership role within engineering organizations
  • SaaS experience is a must; both enterprise and consumer experienced desired
  • Deep understanding of Agile strategies and methods, and evolving them for scale
  • Excellent time management and organizational skills. Attention to detail is critical for this role
  • Bachelor's Degree in computer science or equivalent experience as a software engineer
  • Strong listening and communications skills
  • Highly motivated self-starter and proactive problem solver with a can-do attitude that wants to learn and grow
Why Us?
Together we’ve built a tight-knit culture that’s reflected in our Glassdoor reviews; “Great people, cool product … refreshing place to work … everyone actually works together like a team, employees are all pro-active and genuinely take pride in their work… growth potential plus culture … management is approachable, mindful of their people … opportunity to learn/work on new technology … you are an integral part of the success of the company… the work you are doing everyday really matters and makes a difference… managers provide autonomy and trust you … really innovative company, open to share ideas to make a better product… great culture with the right vision

title: Principal UI Software Engineer
description:
As a Principal UI Engineer on the Marketplace team, you’ll create web, mobile, and desktop applications that integrate with a rich ecosystem of services to power our Marketplace platform.
Our Marketplace is changing how food is produced and sold—in the U.S. now, and soon around the world. Today, growers don’t have incentive to grow higher-quality crops. In fact, since grain is commoditized, growers’ main incentive is to simply grow as much volume as possible.
Our Marketplace flips the current model on its head by connecting growers directly with buyers and preserving crop identity. This means that growers get paid a premium for growing organic and similarly desirable crops.
Your expertise in interface design and software architecture will help us deliver a world-class front-end to our growing suite of world-class marketplace products.
As a Principal UI Engineer you’ll:
  • Design and implement user-facing applications. Today that means working in a React, Typescript, and GraphQL stack.
  • Lead projects end to end, from design to implementation to deployment to production support, communicating risks and issues to stakeholders, and working together to find a path forward.
  • Leverage your expertise to provide technical constraints and solutions to product managers, with a focus on incremental delivery.
  • Collaborate with product managers, back-end engineers, and data science engineers to spec, build, test and deploy high quality code in the cloud.
  • Promote applicable design patterns, refactoring code where necessary, to maintain organizational consistency.
  • Ensure that all APIs are adequately tested in an automated framework, including functional and performance tests.
  • Expertly review code, have your code reviewed, and mentor other engineers.
  • Design product and infrastructure solutions that favor fast, incremental delivery but are extensible and scalable enough to meet the demands of a rapidly growing business and user base.
About You
  • You have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • You’ve been building front-end web applications professionally for 5+ years.
  • You’re able to research, propose, and evangelize new technologies or software patterns to improve the software ecosystem.
  • You’re a strong communicator. You can convey technical concepts and trade-offs to both engineering and business audiences.
  • You have prior experience working in a fast-paced, agile environment.
  • You bring a positive attitude, a sense of humor, and self awareness.
  • You are a perpetual learner and passionate about technology.
  • You possess strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, programming languages, distributed systems, and data management.
Nice to Haves
  • You have deep experience in one or more imperative programming languages. We work primarily in TypeScript/JavaScripit, but alternate experience is acceptable.
  • You have experience working with a cloud provider such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • You have built production grade application using one or more of the following: Typescript, Node, GraphQL, Apollo, React
  • You have developed software that deals directly with transactional systems, trading systems, e-commerce platforms, or marketplaces.
About US
We are a company dedicated to harnessing nature to help farmers sustainably feed the planet. With a vision of creating a world where farming is an economically desirable and accessible profession, we work alongside growers to apply natural approaches, conserve resources for future generations, and grow healthy food for all. Utilizing beneficial plant microbes to improve crop health and productivity, our portfolio is focused on cotton, wheat, barley, corn, soybeans, and rice.

title: Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
Based in San Francisco, we are a SaaS technology company with a mission to unleash the power of the people-centric web. Our platform enables brands to enter the new world of Context-Driven Marketing and build meaningful relationships with those impacting their business and category.
We are funded by super angels and have already built a solid line of revenue. Over 150 paid customers have already signed up, including AARP, Adidas, Anheuser Busch, EMC, Fidelity, Nickelodeon, oDesk, Orange, SAP, and Zendesk.

Job Description

We are looking for a Lead DevOps Engineer to spearhead the management and scaling of our increasingly growing AWS infrastructure. You'll work hand-in-hand with the rest of the engineering and ops teams and you will be the one leading the way to automating everything from our continuous integration and deployment builds to EC2, machine procurement, clustering, monitoring, tuning and security. If you like the idea of being at the heart of scaling a new generation search engine company then drop us a line.

Qualifications

You should be interested in or have experience with several of the following
  • Configuring, maintaining and securing UNIX/Linux systems
  • AWS or similar IaaS cloud services
  • Scripting (shell, python, ruby) skills for monitoring and automation
  • Infrastructure automation (Ansible, Chef, Puppet, Juju, etc) and virtualization (Docker, Vagrant, VMWare, etc)
  • Continuous integration tools such as Jenkins, Hudson, etc
  • Monitoring and alerting tools such as Munin, New Relic, Monitis, Ganglia, etc
  • Scaling distributed data systems
  • Optimizing applications, both stand-alone and in distributed systems to maximize performance
  • Maintaining an infrastructure while adding new features to it
  • Clear articulation to your team of your design choices
Your professional aspirations
  • You want to work in a startup environment
  • You have a strong interest in scaling distributed data systems such as Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Hadoop, Cassandra or others
What makes you get up in the morning
  • You roll up your sleeves and dive head first into new challenges and technologies
  • You know how to leverage many languages such as Java, Scala, Ruby, JavaScript or Python and frameworks such as Akka or Node.js
  • You leverage OSS software but also contribute back to it
  • You like using technology to empower people

title: Backend Engineer (Python)
description:
We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join us working on a suite of products that powers content marketing for B2B companies ranging from small start-ups to multi-national companies on the Fortune 500 list.

At the moment our team is working on developing a data pipeline that ingests millions of web activities and uses attribution models to give deep insights to marketers about their performance. There is some serious engineering behind making all of that work and we want to find people that love tackling hard problems like this head on. We are a very strong team of developers that are focused on helping each other to improve as engineers every day. We write automated tests as part of our development workflow, practice pair programming, perform peer code reviews, and share knowledge in weekly tech talks.

We have an amazing office overlooking the Boston Common with a kitchen full of snacks and weekly catered lunches and top market salary, equity package, 401k plan, Medical with 100% deductible reimbursement, dental and vision insurance and gym membership reimbursement.

Our ideal candidate:
- Has 2-5 years of experience working with large-scale data-intensive applications, with a preference to python.
- Has experience with AWS technologies such as Kinesis, S3 and RDS.
- Feels that testing is a core part of their development process.
- Has experience or familiarity working in a functional programming style or language.
- Enjoys working closely with other developers, pair programming, reviewing code and sharing ideas.

One day you might be developing smarter scheduling algorithms for syncing data from external sources, the next you could be tuning our database to reduce bottlenecks and the next you could be reviewing and refactoring code that is responsible for generating reports that hundreds of marketers rely on. We love people that thrive on solving tough problems with clean, well-tested and scalable code

title: Sr. Software Engineer – QA / Test Automation Engineer
description:
OVERVIEW

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior QA / Test Automation Engineer to join a contractor program supporting a critical customer engagement: a state government professional licensing and regulatory compliance platform built on Google Cloud. This role is ideal for a senior QA engineer who owns the full test lifecycle, from test strategy and case design through automated regression, across web, API, and mobile surfaces. The successful candidate will work closely with the client technical lead, the development team, and customer stakeholders to ensure project success from initial definition through final delivery.

REQUIRED CREDENTIALS

• 5+ years of professional QA / test automation experience

• Experience testing cloud-hosted, service-based applications in production environments

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Web E2E test automation with Playwright or a comparable framework (Cypress, Selenium)

• API test automation for REST services (REST Assured, Karate, or Postman/Newman)

• Test strategy, test case design, and defect lifecycle management

• Manual and exploratory testing alongside automation

• SQL for test data setup and validation (PostgreSQL)

• Testing asynchronous, event-driven behavior (queues, webhooks, scheduled jobs)

• Integrating automated suites into CI/CD pipelines

USEFUL QUALIFICATIONS

• Mobile test automation for React Native (Detox, Maestro, or Appium)

• Performance and load testing (k6, JMeter, or Gatling)

• Accessibility testing (WCAG 2.1 AA)

• Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform services

• Experience in government or regulated environments

• Experience testing workflow- or rules-driven systems (BPMN engines, decision tables)

SCOPE AND SOLUTION EXPECTATIONS

Below covers the scope of work we anticipate the contractor supporting throughout the project timeline.

• Define and maintain the test strategy and test plans for the platform's web portals, backend services, and external integrations

• Build and maintain automated E2E suites for the public citizen portal and staff operations console

• Build and maintain automated API test coverage for the platform's microservices

• Validate dynamic intake forms and business rule outcomes through data-driven regression suites

• Test payment, notification, and document upload flows, including webhook and failure scenarios

• Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and report on coverage and release quality

• Support performance and load testing of high-traffic endpoints such as public license search

• Extend automation coverage to the React Native field inspection application

• Support UAT cycles, defect triage, and release readiness sign-off

title: Administration Assistant
description:
EML is a leading Workers Compensation and Personal Injury Claims Management business. Our goal is to help people get their lives back through ongoing support during their return-to-work journey. We continue to experience ongoing growth and now have over 4,000 dedicated employees. We foster a learning culture that allows for us to continually invest in our employees ensuring a long-term career here at EML.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As part of our diverse team based in Newcastle, you will help make a positive impact on someone’s life every day. You will feel great satisfaction knowing your talent and hard work has a purpose.

As an Administration Assistant, you will play a vital role in supporting our claims teams by keeping things running smoothly behind the scenes. From coordinating claim activities and booking medical appointments to organising travel, investigations and interpreter services, you’ll be the one making sure no detail is missed.

You’ll liaise with providers to gather reports and clinical notes, keep claim records up to date, and prepare accurate, professional documentation that supports our work every step of the way.


This will be a permanent, full time position based in either our Newcastle office, with work-from-home flexibility (up to 3 days per week) considered from month three, subject to performance and approval.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support claims teams by coordinating and progressing claim activities.

  • Arrange appointments, travel and accommodation for injured workers as needed.

  • Liaise with providers to obtain clinical notes, reports and other required information.

  • Organise medical investigations, police reports and interpreter services.

  • Maintain accurate claim records and prepare supporting documentation and correspondence.

ABOUT YOU

  • Strong computer literacy with the ability to quickly learn new systems and navigate multiple platforms.

  • Excellent attention to detail and time management, with a focus on meeting deadlines and staying organised.

  • Confident working both independently and as part of a collaborative, diverse team environment.

  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills, with a proactive approach to queries and follow-ups.

  • Solid data entry experience, with a focus on accuracy and maintaining confidential information would be highly regarded.


WHAT WE OFFER


We stand together as equals. EML is an equal opportunity employer so by coming to work for us, you will be part of a culture that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We are committed to maintaining a workplace where everyone feels valued and where we show respect, integrity and honesty.


EML provides career opportunities and great employee benefits, including:


  • A diverse and collaborative team culture like no other
  • Flexibility to work from home to support work/life balance
  • A corporate wellbeing program with discounted health insurance and gym membership
  • Generous discounts from over 350 retailers through our RewardsHub program
  • Comprehensive learning and development opportunities to help you reach your full potential
  • Access to support and counselling services with work or personal matters, through our Employee Assistance Program
  • Companywide events to stay connected and celebrate success
  • Entitlement to annual company incentive scheme + salary reviews
  • Up to 16 weeks paid parental leave, plus super


We value our people and are committed to supporting our employees by investing in their professional development and providing generous employee benefits. If this position is of interest to you, please apply now.

title: Inventory Specialist
description:
• Responsible for executing, monitoring, and training inventory best practices and standard operating procedures for the entire store, including both front end and pharmacy. Supports pharmacy inventory management activities, including receiving, counting, ordering, and facilitating returns. Champions On-Shelf Availability and is responsible for receiving, counting, pricing, returns, and all in-store inventory processes. Validates and ensures accuracy of planograms.
  • Responsible for reviewing and coordinating the proper use of reports and system applications, which have an impact on the accuracy of front end and pharmacy on-hand balances and pricing.
  • Responsible for executing and maintaining front end and pharmacy asset protection techniques, and filing claims for warehouse and vendor overages (merchandise received, but not billed), shortages (merchandise billed, but not received), order errors or damaged goods including prescription drugs.
  • In designated stores, as required, opens and closes the store in the absence of store management, including all required systems start-ups, required cash handling and cashier responsibilities, and ensuring the floor and stock room are ready for the business day.
Customer Experience
  • Engages customers by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. In designated stores, when serving as the leader on duty, resolves customer issues and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.
  • Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).
Operations
  • Executes and coaches team members on warehouse and vendor inventory management processes including but not limited to creating, reviewing, and receiving orders.
  • Scans in all deliveries while the vendor is still in the store, including common carrier deliveries. Focuses on One Box receiving. Takes the appropriate action marking delivery as received if the product was physically delivered, contacting vendor for past undelivered scheduled receipts, and opening tickets as needed to correct inaccurate orders.
  • Under the supervision of the pharmacist-in-charge, verifies all pharmacy shipments are posted for products physically received at the store. Completes or verifies postings of all pharmacy warehouse orders, ABC prescription and OTC orders daily, secondary vendor orders, flu and dropship orders performing any necessary tote audits, and accurately reporting any shortages or damaged product.
  • Completes On-Shelf Availability (OSA) end-to-end process including warehouse and direct store delivery (DSD) for planogrammed departments, executing disposals, call-ins, and vendor returns before expiration, completes scan outs/ scan outs returns on all subscribed departments including vendor/ DSD departments and pharmacy scan outs.
  • Under the supervision of the pharmacist-in-charge,completes pharmacy inventory activities including but not limited to pharmacy recalls following Pharmacy Hazardous Waste Policy, vendor returns, non-controlled, and damaged salvage returns. Facilitates excess inventory returns or interstore pharmacy transfers where applicable for non-returnable ABC overstock. Verifies posting of all pharmacy/ prescription claims.
  • Completes execution of all pricing activities including price changes, markdowns, and markdowns deletes. Responsible for basic department pricing, including daily price changes, accurate pricing with correct signage, and reliable and timely completion of any additional regulatory pricing tasks.
  • Responsible for supporting front end and pharmacy ordering by ordering expense items. Monitors pharmacy manual orders to identify excess orders. Maintains consigned inventory and orders as required.
  • Ensures all designated pull & quarantine item on-hands are updated and placed in the designated holding area.
  • Maintains accurate inventory counts. Maintains the accuracy of on-hand quantities including but not limited to basic departments, stockroom, overstock locations.
  • Under the supervision of the pharmacist-in-charge, maintains accurate inventory counts and accuracy of on-hand quantities in pharmacy and completes pharmacy smart counts.
  • Ensures the store maintains inventory compliance with state and local laws regarding regulated products (e.g., alcoholic beverages and tobacco products).
  • Assists in the maintenance of inventory records, including receiving and posting of all products (in the front-end)) received at the store in all inventory systems. Organizes files and retains all invoices/receipts/return authorizations necessary for all inventory activities.
  • Helps to prepare for physical inventory and supports the physical inventory day activities, including but not limited to preparing sales floor, stockroom, and pharmacy for inventory and auditing the third party team on the day of inventory.
  • Supports keeping all counters and shelves clean and well merchandised.
  • Knowledgeable of all store systems and equipment.
  • Assists and coaches store team on all package delivery activities, including scanning in and out of packages, completing all daily inventory functions and, package returns at Walgreens. Supports execution of Pickup Program.
  • In designated stores, when serving as the leader on duty, responsible and accountable for registering all related sales on assigned point-of-sale system (POS), including records of scanning errors, price verifications, items not on file, price modifications, and voids. Completes product returns, order voids, customer refunds, cash drops to safe, and provides change as requested for point of sale.
  • Complies with all company policies and procedures; maintains respectful relationships with coworkers.
  • Completes any additional activities and other tasks as assigned.
Training & Personal Development
  • Attends company-based trainings for continuous development and completes all e-learning modules including safety training requirements.

Communications
  • Serves as a liaison between management and non-management team members by coaching and developing other capabilities with inventory systems. When serving as the leader on duty, communicates assigned tasks to team members and reports disciplinary issues and customer complaints to management.

title: Retail Supervisor (FT)
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Retail Supervisor is responsible for providing direct support to store management, overseeing front line and kitchen operations in accordance with policies and procedures, and providing superior customer service and ensuring customer satisfaction to all store patrons.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES

  1. Assist managers with office duties, including data entry, daily reports, payroll, invoices, shift paperwork, incident reports, and scheduling kitchen employee shifts.
  2. Supervise assignments and breaks and coordinate till startup/closing and shift changeovers.
  3. Open and/or close the store according to policy and procedure.
  4. Train and coach all new employees, including conducting employee performance reviews, taking corrective actions, and informing management of staffing issues or needs.
  5. Process various transactions, including cash, credit/debit, coupons, discounts, and refunds, by issuing receipts, refunds, credits, and change to customers.
  6. Balance till and receipts daily, document discrepancies and maintain a safe and secure working environment for all cash handling.
  7. Greet store customers and thank them upon departure as well as resolve customer concerns.
  8. Manage inventory using a hand-held scanner, ensuring accuracy in ordering, storage, display, rotation, counting, invoice entry, and supervising inventory cycles.
  9. Inspect all work areas, including the kitchen, for inspection requirements.
  10. Work closely with managers in all functions of kitchen operations, sales, and budgets.
  11. Ensure all kitchen equipment is maintained and properly serviced.
  12. Participate in on-going training as required.
  13. Maintain confidentiality at all times.
  14. Perform other duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS

  • Knowledge of and ability to abide by Federal, State, and Tribal laws, Lummi Code of Laws, and Washington State Liquor Laws for Alcohol & Tobacco Sales.
  • Proficiency in cash handling, problem-solving, and attention to detail and follow-up.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and diligence with tasks.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, including effective interaction with employees at all levels, including front line and upper management, as well as people of diverse backgrounds.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and motivate all team members to do the same.
  • Possess supervisory qualities and take initiative to suggest improvements.
  • Ability to exercise good judgment and balance priorities and workload.
  • Ability to show a positive demeanor as well as a willingness to promote and sell products.
  • Ability to interact with customers and staff in a respectful, professional, and calm manner.
  • Must pass pre-employment and random drug and alcohol tests to be eligible for and maintain employment, as required by the LCC Substance Abuse policy.
  • Must pass an extensive criminal background check.

Computer Skills: Proficiency in using equipment for tasks including clocking in/out, operating a POS system, handling a handheld scanner, and utilizing other electronic equipment as required by job duties.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the essential functions of this position, employees will be required to:

  • Must be able to lift up to 40 lbs. unassisted.
  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time.
  • Must be able to bend, kneel, climb, walk, and use hands and fingers to handle and feel objects, tools, and controls.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the essential functions of this position, employees may be exposed to the following conditions:

  • Store areas with loose objects or wet surfaces or other congestion from patrons and products.
  • May be exposed to food preparation equipment with cold or hot temperatures.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Education Required: High School Diploma or GED.

Education Preferred: N/A.

Experience: One (1) year as an LCC Cashier or two (2) years’ experience customer service/cashier preferred. Prior Supervisor experience preferred. Prior Kitchen experience preferred.

Certificates & Licenses: Must possess a valid Washington State Driver’s license and meet eligibility requirements for tribal insurance. Must obtain a food handler permit within 90 days of employment.

A combination of education and experience may be considered as a substitute for a degree requirement.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

Supervises Cashier and/or Cook employees including managing productivity, staff development, defining essential job functions, and coaching.

title: Account Management Director
description:
Our client is a global augmented-reality hardware company developing advanced optics, waveguides, display systems, and precision manufacturing technology for the next generation of smart glasses. After more than a decade of AR innovation, the company is expanding its component-supplier model and partnering with leading consumer electronics and technology companies.

The company employs approximately 800 people and has raised more than $4.3 billion from major strategic and institutional investors. This is an opportunity to help define a newly forming account management function around industry-leading hardware that will be designed into future AR products.

We are hiring an Account Management Director to own and grow strategic OEM partner relationships through complex, 12-to-18-month product development cycles. This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports and no new-business quota. You will be the primary bridge between customers and internal engineering, product, operations, and supply-chain teams from technical qualification through production.

What you will do

• Own day-to-day relationships with strategic OEM partners from technical qualification and design reviews through manufacturing readiness and production.
• Serve as the single point of contact between partner teams and internal engineering, product, operations, legal, and supply-chain stakeholders.
• Coordinate technical discussions, program milestones, design tradeoffs, commercial changes, and executive communication across complex buying organizations.
• Advocate for partner needs while communicating manufacturing constraints, technical risks, and schedule implications clearly and proactively.
• Protect long-term account value through negotiations, scope changes, and product-lifecycle decisions.
• Build the operating cadence, processes, and account-management playbook for a new function.
• Maintain trusted relationships with both executive and technical stakeholders across global partner organizations.

Requirements

What we are looking for

• 10 or more years of technical account management or customer-facing experience in complex hardware.
• Experience at a semiconductor, optics, display, photonics, consumer-electronics, sensor, or capital-equipment company.
• A record of owning a strategic or OEM account through a full product development cycle from qualification into production.
• Experience with long, complex sales or design-in cycles of approximately 12 to 18 months.
• Technical credibility to discuss design tradeoffs and manufacturing constraints without always relying on a specialist.
• Strong cross-functional coordination across engineering, product, operations, legal, and supply chain.
• Executive-level communication, commercial judgment, and comfort navigating ambiguity in a newly forming function.
• A desire to remain a hands-on senior individual contributor rather than build or lead a large team.
• Candidates must already be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Helpful experience includes direct familiarity with optics, waveguides, displays, photonics, semiconductors, sensors, or AR and VR hardware; experience at a component supplier selling into OEM design cycles; an engineering background followed by a transition into strategic account management; and international account ownership.

Benefits

Base salary of $160,000 to $200,000 with flexibility based on experience and market feedback. Annual performance bonus, unlimited paid time off, comprehensive medical and retirement benefits, and up to $20,000 in relocation support. This role does not include equity or sales commission. The position is remote within the United States, with Austin, Texas or Plantation, Florida preferred, and requires approximately 50 percent travel including international travel.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
Our client is a pre-seed fintech company building an agentic neobank: an autonomous personal CFO designed to optimize cash, debt, budgeting, expenses, investing, and taxes. We are hiring a Founding Engineer to become the company's first technical hire and build the product from prototype through MVP launch. You will own the architecture, stack, and technical standards across web, mobile, backend, cloud infrastructure, AI agents, and regulated money movement. This is a deeply hands-on 0-to-1 role with a clear path to technical leadership as the team grows.

What you'll do

• Build the MVP end to end across web, mobile, backend, data, and infrastructure

• Integrate banking-as-a-service partners, payment rails, card and lending systems, and KYC and AML services

• Design secure, resilient architecture for an agentic financial-services platform

• Build agentic workflows that make real-money decisions with deterministic logic, auditability, and compliance guardrails

• Select cloud, data, observability, disaster-recovery, and security approaches from first principles

• Set engineering standards for future hires while coordinating with contract engineers

• Ship production systems quickly without compromising trust, reliability, or regulatory requirements

Requirements

• 5 or more years of full-stack software-engineering experience

• A track record of building and shipping a product from zero to one for real users

• End-to-end ability across React or React Native, TypeScript, backend services, Python, and cloud infrastructure

• Hands-on experience building or deploying AI agents or agentic workflows in production

• Experience owning architecture for secure, reliable production systems

• Strong product judgment, bias for action, and comfort operating as the first technical hire

• Ability to work regularly from New York City or San Francisco within 12 to 18 months

Bonus points

• Experience at a US fintech startup in neobanking, banking-as-a-service, cards, lending, or payments rails

• Experience with KYC, AML, money movement, regulated data, or consumer financial products

• Familiarity with LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, and production AI safety patterns

• A computer-science or other technical degree

• Interest in growing into a technical leadership and management role

Benefits

• Base salary of $150K-$300K

• Founding-team equity of 1% to 4%

• Exceptional scope and direct influence over product, architecture, and company direction

• Visa transfers, OPT, and H-1B sponsorship may be available for exceptional candidates

title: Construction Project Manager, Data Center Capacity Delivery
description:
Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be eligible to obtain an Australian Government Security Clearance with the ability to successfully complete an Organisational Suitability Assessment. For more information regarding security clearances please visit (https://www.agsva.gov.au/).

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Construction Project Managers (CPMs) are always at the forefront of the construction industry in terms of innovation, and maintain a focus to deliver the most innovative products to our customers. Our data centers are industry leading facilities in terms of energy efficiency and cost effectiveness. The Data Center CPM is ultimately responsible for the day to day construction oversight and management of the contractors. The CPM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, building services, architectural, electrical or mechanical engineering) and shall be responsible as a team member for delivering construction of some of the most sophisticated electrical and mechanical systems in the world.

At Amazon we leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the substation, to the server, and back to the cooling towers. We are diverse, upbeat, creative, team-oriented construction professionals working on a daily basis to develop data centers that are changing the face of data facilities.

Daily responsibilities will include all aspects of the entire data center lifecycle construction starting with the site feasibility, through the procurement of the design teams and design review, daily construction oversight, and commissioning of completed facilities.

Key job responsibilities
- Project management and oversight of construction related activities for new builds or general capital projects. This will include the ownership of the project scope, timeline, and budgets.
- Driving costs down and schedules shorter while maintaining quality.
- Provide Construction Management for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.
- Review of constructability of electrical and mechanical system and building designs associated with the construction of new data centers or the optimization of existing data centers.
- Creation of project scope and equipment requirements, assist with request for proposals, and capital requests. - Total project quality including the assisting with commissioning and integrated system testing and oversight of the execution of the project.
- Issue/Manage the Request for Information process during construction and coordinate construction administration with engineers
- Recording and reporting key metrics to team members and management.
- Concurrently managing multiple projects including new data center building and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centers.
- Operational support of installed facilities including review of procedures, best practices, and maintenance initiatives.
- Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
- Travel to datacenter sites for electrical systems audits, mechanical system reviews, constructability reviews, startup testing, and full commissioning, as required.

A day in the life
AWS Construction Managers lead the delivery of our Data Center projects. They work closely with Internal Stakeholders and Contractors, resolving project issues, managing RFIs, Change Orders and other key delivery functions. Our CMs spend the majority of the week on site working closely with our vendors to drive project outcomes.

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer (AWS & Azure)
location: Metro Manila, National Capital Region, ph
description:
As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer at Bilue, you own the security, compliance and operational integrity of the AWS and Azure platforms we run for our clients, including their AI workloads.

You will run the infrastructure, harden the pipelines, take the alerts our SOC partner escalates through to closure, and keep our ISO 27001 evidence audit ready.This is a hands-on role inside the codebase, working alongside our engineers rather than reviewing their work from a distance. This role is a technical lead, but there are no people management responsibilities and you will have no direct reports.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Operate and maintain AWS and Azure infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and environment configuration across client platforms

  • Triage security alerts escalated by our third party SOC, drive each one through to remediation and closure, and lead the post incident review

  • Monitor security posture and manage vulnerability remediation across the infrastructure and application layers, including patching and dependency updates

  • Review pull requests alongside the development team and embed security controls into build and deployment processes in line with agreed policies

  • Manage identity, access controls, secrets and API credentials across both clouds, including key rotation and least privilege reviews

  • Maintain observability, alerting, backup and disaster recovery capability, and run regular recovery and restoration testing

  • Maintain infrastructure and security compliance to ISO 27001, covering configuration standards, logging, audit evidence and closure of control gaps

  • Use AI responsibly and in line with Bilue's AI policies, treating it as a tool to work smarter while keeping human judgement at the centre of your decisions

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Mindset & Experience

  • Real craft in your work, you build the security gate rather than only switching on the scanner, and you care that a fix actually holds

  • A consultative approach, you can explain a risk and its trade offs to a client or an engineer without hiding behind jargon

  • A passion for connection, you share what you find and lift the security knowledge of the whole team rather than keeping it to yourself

  • Ownership and accountability, happy to be the security escalation point and to take an alert through to closure without being chased

  • A drive to shape solutions, curious enough to trace a dependency alert through to real exploitability in the codebase and then work with developers on the fix

Technical Skills

  • Strong hands on experience operating production workloads across both AWS and Azure in a cloud security, DevSecOps or platform engineering role

  • Cloud security services in production. GuardDuty, Security Hub, IAM, KMS and CloudTrail on the AWS side, or Defender for Cloud, Entra ID, Key Vault and Azure Policy on the Azure side

  • Confident writing and reviewing Terraform or equivalent infrastructure as code

  • Able to read application code, raise security issues at the code level, and understand how APIs, services and databases fit together in a running platform

  • Able to diagnose faults across the stack and run root cause analysis, tracing a vulnerability from a dependency alert through to real exploitability, then working with developers on the fix

  • CI/CD pipeline experience, including building the security gates rather than only configuring a scanner

  • Practical security alert triage and incident response alongside an external SOC or MSSP

  • Working knowledge of ISO 27001 controls and audit evidence

  • AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or an equivalent certification

Nice to Have

  • A background in platform or backend delivery, with experience building and shipping systems rather than only securing them

LIFE AT BILUE

Connection that counts
From monthly Anchor Days and team lunches to our annual offsite, we create intentional moments to connect, collaborate, and celebrate. These are not just fun perks. They are part of how we work and grow together.

Flexibility that works
We offer flexible hours, aligned with AEST so you can collaborate with the wider team. It gives you the space to do your best work while staying genuinely connected.

Strong internal communities
We actively foster internal communities across tech, design, delivery, AI and beyond, giving you plenty of chances to connect, share knowledge, and learn from your peers.

Opportunities to grow
We invest in your development with unlimited access to our learning library, partnership networks and certification pathways, plus support from our internal performance coach. Whether you want to deepen your technical skills or grow your leadership potential, we will back you.

Flat structure, real impact
At Bilue, everyone's voice matters. Our leadership team is hands-on and approachable, and we operate without unnecessary layers. We keep things open and transparent, and your ideas will be heard, no matter your title.

title: Part-Time On-Call Job Network ( For Alvin ISD Employees)
description:
Job Description


On-Call Substitute Team Member


Organization: Gathering Outreach Community Services

Program: Gathering Kids Afterschool Program

Position Type: Part-Time, On-Call (As Needed)

Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 3 PM–6:30 PM (based on program needs)

Reports To: Campus Manager or Program Director


Position Summary


Gathering Outreach welcomes dependable, energetic, and caring individuals to serve as **Substitute Team Members** for our Gathering Kids Afterschool Program. Substitute Team Members provide classroom and program support when regularly scheduled staff members are unavailable, helping ensure students continue to experience a safe, structured, and engaging environment.


This position is ideal for individuals who enjoy working with children, are flexible with scheduling, and are committed to making a positive impact in their community.


Essential Responsibilities


* Supervise and engage students in a safe and positive environment.

* Assist with student check-in, attendance, and dismissal procedures.

* Support homework assistance and academic enrichment activities.

* Facilitate games, recreational activities, arts and crafts, and other enrichment experiences.

* Encourage positive behavior while reinforcing program expectations.

* Build respectful and supportive relationships with students, families, and staff.

* Maintain cleanliness and organization of assigned program areas.

* Follow all Gathering Outreach Community Services policies, procedures, and safety protocols.

* Respond appropriately to emergencies and communicate concerns to program leadership.

* Perform other duties as assigned to support program operations.


Qualifications


* Must be at least 18 years of age (or meet approved student employment requirements, if applicable).

* High school diploma or equivalent preferred.

* Experience working with children in educational, childcare, youth development, recreation, or mentoring settings is preferred.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

* Ability to work effectively as part of a team.

* Demonstrate professionalism, reliability, flexibility, and sound judgment.

* Must successfully complete all required background screenings and onboarding requirements.


Physical Requirements


* Ability to stand, walk, bend, and actively supervise students for extended periods.

* Ability to participate in indoor and outdoor activities.

* Occasionally lift or move items weighing up to 25 pounds.


Work Schedule


Substitute Team Members are scheduled on an as-needed basis. Assignments may be planned in advance or requested with short notice depending on staffing needs. Availability does not guarantee work hours.


Compensation


Compensation is based on the approved hourly rate for substitute staff and is paid only for hours worked. Assignments are offered based on organizational needs and substitute availability.


Why Join Our Team?


At Gathering Outreach Community Services, we believe every child deserves a safe, supportive, and inspiring place to learn after school. As a Substitute Team Member, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful difference while gaining valuable experience working with youth in a collaborative and mission-driven environment.


We are committed to building a team that leads with integrity, compassion, professionalism, and excellence in serving children, families, and our community.

title: Senior AWS DevOps Engineer - Atlanta
description:
ImagineX is a tech company that deploys AI‑assisted teams to build and secure mission‑critical enterprise solutions with our clients – spanning software, data, and AI. Structured like a software company, not a traditional consultancy, we blend deep technical expertise with authentic values, achieving world‑class satisfaction (NPS 91). Our dedicated teams specialize in software, data, and AI across the U.S. and LATAM, bridging the gap between boutique agility and enterprise scale.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior AWS DevOps Engineer to join our high‑performing engineering team. In this role, you will architect, automate, and optimize cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines that support mission‑critical enterprise systems. You’ll collaborate closely with software and data engineering teams to deliver secure, scalable, and resilient solutions for our clients.

This is a hands‑on senior role for someone who thrives in automation‑first environments, enjoys solving complex cloud challenges, and wants to influence DevOps strategy across multiple projects. You’ll be working with a team of ImagineX’ers ensuring strong alignment and a smooth partnership with the client.

This is a 100% remote full-time position.

What You’ll Do

  • Architect, implement, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure using Terraform, with a strong focus on scalable, Kubernetes‑based architectures.
  • Design, build, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to support containerized and Kubernetes‑deployed applications.
  • Manage and automate provisioning, configuration, and scaling across multiple environments, including Kubernetes clusters and supporting services.
  • Deploy, secure, and maintain Amazon EKS clusters and Kubernetes workloads, including cluster lifecycle management, node group optimization, and workload orchestration.
  • Troubleshoot production issues across AWS and Kubernetes environments, perform root‑cause analysis, and drive long‑term reliability improvements.
  • Champion DevOps culture, automation, and continuous improvement across teams

What You Need
  • 5–8+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering.
  • Deep expertise with AWS cloud infrastructure using Terraform, with a strong focus on scalable, Kubernetes‑based architectures.
  • Strong experience with GitHub Actions and scripting skills in Python
  • Experience with Anthropic Claude, including prompt design, model capabilities/limitations, and best practices for using Claude in development, automation, and documentation workflows.
  • Ability to hit the ground running with Claude‑based tooling, leveraging it for code generation, architectural exploration, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency.

Nice to Have

  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, SysOps Administrator, etc.)
  • Experience with service mesh, API gateways, or distributed systems
  • Background in .NET, Node.js, or backend engineering

This role is based in the US and only open to citizens and permanent residents of the US who do not require visa sponsorship.

title: Product Engineer
description:
Our client is a seed-stage technology company building an AI-native platform for global trade, customs compliance, and duty recovery. Its software brings fragmented documents, spreadsheets, APIs, and supply-chain data into one system so businesses can identify savings, recover refunds, and stay compliant as trade policy changes. The company has raised $5.4M, serves more than 80 customers, and has grown revenue more than fourfold in the past six months.

This is a full-stack Product Engineer role on a small, high-caliber team with three hires planned. You will own meaningful parts of the product from problem discovery through production, working directly with the founders and customers to turn messy global-trade workflows into reliable, intuitive software. You will build across TypeScript, Node.js, React, GraphQL, and PostgreSQL while shaping agentic AI capabilities for a compliance-heavy domain.

Requirements

2 to 5 years of full-stack product engineering experience.

Strong production experience with TypeScript across a Node.js backend and React frontend.

Solid PostgreSQL and data-modeling fundamentals.

Experience shipping end-to-end features in a data-heavy or compliance-adjacent product such as fintech, logistics, or B2B SaaS.

Experience with messy integrations, document pipelines, or data-wrangling workflows.

Experience in a credible engineering culture, ideally at a company that reached Series B or later.

Computer science degree or related technical degree.

Strong product judgment, curiosity, and comfort operating with ambiguity and ownership.

Candidates must be in the San Francisco Bay Area or willing to relocate and work from the office three days per week.

Benefits

$185,000 to $230,000 base salary.

Meaningful early-stage equity.

Direct access to the founders and substantial ownership over product and engineering decisions.

Opportunity to join a fast-growing team ahead of its next financing stage.

Existing H-1B transfers and TN, J-1, or O-1 visas may be considered, but the company cannot provide new H-1B sponsorship.

title: Healthcare Billing Specialist
description:
Position Summary

The Healthcare Biller is responsible for accurately creating, reviewing, and submitting claims to insurance carriers and other payers in a timely manner. This position verifies patient accounts and coverage information, follows claims through the revenue cycle, and helps resolve issues that may delay payment. The Healthcare Biller also serves as a backup Payment Poster and supports accurate, compliant documentation of all billing activity.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Create, review, and submit accurate electronic and paper claims to insurance carriers and other payers within established timelines.
  • Confirm that claims include complete patient, provider, insurance, authorization, and charge information before submission.
  • Complete patient account verifications, including confirming demographic information, insurance eligibility, benefits, coverage, and coordination of benefits, as applicable.
  • Review claim edits, rejections, and payer responses; correct errors and resubmit claims promptly.
  • Monitor outstanding claims and follow up with payers on unpaid, underpaid, or delayed claims.
  • Document billing activity, payer communications, corrections, and follow-up actions clearly and accurately in the applicable system.
  • Serve as a backup Payment Poster by accurately posting insurance and patient payments, adjustments, denials, and remittance information when needed.
  • Protect patient confidentiality and perform all duties in accordance with HIPAA, payer requirements, company policies, and applicable laws and regulations.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Physical and Work Requirements

This position primarily involves prolonged periods of sitting and computer use, frequent keyboarding, and regular telephone communication. The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

title: BCBA - I/DDD
description:
Make a Difference in the Lives of Adults with Developmental Disabilities

Hawaiʻi Behavioral Health (HBH) is seeking compassionate and motivated Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) to provide Training & Consultation (T&C) services through our Developmental Disabilities Division (i/DDD) Waiver Program.


We are currently hiring for positions on:

  • Hawaiʻi Island (Big Island) – 1 Opening
  • Oʻahu – 1 Opening


Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA) – Training & Consultation (T&C)


In this role, you will support adults (ages 22+) with intellectual and developmental disabilities by partnering with participants, families, caregivers, service supervisors, and direct support staff to develop and implement individualized, person-centered behavior support strategies. Services are guided by each participant's Individualized Service Plan (ISP) and are designed to promote independence, enhance quality of life, increase community inclusion, and support meaningful progress toward each individual's personal goals.

Services may be provided in participants' homes, community-based settings (including Adult Day Health Programs & Residential Facilies) or employment locations, as authorized by the ISP.


RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Providing recommendations to inform the person-centered planning process and support the development of meaningful goals, objectives, and outcomes.
  • Supervising and monitoring participants, families, caregivers, and providers to ensure quality service delivery and alignment with the ISP.
  • Developing behavioral support plans and protocols to address identified needs and promote participant well-being.
  • Delivering initial and/or ongoing training, instruction, and technical assistance, which may include:
    • Supportive counseling to strengthen family systems and promote emotional well-being.
    • Instruction on treatment regimens and other services outlined in the Individualized Service Plan (ISP) or Action Plan.
    • Training for caregivers and providers on the use of equipment or tools specified in the service plan.
    • Providing updates and modifications to plans as needed to ensure the participant’s continued safety and success in the home and community.
REQUIREMENTS:
  • Certified BCBA
  • 2+ years of experience preferred
  • Ability to travel throughout assigned service areas
  • Strong assessment, documentation, and organizational skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with interdisciplinary teams
  • Experience supporting individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities preferred
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and electronic documentation systems
  • Must be able to successfully pass all required background screenings and credentialing requirements.
  • Must provide/obtain TB clearance/results prior to employment.
  • Current CPR/First Aid certification required, or willingness to obtain certification prior to providing services.
  • Must provide official college transcripts to verify educational requirements.
  • Must be able to meet all HBH, DDD, and Medicaid Waiver onboarding and compliance requirements prior to providing services.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:


Compensation: $70-$75 per hour, based on experience, with separate administrative rates, if applicable.

  • This position offers a flexible schedule, with hours ranging from P/T to As Needed basis, depending on referral flow.
  • Mileage reimbursement for work-related travel (if applicable)
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance (eligible employees / insurance starts first of the month after 4 consecutive weeks of 20+ hours)
  • Paid time off accruals
  • Paid training and continuing education opportunities
  • Supportive and collaborative clinical leadership
  • Opportunities for professional growth within a growing organization


WHY JOIN HBH?

At HBH, our BCBAs have the opportunity to make a lasting impact beyond traditional ABA services. Through the DDD Training & Consultation Program, you'll work collaboratively with adults, families, and interdisciplinary teams to develop sustainable, person-centered supports that promote independence, improve quality of life, and strengthen community inclusion. We value clinical autonomy, collaboration, and innovative, culturally responsive care that empowers individuals to achieve their goals.



ABOUT HAWAII BEHAVIORAL HEALTH

At Hawai`i Behavioral Health, we believe each child and individual has a special gift to offer, each family has its own unique strength to build upon, and each person who struggles with emotional or mental health challenges can find hope for a better life. Our legacy evolves each and every day as we work together as a team in the lives of the children, individuals, and families we serve.

"A’ohe hana nui ka alu’ia" No task is too big when done together...

Our History: Hawai`i Behavioral Health was created in 1993 to meet the needs of Hawaii’s children, adults, and families.

Our Mission: To improve the health and well-being of the clients we serve and their families by demonstrating excellence in delivery of social, education, and behavioral health services. Our team of dedicated staff lives our mission.

Our Vision: To develop a system of integrated services to meet the needs of Hawai`i through innovative, culturally relevant, and best practices.

Our Values: Dedication, Excellence, Fortitude, Compassion, Individual & Family Centered, Empowerment

Hawaii Behavioral Health was founded in 1993 to serve Hawaii's youth and families through behavioral, educational, and social health services. Our service has expended over the years to include paraprofessional support, behavioral health intervention, early intervention programs, psychological assessments, individual and family therapy, intensive home-based services, therapeutic foster care, and parent training. Our team of professionals remain dedicated to providing the highest quality of service for nurturing a child emotionally, intellectually, physically and spiritually. Join our team and further our mission to improve the health and well-being of children and families in Hawaii.


Hawaii Behavioral Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity, sexual orientation, gender identity, citizenship status, military status, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws. Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other marginalized communities.



HBH staff are committed to cultural competence. Cultural competence is the ability of individuals and systems to respond respectfully and effectively to people of all cultures, classes, races, ethnic backgrounds, sexual orientations, ability statuses, and faiths or religions in a manner that recognizes, affirms, and values the work of individuals, families, tribes, and communities, and protects and preserves the dignity of each. Cultural competence is a continuous process of learning about the differences of others and integrating their unique strengths and perspectives into our lives.

title: Trade Assistant - Boilermaking

title: Security Vulnerability Engineer (R-00224)
description:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

True Zero is seeking a Security Vulnerability Engineer to lead the design, development, and
operation of advanced vulnerability management and threat-detection capabilities across
secure, mission-critical environments. This is a senior technical role for an engineer who pairs
hands-on expertise in security analytics, detection engineering, and predictive risk modeling
with the judgment to guide teams, engage clients, and deliver production-grade, responsibly

governed security solutions.

The ideal candidate brings a track record of directing security and analytics initiatives across
national security and highly regulated environments — combining technical depth in threat
detection and predictive modeling with the strategic acumen to reduce operational risk, minimize
exposure, and enable data-driven decision-making at the command level. This engineer will
configure data pipelines, establish security telemetry ingestion processes, and implement
predictive components that analyze five or more years of historical incident and vulnerability
data to generate time- and location-based risk forecasts that are operationally meaningful to

command staff and field leadership

Job Responsibilities

  • Vulnerability Management: Identify, assess, and prioritize vulnerabilities across
    enterprise systems; develop and tune detection logic and analytics that meet defined
    performance and coverage standards.
  • Threat Detection Engineering: Design, develop, and implement detection and
    enrichment systems that analyze large volumes of unstructured security telemetry, logs,
    and threat-intelligence data.
  • Technical Leadership: Lead security engineering projects with a focus on detection,
    vulnerability analytics, and emerging defensive technologies.
  • Predictive Risk Modeling & Forecasting: Configure data pipelines and telemetry
    ingestion processes and implement predictive components that analyze five or more years
    of historical incident and vulnerability data to generate time- and location-based risk
    forecasts.
  • Systems Integration: Integrate detection and vulnerability-management solutions with
    existing SIEM, ticketing, and operational systems to ensure seamless data flow and
    usability within current workflows; collaborate with cross-functional teams, including work
    within the STRIDE platform.
  • Validation & Accuracy: Validate data integrity, detection performance, and system
    reliability across security tooling; assess detection and forecast accuracy, ensure
    alignment between predicted and observed threat patterns, and verify outputs are
    operationally meaningful for command staff and field leadership.
  • Performance Management: Monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve detection and
    vulnerability-analytics performance; identify optimization opportunities and tune for scale,
    efficiency, and low false-positive rates in cloud environments.
  • Tool Utilization: Leverage common security and analytics tooling (SIEM, vulnerability
    scanners, AWS security services, TensorFlow, PyTorch) and custom frameworks for
    specialized detection applications.
  • Governance & Risk: Assess model and detection risks, biases, and coverage gaps in accordance with responsible-use guidelines and regulatory requirements.
    • Detection Operations (DetOps/MLOps): Implement practices to automate deployment,
      monitoring, and lifecycle management of detections, analytics, and models.

Job Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years in security engineering, vulnerability management, or
    detection engineering, spanning design, evaluation, and deployment.
  • Citizenship: U.S. citizenship required; must be willing to undergo a U.S. Government
    background investigation.
  • Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with security analytics and detection
    frameworks, scripting/automation (Python), and major cloud platforms; familiarity with
    PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Hugging Face, LangChain, and API-driven tooling for
    analytics is a strong plus.
  • Data Management: Experience with large-scale data stores, search/vector databases
    (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Chroma), and retrieval-based analysis architectures for
    security use cases.
  • Advanced Analytics: Advanced query and detection engineering, model/detection tuning,
    and hands-on experience with analytics and automation tooling.
  • Evaluation: Experience in detection and model evaluation, monitoring, validation,
    benchmarking, and deployment
We’re actively searching for talented security and technology practitioners who are ready to experience the True Zero difference. As a True Zero team member, you'll enjoy:
- Competitive salary, paid twice per month

- 100% of medical premiums covered by True Zero

title: Stress Student Placement
description:
Company

ALPINE RACING LIMITED

Job Description

Duration: 1 year
Start Date: July 2027

We are a high-performance Formula One Team driven by innovation, precision, and passion. Our Structures and Materials group is responsible for the analysis and validation of components to ensure they meet the demanding performance, safety, and reliability standards of Formula One. As a Stress Student Placement, you’ll be part of a team that uses advanced simulation and testing techniques to support the design and development of race-critical components.

As a Stress Student Placement, you’ll support the Team in performing structural analysis, validating designs, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. You’ll work closely with design groups including Mechanical and Composites Depts together with Aerodynamics and Vehicle Performance Depts to ensure components are optimised for strength, stiffness, and weight.

  • Passion for motorsport and a proactive, analytical mindset

At Alpine Formula One Team, you won’t just contribute; you’ll make a direct impact on race car performance at the pinnacle of motorsport. Working alongside some of the most talented individuals in the industry, you’ll help shape innovation on a global stage.

Our purpose-built facilities in Enstone provide the perfect environment to thrive. We offer a competitive salary, private medical healthcare, full access to our free on-site gym, a fully catered restaurant with a daily allowance and a wide range of additional benefits designed to support your wellbeing and growth.

Beyond the perks, you’ll be part of a team that’s pushing boundaries in Formula One. The thrill of pioneering cutting-edge technology, combined with a collaborative and inclusive culture, creates unmatched opportunities for career development and personal achievement.

Take the next step in your career and play your part in shaping the future of Formula One.

Full Time – St Vincent’s Health Australia (SVHA)

Mater Hospital North Sydney | St Vincent’s Private Hospital Sydney | Griffith Hospital

START YOUR CAREER IN CLINICAL CODING WITH ONE OF AUSTRALIA’S MOST RESPECTED HEALTH ORGANISATIONS.

St Vincent’s Health Australia (SVHA) is the nation’s largest not-for-profit provider of health and aged care services. Founded by the Sisters of Charity in 1857, our 30,000+ healthcare professionals deliver exceptional care across public and private hospitals, aged care, community and virtual care, and outreach programs.

We are offering an exciting opportunity for graduates to join our newly established Trainee Clinical Coder Program, designed to provide structured, hands-on training, mentoring, and ongoing professional support from experienced coding professionals.

This program offers a clear career pathway, combining practical learning, structured education via an online learning platform, and one-on-one guidance from skilled mentors to ensure you feel supported and confident as you begin your coding career.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Trainee Clinical Coder, you will learn how to assign accurate and timely clinical codes to patient episodes of care through detailed analysis of medical records. You will receive formal training and day-to-day guidance from our Health Information Services (HIS) team across Mater Hospital North Sydney, St Vincent’s Private Hospital Sydney and Griffith Hospital. This is a full-time development role that provides a pathway to a professional career in clinical coding, working within a supportive and highly skilled national team.

At St Vincent’s gain exposure to coding software technology utilising a hybrid EMR across all sites combined with a coding management software platform that supports assigning codes using the industry recognised Solventum Codefinder.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Participate in the Trainee Clinical Coder Program, including structured learning modules and mentoring.
  • Learn to apply ICD-10-AM/ACHI/ACS classifications and national/state coding standards.
  • Develop an understanding of hospital casemix, funding models, and data quality.
  • Contribute to education, audit and performance improvement activities.

ABOUT YOU

We are seeking motivated recent graduates who are ready to learn and grow in a supportive environment.

You will have:

  • A HIMAA Diploma of Clinical Coding or A Bachelor/Master of Health Information Management
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking and an eagerness to learn.
  • Excellent comprehension skills
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills.
  • Basic familiarity with medical terminology or coding principles
  • Excellent computer skills, proficiency with Microsoft suite of products
  • Previous hospital working experience will be viewed favourably
  • Trainees will need to attend the Mater Hospital North Sydney for training and onboarding. Once established, flexible and remote work options may be available with a hybrid working environment combining remote and onsite the preferred option.

WHY JOIN ST VINCENT’S?

  • Retention bonus as part of our commitment to supporting your growth and stability.
  • Learn from experienced and supportive coding professionals.
  • Structured training and mentoring through our new national trainee program.
  • Access to professional development and education funding.
  • Generous salary packaging benefits to increase your take-home pay.
  • Discounted gym memberships through Fitness Passport.
  • Access to discounted private health insurance with Medibank.
  • Flexible work options once competencies are achieved.
  • Be part of a mission-based organisation providing compassionate care to all.

HOW TO APPLY

Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your interest in the Trainee Clinical Coder Program and how your background aligns with the role.

This opportunity is open to Australian and New Zealand citizens or those with appropriate work rights. Visa sponsorship is not available.
