title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
We are looking for data scientists to analyze large data sets (we’re collecting billions of individual actions every month), build models and ship products that enable businesses to grow faster and communicate with their customers. Our background as a team is building these models for the Fortune 50 and we want to democratize and open up that technology to everyone.

The ideal candidate has a background in data science, statistics and machine learning and has done work ranging from exploratory analysis to training and deploying models. We use a wide variety of data mining and machine learning algorithms. The right candidate will have both a solid fundamental understanding and deep practical experience with at least a few modeling and machine learning techniques.

Our goal is always to match the right assumptions and models to the right problem -- they don’t necessarily have to be complex. You should have experience building models that are used by people to make better decisions. We’re focused on shipping early and often. We prefer iterative solutions that are incrementally better to the perfect solution. You should also be able to measure and know what impact your models had on the decisions people made -- e.g. did they outperform the previous best model or a human decision maker?

Our data science team is still in its early days and you’ll have a big impact on our direction and how we operate. You’ll be central to upfront research and shipping products that help our customers learn and grow from their data.

You:

    • Have a strong fundamental understanding and deep experience with at least a few machine learning algorithms (e.g. regressions, decision trees, k-means clustering, neural networks).
    • Understand Bayesian modeling techniques.
    • Are capable of analyzing data and making rigorous statements about what can or cannot be concluded.
    • Have experience designing and implementing model performance/validation assessments.
    • Have a background in statistics and understand different distributions and the conditions under which they’re valid.
    • Know how code and have used data science tools and packages.
    • Have demonstrated a measurable impact based on the models you’ve created. It’s not always easy getting a model correct and we love talking about places we got stuck and working as a team to think through ideas that could unblock us.
    • Have a desire to ship features powered by data science (in other words, you’re excited by both upfront research and actually getting models into production at cloud scale).

You Have:

    • Bachelor’s or advanced degree in statistics, applied mathematics, computer science or other relevant quantitative discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
    • Have worked in a data science role for 5+ years professionally or academically and can talk about your projects and the techniques you used.

About Us

We are a team of people who are crazy motivated by growth.

It’s what we help our customers do: grow their businesses by making it possible and easy for them to use their data to power better marketing.

It’s how we behave as individuals: we’re all deeply passionate about learning.

It’s how we manage our business: we have thousands of paying customers, we’re profitable, and we’re growing insanely fast.

title: Credits & Claims Controller
description:
Global FMCG | Claims, credits & investigations | High-volume role with strong systems, reporting and stakeholder focus | Hybrid Working

We are Pernod Ricard, a leading company in the global spirits industry with over 19,000 employees globally. We hold one of the most prestigious and comprehensive brand portfolios in the industry with premium brands including: Absolut vodka, The Glenlivet Scotch whisky, Jameson Irish whiskey, Martell cognac, Havana Club rum, Beefeater, Malfy and Monkey 47 gins, Malibu liqueur and Mumm and Perrier-Jouët champagnes.

The opportunity

As our Credit and Claims Controller – Pacific, you will support the accurate and timely management of customer claims and credits across Australia and New Zealand by investigating issues, processing credits, and partnering with key stakeholders to resolve disputes and improve outcomes.

Reporting to the Customer Services Manager – Pacific, you will play a key role in ensuring claims are handled efficiently, compliantly, and with strong visibility through reporting and root cause analysis.

This role is ideal for someone with claims, credit control, accounts receivable, supply chain, or logistics administration experience, along with strong attention to detail and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.

Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end processing of stock and pricing claims, including logging, investigation, validation, closure, and documentation.

  • Raise credit notes and recharges in JD Edwards (E1), ensuring accurate reason coding and compliance with internal frameworks.

  • Investigate claims and disputes with 3PLs, transport providers, Customer Service, Supply Chain, Sales, and Finance to identify and resolve root causes.

  • Deliver accurate fortnightly and monthly KPI reporting across claims, credits, recoveries, ageing, and service performance.

  • Support process improvement initiatives, system testing, SOP development, and general operational administration across Integrated Operations.

What you will bring to the role

  • Experience in claims processing, credit control, accounts receivable, warehouse administration, or supply chain operations.

  • Strong attention to detail and a high level of data accuracy.

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate issues and identify root causes.

  • Strong ERP system experience, ideally with JD Edwards or SAP, plus advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams and external partners.

Conviviality: the Pernod Ricard Way

Working at Pernod Ricard is all about igniting conviviality in all that we do. Derived from the French word, convivialité…it means human connection, authenticity, friendship, and fun. Conviviality is energy, spirit and charisma, and is a core philosophy around how we live and work at Pernod Ricard.

Guided by our four core values; we are team players, dream makers, trailblazers, movers and (cocktail) shakers. We have a passion for living life to the fullest, making new friends every day, and realizing our potential as people and as a business!

We know that happiness at work starts with that feeling of belonging you get from an inclusive culture where being uniquely you is celebrated. Our values are lived, they drive our behaviours, and it’s what brings our culture to life.

Our work philosophy celebrates the magic of human connection with the flexibility needed to provide one's most meaningful contribution. We offer a flexible work policy, with most of our positions offering a hybrid option with flexibility to work remotely 2 days a week.

Our mix of benefits

Product allowance | Hybrid and flexible working | Summer hours | Employee Assistance Program | Generous parental leave policy | Career development | Office drinks & events | Inclusive culture ERG |

Joining and contributing to an Inclusive workplace

As Créateurs de Convivialité, we are committed to better reflect the richness of our society, the marketplace, and communities in which we operate. We believe that it is the best way to build effective teams, understand our consumers by market and sustainably grow our business.

Pernod Ricard is part of Forbes World’s Best Employers and has been recognized by Equileap among the top 100 Employers for Gender Equality. As a skills-based organization, we ensure fair processes and equal opportunities for all candidates and team members by assessing your skills against role expectations. title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Enterprise Architect

Australian Unity



About us

Established in 1840, we are Australia's first wellbeing company, delivering health, wealth and care services for our members and the community.

As a social enterprise, we're motivated by our purpose to positively impact the wellbeing of millions. We reinvest profits to deliver products and services sustainably that matter most to our members, customers and the Australian community.

For us, Real Wellbeing encompasses the whole experience of life. It's about feeling supported in your health, connected with your community and empowered to live life on your terms.



The Opportunity

The Enterprise Architect is responsible for designing and overseeing the long-term architecture solutions that will affect the broad enterprise technology landscape. You will develop and maintain the enterprise architecture vision, strategy, and blueprints in collaboration with business owners and executives in line with the enterprise investment plans and risks appetite.

Working closely with domain and solution architects you will assist, guide, and align the use of appropriate organisational capabilities, guardrails, practices, and technologies whilst considering Australian Unity's overall business aims and outcomes.



Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a trusted advisor to drive business adoption and leverage enterprise technology platforms aligned with business domain strategy, goals, and objectives.
  • Lead the long-term (3-5 years) technology strategy discussions across the enterprise and business domains along with architecture work plans to progress the enterprise architecture.
  • Communicate the architecture vision and roadmap that will deliver business domain goals and objectives.
  • Lead the evaluation, selection, and adoption of technology solutions that drive business value and enable digital transformation.
  • Develop enterprise blueprints describing the organisation approved portfolio of technology platforms and promote reuse.
  • Develop and contribute to standards, guardrails and principles pertaining to technology usage and adoption.
  • Lead applications simplification and consolidation initiative in the areas of coverage in support of broader enterprise technology simplification strategy
  • Align and support the architectural governance processes including the review and approval of new technology initiatives

Applications Close: September 20th, 2026

You will bring:

  • Advanced degree in computing, computer science, business / information systems or other IT related field
  • 10+ years in business and/or technology strategic and operational planning as an Enterprise or Domain Architect advisor. 10+ years in these areas: Business Architecture, Business Capability Assessment, Data / Information Architecture, Technology Architecture, Integration Architecture and Solution Architecture
  • Exposure to domain sector experience in Healthcare, Health Services, Human Services / Aged care services is highly desirable.
  • Deep experience influencing and managing stakeholders
  • Proven experience with customer relationship management platforms such as Salesforce/ Salesforce Health Cloud, ServiceNow and Dynamic365.
  • Proven experience with business process automation platforms such as Tungsten TotalAgility, Appian, Salesforce Flow, Signavio, UiPath and PowerAutomate.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure, microservices frameworks, and API-enablement platform such as webMethods.
  • The ability to think strategically and create a vision for the future of enterprise architecture in collaboration with other architects.



Why Join Us?

At Australian Unity, we provide a supportive, flexible and purpose‑driven environment where you can make a meaningful impact.

You will enjoy:

  • Competitive salary + bonus program
  • Additional wellbeing and community leave days
  • 14‑week paid parental leave (equal for all parents)
  • Hybrid working model
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Flare / Maxxia Rewards - discounted retail, travel, entertainment
  • Discounts on Australian Unity products including Health, General Insurance and more
  • Access to LinkedIn Learning and professional development programs


If you're looking to step into a leadership role where you can make a meaningful impact across a purpose‑driven organisation, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and join us in shaping better outcomes for our members and community.

For further benefits visit: https://www.australianunity.com.au/careers/culture

Australian Unity is an Equal Opportunity employer and we encourage applications from all members of the community, including people of Aboriginal and Torres strait Islander descent, culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds and, mature aged people.

title: Senior Front-End Developer
description:
We provide a mobile engagement platform for many of the world’s top app publishers including ESPN, Grindr, and HBO. Our customers rely on us to keep their mobile users happy and engaged. We provide tools to drive great app experiences including push messaging, mobile analytics, predictive analytics, and individualized in-app experiences.
We are seeking a Front End engineer to help develop our web application, which is the customer-facing component of our platform. We'd love working with you if you are passionate about delivering value to the customer as well as excited by the innovative technologies we’re using and developing. You'd work directly on a modern and growing front end stack (ES6, React, Redux, Webpack) on a great team, and contribute to a long history of front end thought leadership and open source contributions. Together, we'll pursue interesting challenges in data visualization, component-based architecture, and front end performance optimization, which will provide you with many opportunities to find creative, blog-worthy solutions.
In this role, you will focus on front end technologies but won't shy away from full-stack work when required to complete end-to-end functionality. We expect you to have advanced knowledge of JavaScript, React, and Redux.

Responsibilities

  • Build React components with ES6
  • Build visualizations with D3.js
  • Help define our front end technology vision
  • Help drive up our JavaScript code coverage
  • Migrate existing code from Angular / Rails to SPA with React / Redux
  • Help design customer solutions including input on UX designs and workflows
  • Collaborate frequently in design reviews, pair programming and code reviews

Requirements

  • Senior or expert level knowledge of many of our front end technologies including: React, Redux, Webpack, HTML and CSS
  • A keen eye for UI and UX
  • Experience with an MVC framework like Rails or Django
  • You gotta love working with people

title: Founding DevOps Engineer
description:
We are the strongest team in an industry where software has been under-appreciated for far too long. Mechanical engineering tools are stuck in the 90s and iteration time is measured in days (sometimes weeks) rather than hours. We have proven to the world that same day hardware development is not only possible but accessible today. Help us fulfill the promise of 3D printing and bring metal-strength manufacturing to the masses.

As our 7th Software Engineer and first DevOps Engineer, you will have tons of project ownership and responsibility. We move at a breakneck pace but refuse to compromise on quality. Your ideas will directly influence the company's future. You will do interdisciplinary work on physical systems and learn from best-of-the-best engineers across MatSci, Mech-E, EE, and Software.

To succeed here, you need to be a quick learner and have a passion for software engineering. You don't need prior experience with 3D printing or our software stack; you can pick up those skills on the job.

You will be building automation, improving monitoring and security, troubleshooting issues, and analyzing performance. You should be comfortable writing code, designing scalable services, and operating a customer-facing web application with high uptime requirements.

What You Will Work On

    • Manage and improve our infrastructure to ensure the uptime and performance of our software platform
    • Work side by side with the rest of the software team to design scalable and supportable services
    • Continually evaluate the security of our systems and applications, with an emphasis on data security
    • Work with other engineers to determine tool requirements, then drive the implementation, documentation, maintenance, and improvement of these tools
    • Build automation for routine, simple, and complex tasks
    • Troubleshoot and resolve active production issues
    • Collaborate with peers and key stakeholders to develop and maintain disaster recovery processes
    • Participate in an on-call rotation
    • Learn, extend, and maintain our build, deploy, config, metrics, and alerting systems

What We Look For

    • 5+ years of operations engineering experience supporting global 24x7x365 web applications
    • Excellent command of at least one programming language (Preference for Javascript/Coffeescript)
    • A strong desire to minimize the operational overhead of systems, large and small
    • Expertise with AWS (EC2, VPC, S3, RDS, ElastiCache, IAM, KMS, etc)
    • Experience with managing applications on Heroku
    • Experience managing several large scale deployments
    • Expertise in troubleshooting complex customer-facing systems
    • Experience supporting CI/CD platforms and related software development tools
    • Working knowledge of Postgres and Redis
    • Comfortable with Linux, security, and networking fundamentals
    • A passion for ownership and technical excellence
    • Strong interpersonal and communication skills
    • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, or equivalent

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:

The infrastructure team is responsible for architecting and developing the base cloud infrastructure layer needed to run our data and application platform. In addition, this team builds internal applications and tools to improve efficiency, automation, and system monitoring for our continuous delivery pipeline. DevOps works closely with the application development engineers to ensure that the end product is a high-performing, highly available, and secure platform that our customers trust.

The opportunity for this engineer is to take their many years of experience and apply that in a way that will define how we think about development operations, deployments, monitoring, and application infrastructure. This individual will help define the roadmap and drive work that will help engineers be more productive, code deployments to be safer, and ultimately drive the strategic success here.


Requirements:
  • Experience with Cloud based infrastructure, ideally Amazon Web Services
  • Software development experience (ability to understand, debug, and patch the applications you support, as well as to write small-to-midsize applications as necessary)

  • Experience with Continuous Integration tools (e.g. Jenkins, Bamboo, Team City)
  • Eagerness to learn about new technologies, incorporate them into our infrastructure if they add value, and scrap them if not
  • A strong understanding of database technologies, especially PostgreSQL
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • 8+ years of experience working in software engineering, with at least 4 years working in development operation type roles

Pluses:

  • Experience with SSO vendors and federated auth solutions (SAML, OAuth, etc)
  • Experience developing continuous deployment pipelines
  • Experience designing highly available and fault tolerant production architectures in the cloud
  • Strong understanding of the Amazon tools

title: Senior Cloud Architect
description:
We are a molecular information company focused on fundamentally changing the way in which patients with cancer are treated. Our products provide more than information. They offer hope to patients, their families and friends, their physicians and caregivers.
We've seen the difference that our technology can make in the lives of patients, but there is still enormous potential to help even more people. In our drive to help transform the way in which patients with cancer are treated, we strive to improve every life we touch through our dedication to innovation, our commitment to people, and our passion for performance.

Responsibilities:

Reporting to the Associate Director of Cloud Platforms, you will be a primary driver for the team in global operational strategies in the cloud while driving our cloud initiative in High Performance Grid Computing and managing a scalable, continuous-integration architecture. Ensuring architectural best practices, such as loose-coupling, security at every layer, and regulatory governance is key. Strategic implementation of local and global solutions, with an eye to scalable, sustainable architecture, will be a core tenant. This role handles complex long-term projects involving multiple disciplines and across many different business units. We have to know you’ve been there and done that so bring your ideas, past and present experiences and high energy to this innovative technology team; help us bring this amazing company and industry through its cloud adoption, and beyond.

Qualifications:

Your Expertise
  • You are someone who has successfully lead a migration of on-premise, cloud, and hybrid systems to AWS.

  • CloudFormation, Terraform; iterative template creation experience
  • Solid exposure to Chef, Puppet, Ansible

title: Senior Web Application Developer
description:

We are the premier global provider of innovative, cost effective, rapid deployment, cyber security testing products. Our products have been incorporated into the cyber-security toolboxes of security service providers, Fortune 500 companies and various federal agencies.

title: Claims Advisor
description:

We’re now welcoming applications for Claims Advisors to join our supportive, purpose‑driven team in Newcastle. Giving you more control over your time and work life balance.

Our deep expertise, purpose‑driven work and development pathways help you build a long‑term career in a field where your skills will always be in demand. EML’s investment in AI-powered technology is designed to reduce admin, giving you more time to focus on making a real difference in people’s lives.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Assist the worker and employer with the claim process and providing support in the completion of relevant documents to ensure timely access to required services to support return to work and injury recovery

  • Pro-actively proceed with appropriate case management to achieve the optimum outcome of early sustainable return to work for workers with reasonable claim costs

  • Ensure that allocated work is actioned within appropriate timeframes

  • Manage telephone enquiries within EML’s guidelines and adhere to the EML’s Communication Policy

  • You will embrace change with confidence and are comfortable with in a multi-system environment whilst having the ability to handle and overcome challenges

We value our people and are committed to supporting our employees by investing in their professional development and providing generous employee benefits. If this position is of interest to you, please apply now.

title: Senior/Principal SW Engineer, Platform

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Our platform runs on .NET microservices behind a Next.js frontend, and we'd like you to own the path between them. Not a slice of it — the whole thing, from the data model up to the button someone clicks, and still yours once it's live.

You'll work closely with our software architects, product owners, and fellow developers: code reviews, pair programming, and the technical decisions that stick around.

  • You own features from the database row to the interface that triggers it. No handover, no waiting for another team to pick up your half.
  • You decide how data moves through the system: schemas in Postgres, caching in Redis where it pays off, messaging over RabbitMQ where services need to stay independent.
  • You build the Next.js frontend on top of the services you wrote — which means you feel every backend decision in the UI, and you design accordingly.
  • You take features to production and keep the CI/CD pipeline fast enough that nobody avoids it.
  • You catch bottlenecks, security risks, and failure modes before users do, on both sides of the stack.
  • You use coding agents as part of your daily workflow — directing their work, reviewing their output, and fixing what doesn't hold up. Writing code matters; knowing what good code looks like matters more.
  • You've spent several years on both sides of the stack — C# and .NET on the backend, React and TypeScript on the frontend.
  • You've built microservice architectures and run Postgres, Redis, and RabbitMQ in production.
  • You're at home in a Next.js codebase with Tailwind, and in the Node.js layer (Express.js, Nest.js) that connects the UI to our services.
  • You know your way around architecture principles, performance optimization, and secure scalability.
  • You work well in agile teams (Scrum/Kanban), you write clearly, and you're comfortable in English and German.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or the experience that makes one unnecessary.
  • You've worked with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. We're not in the cloud yet, so this is a plus, not a requirement.
We care as much about how you approach a problem as about which frameworks you know. You look past the edges of your own ticket: you notice when a fix really belongs in a different service, you question a process once it has stopped making sense, and you judge your work by whether the whole system got better — not by whether your part shipped. "Not my code" isn't a sentence we use much around here. You're joining at a point where the engineering foundations themselves are being rebuilt around AI-native workflows — not retrofitted onto legacy decisions, but designed now, while the architecture is still being shaped. That means you don't inherit someone else's five-year-old choices: you help make the calls on how services are split, where AI agents fit into the workflow, and what "good" looks like technically around here. Few Senior roles hand you this much real influence over the foundation rather than the features on top of it.
On the practical side: 30 days of vacation, up to 50 workation days a year, a sabbatical option, Hansefit, pension contributions and an employee loan program, plus a range of travel-industry discounts on your own trips. Fully remote with no relocation required, a hiring process that's three steps end to end, and no bureaucratic layers slowing down a "yes." We're rated 4.7/5 on Trustpilot — what you build ships to real people, not into the void. We're fully remote, so you work from wherever you do your best thinking. Agentic coding is part of our day-to-day, not a side experiment: we work with Claude Code across the team, and we'd want you to have an opinion about where it helps, where it doesn't, and how to review what it produces. If that's already your workflow, you'll feel at home. If it isn't yet, you'll pick it up here.

Three steps, no surprises:

  1. Online interview with HR
  2. Online interview with our Head of Engineering
  3. On-site interview with the team

Job Title: Pharmacy Technician, Certified

About Hy-Vee

At Hy-Vee, we believe the shortest distance between two people is a smile. We're seeking people with a passion for customer service, a willingness to learn, and a commitment to being part of a team that strives to make our customers' lives easier, healthier and happier.

The Role and Why It's Important

Our Certified Pharmacy Technicians play a critical role in the health and wellbeing of our customers, supporting pharmacists in the preparation and distribution of prescription medications with accuracy, professionalism, and care. In this role, you'll assist with everything from prescription processing and insurance billing to customer service and inventory, all while maintaining the highest standards of confidentiality and compliance.

If you are detail-oriented, passionate about helping people, and ready to grow your pharmacy career, we'd love to have you on our team.

What You'll Do

No two shifts are exactly the same, but here's what you can expect:

  • Provide prompt, friendly customer service by greeting customers with a smile, learning their names, and making every interaction a positive one

  • Handle customer inquiries that do not require a pharmacist's expertise and judgment

  • Accept new written prescription orders and telephoned refill requests at the discretion of the supervising pharmacist

  • Contact doctor's offices to take or request refill prescriptions as needed

  • Gather and maintain accurate patient information required to prepare prescriptions

  • Assist pharmacists in preparing prescription drug products for dispensing

  • Prepare and affix labels to prescription containers and prepare prescriptions to be mailed

  • Prepare and submit insurance claims and assist with third-party insurance billing and troubleshooting

  • File prescriptions after they have been dispensed and report any medication errors to appropriate personnel

  • Order, check in, and stock pharmacy supplies and log invoices as necessary

  • Perform cash transactions accurately

  • Administer vaccines as allowed by law, with required certification where applicable

  • Maintain the cleanliness of the pharmacy and dispensing area

  • Maintain the confidentiality of customers' private medical information in accordance with HIPAA

  • Adhere to all statutes and regulations pertaining to a pharmacy technician

  • Work with co-workers as a team to ensure customer satisfaction and a pleasant work environment

  • Assist in other areas of the store as needed and take on special projects as assigned

  • Maintain strict adherence to personal hygiene, dress standards, and all Hy-Vee policies and store guidelines

  • Report to work when scheduled and on time

Your Skills

To be successful, you'll need to be able to:

  • Apply logical and scientific thinking to solve problems involving both abstract and concrete variables

  • Perform arithmetic, algebraic, and geometric calculations accurately

  • Compose original correspondence, follow technical manuals, and evaluate technical data

  • Counsel and advise customers and interact professionally with patients, healthcare providers, and team members

  • Maintain a high level of discretion and integrity when handling confidential patient information

Reporting Relationships

Accountable and Reports to: Store Director; Store Manager; Assistant Managers of Health Wellness Home, Store Operations, and Perishables; Pharmacy Department Manager; Staff Pharmacists

Education and Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent required

  • Certified as a licensed technician through a certified national program required; must maintain continuing education requirements to keep license active

  • Previous experience as a pharmacy technician or pharmacy clerk preferred

  • Vaccination certification required if administering vaccines, as required by law

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to frequently stand and walk throughout a shift in the pharmacy and dispensing area, including extended periods at a pharmacy counter or workstation while filling and processing prescriptions

  • Ability to count, pour, package, and label medications, and fill prescriptions under pharmacist supervision, in accordance with state and federal pharmacy regulations

  • Exposure to bloodborne pathogens and sharps (needles, lancets) associated with pharmacy operations and, where certified, immunization administration

  • Ability to perform repetitive standing, walking, reaching, and bending associated with order fulfillment, POS transactions, and cleaning/sanitation duties

Working Environment

This is a fast-paced role in a retail pharmacy where you will handle multiple tasks throughout your shift including filling prescriptions, answering the telephone, and assisting customers. There is occasional exposure to hazardous chemicals or solvents during compounding, including chemotherapy drugs. This pharmacy handles and prepares hazardous drugs; personnel of reproductive capability should be aware that exposure may cause acute and chronic effects, and that following all pharmacy policies and procedures is essential to minimizing risk. Safety is always a priority, and training is provided to help ensure a safe and supportive work environment.

Are you ready to smile, apply today.

Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a pre employment drug screen.

title: Lead AI & Microservices Engineer
description:

Lead AI & Microservices Engineer/Architect

Help establish the foundations for enterprise microservices, event-driven architecture and AI-enabled engineering across a major Australian Government environment.

This is a newly created EL2-equivalent technical leadership role for an experienced architect who still enjoys being close to the engineering.
Rather than operating purely at an architecture or governance level, you will have the opportunity to set technical direction, establish reusable patterns, validate approaches and influence how modern engineering and AI capabilities are implemented in production.

The opportunity
Working within a Federal Government technology environment, you will provide technical leadership and architectural authority across a major business application transformation program.
The program is establishing enterprise microservices and event-driven architecture capabilities while embedding AI-enabled engineering practices across the software development lifecycle.
You will work across architecture, engineering, platform and delivery teams to establish scalable technical patterns, improve engineering practices and ensure capability is successfully transferred into internal teams.
This is not simply an advisory architecture position. You will remain sufficiently hands-on to develop and validate priority solutions, demonstrate good engineering practice and help teams successfully operationalise new capabilities.

  • Lead the design, governance and evolution of cloud-native, microservices and event-driven architectures
  • Establish reusable architecture and engineering patterns for enterprise applications
  • Lead adoption of GenAI, Large Language Models and AI-enabled software engineering
  • Support implementation of semantic search, RAG and selected machine learning capabilities
  • Establish practical DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing and observability practices
  • Guide containerisation and platform engineering approaches
  • Influence system design and major engineering decisions
  • Improve platform scalability, resilience, security and maintainability
  • Provide technical leadership across multidisciplinary engineering teams and delivery partners
  • Establish responsible AI, human oversight, security and operational controls
  • Support knowledge transfer and uplift the technical capability of internal teams
  • Remain hands-on where required to prototype, validate and develop priority enhancements
Technology environment
The environment is primarily based around the Microsoft Azure ecosystem, including technologies and patterns such as:
  • Microsoft Azure
  • .NET
  • Microservices architecture
  • Event-driven architecture
  • Azure Service Bus and Event Hubs
  • Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
  • Azure SQL
  • API Management and OpenAPI
  • CI/CD and DevSecOps
  • Azure Monitor
  • OpenTelemetry
  • Microsoft AI services
  • GenAI / LLMs
  • Semantic search and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • Dynamics 365 and Dataverse
What we’re looking for
We are particularly interested in senior technical professionals who have successfully led modernisation within large, complex enterprise environments.
You will bring:
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing cloud-native microservices and event-driven architectures
  • Strong enterprise architecture and solution design capability
  • Demonstrated experience delivering or operationalising enterprise AI solutions
  • Knowledge of GenAI, LLMs, semantic search and RAG
  • Strong software and platform engineering fundamentals
  • Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing and observability
  • Experience designing or operating Kubernetes/container environments
  • Strong Azure architecture and engineering experience
  • The ability to move comfortably between architecture strategy and hands-on technical delivery
  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders, architects, engineers and delivery partners
  • Strong technical leadership and mentoring capability
Experience establishing engineering standards, platform engineering practices, SRE capabilities or enterprise-scale automation would be highly regarded.
Location and working arrangementsThe role is offered under hybrid working arrangements.

While Canberra is the Department's primary location, suitable candidates may be able to work primarily from another Departmental location, including major capital city offices, subject to operational requirements.
Interstate candidates should be prepared for occasional travel to Canberra for key workshops, delivery activities and stakeholder engagement.

Security requirements
Applicants must be Australian Citizens and able to obtain an Australian Government Baseline security clearance.
Candidates who do not currently hold a Baseline clearance may still be considered, with clearance sponsorship available for the successful applicant.

Contract
  • Rate: $130–$140 per hour, depending on experience
  • Initial term: 12 months
  • Extensions: Up to 2 x 12 months
  • Location: Canberra / other Departmental locations nationally
  • Working arrangement: Hybrid
  • Clearance: Baseline – ability to obtain
Apply
This is a strong opportunity for a senior architect or technical lead who wants more than a governance-only role and enjoys shaping architecture while remaining connected to engineering delivery.
To be considered, please submit your CV outlining your experience across Azure, microservices, event-driven architecture, enterprise AI and modern software engineering practices.

title: SSA elever til decemeber 2026 MERIT
description:
✨Omsorg med hjertet – karriere med perspektiv

Vi søger talentfulde og uddannelsesparate elever til en spændende SOSU-uddannelse, med løn under uddannelse og oplæringsplads. OPSTART den 21. december 2026

✨ SSA‑uddannelsen er for dig, der vil være med til at forme fremtidens omsorg og skabe nye muligheder for mennesker i alle livets faser. Du bliver en central drivkraft i det sammenhængende borger- og patientforløb, hvor du med stærke faglige kompetencer og et skarpt klinisk blik er med til at sikre kvalitet, værdighed og helhed i plejen.

Du lærer ikke blot at yde støtte, omsorg og professionel pleje – du lærer at se mennesket bag behovet og skabe tryghed, nærvær og udvikling i deres hverdag. Som SSA bliver du en nøgleperson i et sundhedsvæsen i forandring, hvor du bidrager til at bygge bro mellem fagligheder, styrke sammenhængen i forløb og skabe løsninger, der gør en reel forskel for både borgere, pårørende og samfundet.

Det er en uddannelse for dig, der vil være med til at løfte omsorg til et nyt niveau og være en del af en profession, der former fremtiden – menneske for menneske.

Vi tilbyder

  • Der er garanti for oplæringsplads under hele uddannelsen (dette skal du ikke selv søge).
  • Fokus på trivsel under uddannelse og læringsmiljø
  • At du bliver tilknyttet en daglig vejleder når du er i oplæring. Den daglige vejleder, vil følge dig i dit daglige arbejde når du er i oplæring.
  • At du ligeledes tilknyttes en uddannelsesansvarlig, som du samarbejder med gennem dit uddannelsesforløb. Den uddannelsesansvarlige, vil koordinere dit forløb når du er oplæring, samt møde dig til individuelle vejledningssamtaler.
  • Faglig og personlig udvikling gennem uddannelsen

Vi forventer:

SOSU-uddannelsen er både spændende og krævende – både teoretisk og praksis.
Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er klar til at lære og tager din uddannelse seriøst, både i skolen og i oplæring.
Vi forventer, at du har de personlige og sociale kompetencer, der skal til for at arbejde med mennesker – især inden for sundhed og omsorg.

Det er ikke krav for optagelse at du har fx kørekort eller bil, men det er en forudsætning at du kan transportere dig på anden vis, når du er i oplæring eller skal til og fra skole/oplæring.

At du er indforstået med at møde i oplæring kl. 7.00 i oplæringsperioden, herunder også i weekenden. Du kan forvente at skulle arbejde i weekender jævnfør FOA´s overenskomst for elever.

Derudover skal du naturligvis:

  • Være interesseret i at arbejde med mennesker og lære nyt.
  • Have gode samarbejdsevner, da du vil møde mange forskellige mennesker igennem din uddannelse.
  • Være fleksibel og mødestabil,
  • Være fysisk og psykisk robust

Optagelseskrav:

  • Bestået SSH-uddannelse (medsend dokumentation)
  • At du er i besiddelse af en gyldig arbejds- og opholdstilladelse, hvis du ikke er dansk statsborger (medsend dokumentation)
  • En tilfredsstillende straffeattest, som indhentes i forbindelse med en eventuel ansættelse.

Ansøgningsprocedure

Du har mulighed for at sende en skriftlig ansøgning eller ansøge ved at sende en kort video, hvor du kort beskriver:

  • Hvad er årsagen til, at du søger stillingen som SOSU-elev i Guldborgsund kommune
  • Hvor ser du selv dine styrker og svagheder?
  • Hvad er godt samarbejde for dig?
  • Hvordan lærer du bedst?
  • Hvad kan vi forvente af dig som evt. kommende SOSU-elev

Derudover skal du vedhæfte et CV, hvor vi beder dig beskrive din uddannelsesbaggrund, tidligere arbejdserfaring, fritidsinteresser og lignende.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Løn
Du bliver ansat på 37 timer pr. uge, og du vil få elevløn gennem hele uddannelsen i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem KL og FOA – Fag og Arbejde.

Som udgangspunkt aflønnes du med ordinær elevløn. Er du 25 år eller derover, lønnes du som voksenelev i Guldborgsund Kommune.
Uddannelsen veksler mellem oplæring og skole. Guldborgsund Kommune samarbejder og udveksler relevant information med SOSU-skolen Nykøbing F.

Mere information

Du er velkommen til at kontakte uddannelsesteamet på tlf.: 5473 2189 mellem kl. 09.00-12.00. Ydermere kan du via vores hjemmeside under kontakt, finde kontaktinformation under SOSU-elevadministrationen, hvorfra du kan sende sikker mail.


Hvis du skulle modtage et afslag på din ansøgning om elevstilling, er Guldborgsund Kommune forpligtet til at registrere afslaget – herunder også dit cpr-nummer. Oplysningerne registreres på Praktikpladsen.dk og overføres til Datavarehuset i Styrelsen for It og Læring. Oplysningerne indsamles udelukkende til statistiske formål. De registrerede oplysninger er ikke synlige for dig eller offentligheden. Indsamlingen af disse data sker med hjemmel i §58 i Bekendtgørelse om Erhvervsuddannelser.

Ansøgningsfrist

Den 4. oktober 2026

Samtaler

Vi forventer at holde i uge: 43

Mere om Guldborgsund Kommune

Læs mere om Guldborgsund Kommune på www.guldborgsund.dk.

title: 3760 Capping Past Controller (Day Shift) DC
description:
Summary

Mt. Olive Pickle Company is seeking qualified and experienced candidate for a Day Shift Capping Pasteruizer Controller role. Operates and monitors pasteurizer functions to properly pasteurize each product according to established Company Standards.


Work Schedule: Monday - Saturday (during peak season), 7:30 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. **schedule may vary based on the needs of the department

Duties and Responsibilities

Essential Functions

Operates switch box controls to start pasteurizer. Turns on water to pasteurizer, adjusts water to troughs and operates temperature controls to set temperature according to Company specifications for size and item run.

Opens valves to allow steam into pasteurizer. Adjusts pasteurizer belts according to size and item run. Verifies the belt speed with a ruler at the beginning of the shift. Must clean all screens in holding tanks through-out the shift to ensure proper water flow and damage doesn’t occur to pumps.

Every 45 minutes checks the following and records -

  • the temperature of thermometers on each section of the pasteurizer,
  • two temperature readings (highest and lowest) of 2 sample jars from sections 4 -7 and the vacuum, pressure and volume of each jar

Monitors the HACCP and Quality critical limit for time and temperature every 45 minutes throughout the shift.

At the beginning of each shift

  • obtains calibrated thermometer from QC
  • checks all vacuum and pressure gauges for accuracy and adjusts or replaces as needed.
  • Clean the screens in each holding tank

Checks all regulating equipment and notifies supervisor if needed.

Adjusts cold water volume to get the maximum cooling with a minimum water usage for each product run. No more than 50 gpm. Checks and records every 45 minutes.

Records information on broken jars and jars returned to pasteurizer or capper.

May be assigned to control one or two pasteurizers, which may or may not be side by side.

Another operator who is trained in monitoring HACCP and Quality critical limits must cover this job in the absence of the Pasteurizer Controller.

Keeps work space clean and tidy.

Follows safety rules and company policies.

Other duties

Performs duties of Unscrambler if needed.

Participates in training, employee meetings, committees, project teams, etc. as appropriate.

Receives written instructions from packing schedule or verbal instructions from supervisor on above tasks and performs other work as directed by supervisor.

This is a broad new-graduate engineering role for someone with strong fundamentals and the curiosity to work across machine learning, geometry, graphics, data systems, evaluation, and internal tooling. You will begin with well-scoped projects, learn the full system, and take on more ownership as you demonstrate strength. No CAD or manufacturing background is required.

• Build and maintain geometry and data pipelines that parse CAD, convert formats, extract features, and verify output quality.

• Write evaluation harnesses and tooling that help the team determine whether model performance has improved.

• Support machine learning training and experiment runs, instrument systems, debug failures, and present results clearly.

• Build internal tools that remove friction for researchers and engineers.

• Work across the stack and develop depth in the areas where you have the greatest impact.

• Own challenging technical problems in close collaboration with a small, experienced team.

Requirements

What we're looking for

• Zero to two years of software engineering experience, including internships or research.

• A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, physics, or a closely related field from a rigorous program.

• Hands-on experience with machine learning training, data pipelines, internal tooling, or adjacent technical work.

• Strong programming ability in Python and/or C or C++.

• Evidence of high performance through internships, research, ambitious technical projects, or work in a demanding engineering environment.

• A generalist mindset, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to begin broadly before specializing.

• A track record of finishing difficult work and taking initiative without waiting for detailed instructions.

Bonus points

• Exposure to CAD, computational geometry, robotics, perception, graphics, game development, or related coursework and projects.

• Experience building evaluation systems or supporting model training infrastructure.

• Research or internship experience at a high-bar technology company or laboratory.

Benefits

Compensation and benefits

• $150K-$220K base salary.

• Total compensation around $300K, including bonus.

• Competitive equity and benefits.

• Visa sponsorship and transfers may be available, including F-1 OPT, H-1B transfers, new H-1B sponsorship, and TN visas.

Location and work model

This is a full-time role based in San Francisco, California. The team works together in the office five days per week, and candidates must be able to work on-site or relocate before starting.

description:

title: Leasing Consultant
description:
Fort Collins, CO · $17-$19/hour + commissions · 5 days a week including Saturday 9a-6pm

Final compensation is based on experience, skills, and qualifications.


You're the first face people see when they picture living here.

You make a great first impression and back it up with follow-through. You can read what a prospect is really looking for, show them how this community fits their life, and close with care, not pressure. You take pride in a full house and residents who are glad they chose you. If that sounds like you, we want to meet you.


At Roundhouse, our mission is simple and serious: putting humanity into housing. Since 2008 we have grown into a developer and manager of diverse real estate across four states, with more than 10,000 multifamily units and over $2B in assets under management. We got here by challenging the status quo, building communities people are proud to call home, and hiring people who genuinely care about the resident experience.

As a Leasing Consultant, you manage the leasing process from first hello to signed lease, and you help keep current residents happy enough to stay.


Our culture

Our culture is what makes Roundhouse unique, and it shows up in how the whole team works:


One Team: We put people first, work with humility, and celebrate wins together.

Self-Starter: We take initiative, own outcomes, and push ideas forward with energy and purpose.

Forward Thinker: We stay curious, embrace change, and explore better ways to serve our residents and partners.

Commitment to Excellence: We set high standards, double-check details, and take pride in doing the work right.


What you'll own

You are the front line of the community and the engine behind occupancy. That means you:

  • Welcome prospects, answer their questions, and verify eligibility as their first point of contact.
  • Build strong resident relations by addressing concerns, ensuring satisfaction, and driving retention.
  • Walk the community daily to keep tour paths, models, amenities, and common areas sharp.
  • Prepare and process notices to vacate, renewals, service requests, applications, move-ins and outs, transfers, and roommate changes.
  • Hit community goals for occupancy, renewals, and turn times, with at least a 35% rental closing ratio.
  • Manage resident communication channels and keep accurate CRM records.
  • Track local market trends, complete monthly market surveys, and recommend competitive pricing to the Community Manager.
  • Support marketing initiatives and flag local opportunities to management.
  • Help plan and host resident events and activities.
  • Keep resident and vendor files accurate and organized.
  • Follow all safety procedures in the Employee Handbook, SOPs, and on-equipment labels.
  • Ensure compliance with Fair Housing, safety procedures, and company policy, and represent Roundhouse positively in every interaction.

You take initiative, own your numbers, and make people feel at home from the first tour.


What you bring

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Leasing experience preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and Outlook.
  • Strong sales and customer-service skills.
  • A strong desire to lead, both in your role and in your local community.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally between properties as needed.


A leg up if you have:

  • At least two years of sales experience.
  • At least one year onsite in multifamily housing.
  • Experience with Yardi Voyager, RentCafe, AIRM, LEO, Appwork, or similar CRM tools.
  • Spanish fluency.

What's in it for you

This is full-time work with pay, benefits, and perks built around your well-being, your growth, and your sense of community.

Health and wellness

  • Dental and vision coverage
  • Mental wellness program

  • Employee housing discount
  • Cell phone stipend
  • Alternative transportation allowance
  • Monthly coffee coupon
  • Perks at Work program

Recognition and growth

  • Peer recognition program
  • Years of service awards
  • Infinite Possibilities program

Ready to fill a community you're proud of?

If you want to make a real impact, build relationships that last, and join a team that looks out for each other, we want to hear from you.

Roundhouse is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

쿠팡이츠 Visual Design 팀은 소비자, 배달파트너, 매장, 광고 비즈니스, 퀵커머스 등 다양한 제품과 비즈니스 영역 전반에서 시각적으로 일관된 고객 경험을 설계합니다.

시각적으로 일관된 고객 경험은 단순히 아름다운 화면이 아니라, 고객이 더 쉽고 빠르게 이해하고 행동할 수 있도록 도움으로써 제품의 신뢰를 높입니다.

Staff Product Visual Designer는 뛰어난 비주얼 디자인 역량을 바탕으로 기능이나 프로젝트를 넘어, 제품 전반에 걸친 시각적 경험을 발전시키며, 나아가 조직 전체의 비주얼 퀄리티를 지속적으로 높이는 역할을 합니다.

AI가 디자인 생산성을 빠르게 향상시키고 있지만, 문제를 정의하고 고객과 비즈니스의 목표를 이해한 뒤 적절한 해결 방법을 판단하는 일은 여전히 디자이너의 역할입니다. 우리 팀에서는 새로운 도구를 적극 활용하면서도 탁월한 디자인 판단으로 쿠팡이츠의 시각적으로 일관된 고객 경험(Visual Customer Experience)을 리드할 디자이너를 찾고 있습니다.

주요 업무

  • 쿠팡이츠 및 글로벌 제품에서 시각적 원칙과 다양한 디자인 접근을 활용해 고객이 더 쉽고 빠르게 이해하고 행동할 수 있는 시각적 경험을 구현합니다.
  • 고객과 비즈니스 목표에 대한 깊은 이해를 바탕으로 가장 효과적인 시각적 솔루션을 제시합니다.
  • 비주얼 디자인 원칙, 에셋, 가이드라인을 구축해 제품, 브랜드, 비즈니스 전반에서 일관된 비주얼 디자인 시스템을 만듭니다.
  • Product Designer, Product Manager, Engineer, Marketing, Business Strategy 등 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하며 복잡한 프로젝트를 운영 관리하고, 디자인 방향성과 의사결정을 리드합니다.
  • 명확한 디자인 원칙을 통해 조직 전체의 비주얼 디자인 수준을 지속적으로 높입니다.
  • AI 기반 디자인 워크플로우와 새로운 디자인 도구를 적극 활용하여 반복적인 작업을 줄이고, 더 높은 수준의 문제 해결에 집중합니다.
  • 디자인 리뷰, 멘토링, 프로젝트 리딩 등을 통해 다른 디자이너의 성장을 지원합니다.

자격 요건

  • 커뮤니케이션 디자인, 그래픽 디자인, 관련 디자인 분야 학사 학위 또는 이와 동등한 경험
  • 8년 이상의 Product Visual Design 경력 또는 이에 준하는 경험을 보유한 분.
  • 모바일 및 웹 기반 디지털 제품에서 비즈니스 맥락을 고려한 시각 경험을 설계할 수 있는 분.
  • Typography, Color, Illustration, Layout, Iconography, Motion 등의 스킬셋을 활용해 가장 적절한 디자인 솔루션을 도출하고 실행할 수 있는 분.
  • 비주얼 가이드라인, 디자인 시스템을 정의하거나 발전시킨 경험이 있는 분.
  • 다양한 이해관계자를 설득하며 제품의 디자인 방향성을 이끌어본 경험이 있는 분.
  • 제한된 시간과 자원 안에서 우선순위를 판단하고 임팩트를 만들 수 있는 분.
  • 에디토리얼, 인쇄물, 프로모션 자산 등 다양한 매체의 경험을 디지털 제품 및 브랜드 경험과 연결해본 경험이 있는 분.
  • Figma, Adobe tools, AI 기반 디자인 도구 등 다양한 툴의 활용해 퀄리티 높은 비주얼 디자인 결과물을 만들어낼 수 있는 분.
  • 문제 정의부터 디자인 원칙, 실행 과정, 협업 방식, 비즈니스 임팩트까지 설명 가능한 포트폴리오를 보유한 분.
  • 한 명 이상의 디자이너를 이끌며 프로젝트를 주도적으로 리드한 경험이 있으며, 디자인 리뷰, 멘토링 등을 통해 다른 디자이너의 성장을 지원한 경험이 있는 분.

우대 사항

  • 커머스, 배달 서비스 등 디지털 제품 경험 및 제품의 글로벌 확장 경험.
  • 모션 그래픽 혹은 3D 디자인(Cinema4d) 작업 능력.
  • AI 기반 디자인 워크플로우를 활용해 디자인 생산성과 품질을 향상시킨 경험.
  • UX, 디자인 시스템, 브랜드 디자인간의 상호 연관성에 대한 이해.
  • 급변하는 환경에서 적극적이고 독립적으로 일할 수 있는 능력.
  • 전문성을 기반으로 새로운 영역을 개척하고 조직의 디자인 역량을 확장한 경험.
  • 영어 또는 일본어 의사 소통 능력. (필수 아님)

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 1차 면접 - 2차 면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

title: SENIOR FULLSTACK SOFTWARE DEVELOPER
description:
We are looking for a Senior FullStack Software Developer to join us working on a suite of products that powers content marketing for B2B companies ranging from small start­ups to multi­national companies on the Fortune 500 list

Why Work Here?

● Deep technical challenges on a daily basis as well as a meaningful role in product development. At the moment our team is working on building a web crawling architecture that can crawl 10,000,000+ articles a day and make them fully searchable in real time. There is some serious engineering behind making all of that work and we want to find people that love tackling hard problems like this head on.

● A very strong team of developers that are focused on helping each other to improve as engineers every day. We write automated tests as part of our development workflow, practice pair programming, perform peer code reviews, and share knowledge in weekly tech talks.

● Room for growth, we're still a relatively small team but looking to grow significantly this year. We have a huge vision and we’re just at the beginning of an immense growth curve in an industry that is exploding.

● All the tools you need to succeed, chose your own computer and gear.

● Focused startup environment that truly values work/life balance. We have an amazing office overlooking the Boston Common with a kitchen full of snacks and weekly catered lunches.

● Top market salary, equity package, 401k plan, Medical with 100% deductible reimbursement, dental and vision insurance and gym membership reimbursement.

Our ideal candidate:

● Has 4+ years of experience working on teams that develop scalable web applications.
● Is comfortable working up and down the technology stack.
● Feels that testing is a core part of their development process, experience in TDD is a plus.
● Enjoys pair programming, reviewing code and mentoring other developers.

There is always a new and challenging problem to solve. One day you might be pairing with another developer on a new API for our web application, the next you could be developing predictive models to determine how many social shares certain articles will receive and the next you could be reviewing and refactoring code that is responsible for crawling millions of articles per day. We love people that thrive on solving tough problems with clean, well­ tested and scalable code

title: Communication Officer - Sheriff - POLE II
description:
To perform this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed in this document are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Incumbent serves as Communication Officer in the E-911 Department, responsible for receiving emergency and non-emergency calls and taking appropriate action, including dispatching information to various response units.


DUTIES:


  • Receives emergency calls, gathers maximum amount of information in minimum amount of time, determines appropriate response, and dispatches Department officers and other emergency personnel, such as Indiana State Police, Emergency Medical Services, and Fire.
  • Receives non-emergency calls, determines nature of call, responds to inquiries, routes caller to appropriate person, takes messages, or dispatches personnel, such as County and State Highway, Animal Control and Conservation Officers, wreckers, Coroner and Child Protective Services.
  • Monitors radio frequency activities of various other law enforcement and public safety agencies within the county and surrounding counties and notifies and/or dispatches local emergency personnel as situations demand. Regularly communicates with field units, assessing unit safety and need for backup, dispatching backup units and other emergency personnel as necessary.
  • Receives teletypes pertaining to, but not limited to, criminal histories, driver's licenses, vehicle registrations, gun permits, runaways, missing persons, and stolen property.
  • Maintains accurate records/logs of all complaints, restraining and protective orders, and warrants served and recalled. Maintains complete and accurate log of all radio traffic calls, assigns unit(s), follows up on disposition of call, and enters information on log sheet.
  • Answers alarms and dispatches police officers for local businesses and residences.
  • May clock jail personnel in/out, and periodically assist with jail operations in absence of Jail Officers and/or Matron, such as monitoring security cameras, operating control board, communicating with inmates and booking female detainees.
  • Periodically attends prescribed training programs as required. Dispatch’s notices regarding Fire and EMS training and meetings.
  • Performs related duties as assigned.

Every effort has been made to identify the essential functions of this position. However, it in no way states or implies that these are the only duties you will be required to perform. By balancing hands-on engineering with architectural thinking, you will transform recurring incidents into lasting improvements and establish your credibility through faster response times and stable, supportable systems.   • Professional experience in designing and implementing technical improvements, such as platform upgrades or workflow integrations, rather than performing only standard maintenance.
  • Ability to work from the Massachusetts office at least three days per week and participate in an on-call rotation for scheduled maintenance and incident response.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting technically demanding environments such as engineering, lab, test, manufacturing, or supply chain.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code technologies (e.g., Ansible, Terraform) and public/hybrid-cloud platforms.

  • Exposure to AI-enabled tools, operational dashboards, observability platforms, or disaster recovery planning.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Specialist Landcommissie
description: Onder het motto 'Samen versterken we de open ruimte' maakt de Vlaamse Landmaatschappij (VLM) werk van een milieu- en natuurvriendelijke landbouw, een klimaatrobuuste open ruimte en een vitaal platteland. Daarvoor verbinden we landbouw- en milieudoelen, investeren we in complexe openruimtedossiers en faciliteren we samenwerkingsverbanden. Zo bieden we een antwoord op maatschappelijke uitdagingen zoals de klimaatverandering, de achteruitgang van de bodem- en waterkwaliteit, de afname van de biodiversiteit en de leefbaarheid op het platteland. Samen met lokale en bovenlokale belanghebbenden geven we het openruimtebeleid, het plattelandsbeleid en het mestbeleid vorm en voeren we het uit op het terrein. Zo dragen we samen met onze partners bij aan de realisatie van de Europese en Vlaamse natuur-, plattelands- en milieudoelen. Binnen de VLM vormt de werking van de dienst landcommissies en geodata een belangrijke rol in de ondersteuning van de landcommissies en werk je op het kruispunt van ruimtelijke ordening, waardebepaling, landbouw en beleid. Je ondersteunt secretarissen, experten waardebepaling en dossierbehandelaars bij de uitvoering van opdrachten binnen het flankerend beleid PAS en het Instrumentendecreet. Als specialist zorg je voor de inhoudelijke voorbereiding van dossiers voor de secretaris van de landcommissie. Je analyseert complexe vraagstukken, verzamelt relevante informatie en zorgt ervoor dat dossiers zorgvuldig en conform de geldende regelgeving worden voorbereid. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met verschillende experten binnen de VLM en draag je bij aan een kwaliteitsvolle en consistente werking van de landcommissies. Daarnaast ondersteun je schatters bij waarderingsmethodieken en de toepassing ervan binnen het flankerend beleid PAS. Je helpt bij de vertaling van beleidsmaatregelen naar de dagelijkse werking van de landcommissies en werkt mee aan de ontwikkeling en afwerking van inrichtingsnota's, oproepen en andere operationele instrumenten. Dankzij jouw expertise kunnen beleidsbeslissingen op een correcte en onderbouwde manier worden uitgevoerd. Een belangrijk onderdeel van de functie bestaat uit het analyseren van ruimtelijke en economische gegevens. Je verdiept je in bestemmingen op gewestplannen, RUP's en BPA's en onderzoekt de impact van beleidsinstrumenten zoals planbatenheffingen en planschadevergoedingen. Ook de analyse van ruimtelijke structuurplannen, bouwprogramma's en socio-economische ontwikkelingen behoort tot jouw takenpakket. Op basis van deze inzichten formuleer je onderbouwde adviezen en ondersteun je collega's bij de behandeling van dossiers. Deze rol als specialist landbouwcommissie biedt een boeiende mix van analyse, beleidsvoorbereiding en samenwerking. Je werkt mee aan actuele maatschappelijke thema's en krijgt de kans om jouw expertise verder uit te bouwen binnen een organisatie die volop inzet op een duurzame en kwaliteitsvolle open ruimte. Deze rol vraagt een sterk analytisch vermogen, interesse in ruimtelijke en maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen en de capaciteit om complexe informatie helder te verwerken. Tegelijk werk je graag samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en draag je met jouw expertise bij aan oplossingen voor actuele uitdagingen binnen de Vlaamse open ruimte. Lees meer over de job en het selectieproces in het selectiereglement als bijlage bij ‘meer informatie’. Download dit document en hou het bij.

Why we think you’ll love it here

title: Data Scientist- Artificial Intelligence Platform
description:
We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic data scientist for our novel general-purpose AI platform. Our platform is a recommendation and decision engine that builds learning knowledge graphs across a variety of information classes and customer verticals. The platform ingests and organizes data into networks involving data, people, objects and actions. The platform learns, optimizes, and provides a real-time interaction system for querying recommendations and relations, along with dynamic analytics about uncovered connections. Top companies use the platform across the enterprise from direct customer product and offer recommendations to back-end corporate decision support needs.

Many of us come from scientific backgrounds and seek a counterpart in a data scientist who will be actively supported in helping to organize and apply best practices to our data, seeking patterns and insights. You must have a strong analytical background and solid experience with hypothesis formation, evaluation through multi-dimensional data analysis, and communication of results in a visually exciting manner. You will produce analyses and solutions to complement our recommendation engine, for example:
  • show key business results that demonstrates the benefits of our technology as being used by our current and future customers in diverse and interesting verticals
  • generate dashboards on platform efficacy
  • distill results to guide further algorithm development
  • discover patterns in the data and consequent networks that indicate where our platform is uncovering signal vs. noise
  • determine proper testing for customer problems and lead the results analysis
  • collaborate across the team to create infographics and analyses in support of PR and thought leadership efforts
Our culture:
  • We are a small, close, highly technical team. You need to be self-motivated and self-managed.
  • Our customers are top global companies. You need to have the skills required to analyze results and present them professionally to customer teams and high-level executives.
  • This is an intelligence platform, and you’ve got to be smarter than it. Problem solving skills are a must. A mathematical background is an asset in the types of conceptual challenges that we routinely face.
  • This is a highly technical team. Everyone keeps up with and teaches one another. We communicate in code and prose; you should too.
  • While many skills are transferable, the ability to find and invent creative approaches must be in your toolset.

REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field with effective programming experience
  • 2-5 years analytical training through an academic background and/or industry experience
  • Experience in data visualization a plus; experience using data to tell a story a must
You:
  • Have a passion for deciphering large data sets to find patterns in the past to help respond to the future
  • Have experience in data science, statistical analysis, data mining, and predictive algorithms
  • Understand and consider sacred data security and privacy restrictions for working with partner data
  • Crave business questions to answer with data and can define a plan for collecting, aggregating, and analyzing data to given insights and answers
  • Interpret large data sets and can derive business insight in a visual display to describe results
  • Can build visual dashboards to display key business requirements/analytics
  • Take pleasure in knowing people are using and responding to your work
  • Enjoy a focused and dynamic work environment with other bright, friendly people
Other Skills:
  • Experience translating business questions into clear, conclusive reports and visualizations
  • Experience with data analysis tools such as Splunk, Tableau, etc.
  • Experience with databases such as MySQL
  • Versatility in analysis environments such as Python (NumPy, SciPy), R, Matlab, etc.
  • Experience in Agile software development
  • Organized and positive

BENEFITS

About Us:
We are a fast growing artificial intelligence company, developing “synaptic intelligence” for connecting data to decisions. We have built and continue to refine a novel, general purpose pipeline for connecting dynamic neural networks to significant business problems. We have established customers in some of the world’s largest companies, across multiple interesting verticals such as health, finance, travel and entertainment, e-commerce, and government. For these customers, we automatically organize data for general recommendations (i.e., “Pandora for many categories”) and decisions (e.g. Siri, Watson, Echo). With an MIT heritage, we have a great Cambridge office right in the heart of Kendall Square. We are cultivating a great team of optimistic and productive people to develop a new framework for organizing knowledge and help make smarter decisions.
What We Offer:
  • Purpose – building a new AI technology that advances the art and makes peoples’ lives better through more informed decisions for society and better recommendations.
  • $$$ – a salary that is geared to retaining top talent like you, with comprehensive benefits, in a stable startup
  • Stock – incentive stock options in a company poised for near-term growth
  • Location – located in the historic Athenaeum building, near new restaurants and shopping, and right off of the red and green T lines
  • Perks – friendly team, gourmet coffee, snacks, gym membership reimbursement / health credit, weekly yoga and spin classes, great health and dental insurance plan
  • Efficiency - quiet work environment with the best tools
  • Autonomy – we are a small team that uses architectural design to accomplish a great deal, and thrives with people who take initiative and try new routes to solve problems
  • Stimulation – work that is intellectually challenging and fascinating, and topical to where the world is heading
  • Happiness – great colleagues and a vibrant culture
What We Are Doing:
  • We are contributing to a new form of artificial intelligence to find commonalities and connections in data for the purpose of recommendations across general categories of knowledge
  • We are inspired by the latest neuroscience research to support our quest to pull out the signal from the noise in big data
  • We are creating new types of dynamic interfaces and APIs to make this easy to use for solving real business problems
  • We are guided by a keen focus on data analytics that drives business decisions for our customers and ourselves.

title: Sr. Software Engineer – Backend Engineering (Core) / Integrations
description:
OVERVIEW

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Software Engineer (Backend / Integrations) to join a contractor program supporting a critical customer engagement: a state government professional licensing and regulatory compliance platform built on Google Cloud. This role is ideal for a senior backend engineer with deep Java experience who builds event-driven microservices and has integrated with external systems over REST, SOAP, and SFTP. • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Java 21 and Spring Boot 3.x microservice development

• PostgreSQL, including schema design, indexing, and versioned migrations

• GCP serverless services: Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Cloud Workflows, Cloud Scheduler

• Event-driven architecture and messaging patterns (idempotency, retries, dead-letter handling)

• External system integration over REST, SOAP, SFTP, and webhooks

• API security with OAuth 2.0 / OIDC and JWT

• Automated testing (JUnit, integration tests) and CI/CD

USEFUL QUALIFICATIONS

• Workflow engines (Flowable, BPMN) and business rules engines

• AlloyDB, BigQuery

• Payment processing integrations

• Experience in government or regulated environments (FIPS, CJIS, HIPAA)

• Google Cloud Professional certifications

SCOPE AND SOLUTION EXPECTATIONS

Below covers the scope of work we anticipate the contractor supporting throughout the project timeline.

• Design and implement Java 21 / Spring Boot microservices on Cloud Run (licensing, case management, payments, documents, notifications)

• Implement PostgreSQL (AlloyDB) persistence, including row-level data isolation and search indexing

• Build asynchronous event flows on Pub/Sub and Eventarc

• Implement scheduled and timer-driven processing with Cloud Tasks and Cloud Scheduler (renewal reminders, expiration sweeps, reconciliation)

• Author Cloud Workflows orchestrations for multi-service pipelines

• Build integrations with external state and federal systems over REST, SOAP, SFTP, and webhooks

• Meet platform security and compliance requirements for encryption and data isolation
