title: Associate Director, Chemical Engineering
description:
Associate Director, Chemical Engineering

Nurix Therapeutics is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of targeted protein degradation medicines, the next frontier in innovative drug design aimed at improving treatment options for patients with cancer and inflammatory diseases. Powered by a fully AI-integrated discovery engine capable of tackling any protein class, and coupled with unparalleled ligase expertise, Nurix’s dedicated team has built a formidable advantage in translating the science of targeted protein degradation into clinical advancements. Nurix aims to establish degrader-based treatments at the forefront of patient care, writing medicine’s next chapter with a new script to outmatch disease.

Position Description

Nurix is seeking an experienced, independent, and highly motivated individual who will be accountable for end‑to‑end chemical engineering support of bexobrutideg (NX-5948) drug substance (DS) from late‑stage development through commercial launch, including oversight of external manufacturing sites. The Associate Director, Chemical Engineering will work closely with the CMC team and colleagues in cross-functional departments to provide scientific, technical, and hands-on leadership and oversight of facility and equipment operations at Contract Development Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs) to support bexobrutideg drug substance manufacturing process optimization and scale-up. The position will report to the Director, Chemical Development.

Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

  • Provide engineering leadership to design, develop and optimize scalable routes for small-molecule DS manufacturing, including demonstrated knowledge in unit operation design, process modeling, process equipment selection and scale-up methodologies.
  • Review equipment configurations, qualification packages, and maintenance records at CDMOs to ensure equipment trains are properly qualified, maintained and operating at optimal performance to support Nurix manufacturing operations.
  • Oversee equipment engineering and scale-up operations at DS CDMOs, including hands‑on process troubleshooting during engineering, clinical, registration and PPQ batches.
  • Lead technology transfer to CDMOs including scale-up and demonstration of new chemical processes in development and commercial equipment.
  • Coordinate with CDMOs and Nurix Quality Assurance, and Global Supply Chain functions to ensure timely manufacture and release of DS lots.
  • Partner within Nurix CMC to drive process understanding (critical process parameters, critical quality attributes, control strategy) using engineering principles, DoE and QbD concepts.
  • Review and approve Master Batch Records, campaign reports, deviation investigations and change controls for drug substance operations.
  • Ensure manufacturing operations adhere to company quality, safety and regulatory standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, cGMP).
  • Provide regular Person-In-Plant support for DS manufacturing and ongoing performance monitoring of key facility and operational KPIs across manufacturing sites, including schedule adherence, batch performance, deviation trends, and inspection readiness.
  • Author and review CMC sections of regulatory filings including INDs/IMPD, and NDA/MAA, including responses to Health Authority queries.
  • Define and drive the long‑term engineering strategy for bexobrutideg DS, including process robustness, lifecycle management, and cost‑of‑goods optimization.
  • Represent Chemical Engineering on CMC and cross‑functional program teams, providing input to development strategy, risk assessments, and timelines.
  • Manage and provide technical mentorship of scientists and engineers.

Required Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in chemical engineering, or related field with at least 5 years (M.S. with 10 years or B.S. with 15 years) of industrial, late-phase, small-molecule drug substance development experience
  • Extensive knowledge and experience in GMP drug substance manufacturing, characterization, process development, equipment evaluation/selection, scale up and process validation.
  • Knowledge of solid‑state properties, polymorphism, and crystallization principles relevant to small‑molecule drug substance.
  • Extensive third-party drug substance CDMO management experience including tech transfer activities, QbD and DoE studies, clinical supply production, registration batch production and commercial launch activities.
  • In-depth knowledge of relevant cGMP, ICH, FDA and EMA guidelines.
  • Proven track record of effective internal and external collaboration.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, interpersonal skills and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to multi-task, manage conflict and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of their time.

Fit with Nurix Culture and Values

  • Strong team orientation; highly collaborative
  • Solutions and results-oriented focus
  • Hands-on approach; resourceful and open to diverse points of view

Salary Range: $189,800 - $216,700

title: Senior Backend Software Engineer – Agentic AI Workflows (Go/AWS)
description:
About the role

Most backend roles touching “AI” mean a chatbot bolted onto a CRUD app. This one is different: the agentic workflows are the product surface.

You’ll work on an established enterprise asset-and-metadata platform, building the AI engine that proposes metadata across the active project estate, the automated logic that reassigns or retires ownerless systems, and a live inventory of every agent and MCP server running across production and endpoint environments — all exposed through the platform API.

It’s Go on AWS, against a real production codebase with real users. A large part of the job is reading code you didn’t write, understanding how it behaves, and then extending, refactoring or decommissioning it without breaking anything.

What you’ll own

  • AI-suggested metadata engine — proposing metadata across the active project estate, then tuning it until engineers actually accept the suggestions.
  • Automated ownership reassignment and deprecation — logic that finds ownerless or relinquished systems and acts on them safely.
  • Agent and MCP inventory — complete coverage across production and endpoint environments, accessible programmatically.
  • First-party product inventory and critical-user-journey mapping — making ownership and metadata trustworthy enough to decide on.
  • Legacy refactoring and decommissioning — with unit and integration tests covering everything you ship.
  • Sprint delivery alongside program and customer teams.

Requirements — check yourself against this list

You should be able to say yes to essentially all of these:

  1. 5+ years professional backend software engineering
  2. Go as a working language — you’ve built and shipped scalable backend services and APIs in it
  3. PostgreSQL — schema design and real querying
  4. MongoDB — schema design and real querying
  5. AWS — working knowledge of the services plus their client libraries and APIs
  6. Agentic, AI-driven workflows you have designed, implemented and tuned — suggestion engines, automated decision logic, or assistant interfaces
  7. Asset discovery / ingestion tooling — open-source or commercial (e.g. CloudQuery) for aggregating cloud resources and metadata
  8. Data classification standards, dependency mapping, functional framework mapping
  9. Navigating a large, unfamiliar codebase to refactor or decommission legacy code without regressing existing behaviour
  10. Unit and integration testing for backend components, as standard practice
  11. Agile/Scrum delivery — sprints, stand-ups, retrospectives
  12. Bachelor’s in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience — we care about what you’ve built

Nice to have — not required

  • IT asset management, CMDB, or configuration management platforms
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP) and related agent tooling patterns
  • Governance, risk or compliance workflows — findings management, risk remediation

Logistics

  • Remote, United States. No relocation.
  • Contract engagement, starting mid-September 2026 (W2 or 1099 — whichever suits you).
  • Compensation is competitive; we’ll discuss it openly on the first call.

Interested? Drop your resume and we’ll set up a call. If it isn’t the right fit we’ll tell you quickly — and tell you why.

title: Freelance Senior Power Systems & Python Engineer
description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Voor een afgebakend onderzoeksproject wordt onderzocht hoe structurele datacleaning en anomaliedetectie kunnen worden opgezet voor data afkomstig van Digitale Cabines binnen een bestaand dataplatform.

Voor deze opdracht wordt een team van twee specialisten samengesteld om een algoritme te ontwikkelen dat als Databricks Wheel kan worden uitgerold op het dataplatform. Dit component moet bij het opladen van datasets problemen in de data van Digitale Cabines detecteren, de onderliggende oorzaken helpen identificeren en de opgeladen gegevens volgens een vaste structuur wegschrijven.

Voor het team worden twee complementaire expertisedomeinen voorzien:

  • focus op Power Systems Engineering & Software Engineering
  • focus op Data Science / Machine Learning Operations Engineering

In deze rol werk je mee aan het inhoudelijk uitwerken van het algoritme op basis van aangeleverde cabinedata. Samen met de tweede specialist stel je de code op, test je die grondig en lever je die op in de vorm van een Databricks Wheel dat kan worden gedeployed binnen het dataplatform.

Daarnaast stem je af met platform- en dataspecialisten om de inhoudelijke werking, stabiliteit en inzetbaarheid van de oplossing te valideren. De nadruk ligt op het aantonen van een stabiele en coherente werking van het algoritme binnen de bestaande cloudomgeving.

De opdracht focust op de ontwikkeling, verwerking en analyse van substation-meetdata in een klantenbeheerde secure cloudomgeving, inclusief werken met een door de klant beheerde laptop. Structurele uitrol van de algoritmes en het beheer van de platformen vallen niet binnen deze scope.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt sterke expertise in Power Systems Engineering.
  • Je beschikt over ervaring met Python softwareontwikkeling en Python software engineering, of met een equivalente programmeertaal.
  • Je hebt kennis van Azure data-engineering.
  • Je hebt ervaring met data-ingestie, data quality cleaning en root-cause-analyse van data-quality issues.
  • Je bent vertrouwd met Data Science, MLOps en het werken met tijdsreeksen afkomstig van elektriciteitsnetten.
  • Je kan een oplossing ontwikkelen en opleveren als Python Wheel in Databricks, conform de geldende Europese regels rond data.
  • Ervaring met de technologie in kwestie of met een gelijkaardige technologie is vereist.
  • Je beschikt minstens over een masterdiploma.
  • Je bent onmiddellijk beschikbaar.
  • Ervaring met de verwerking en analyse van substation-meetdata binnen een secure cloudomgeving is een belangrijke troef.
  • Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands.

title: Commercial Data & Insights Lead
description:
Jacaranda Finance is entering an exciting new phase of growth, we are looking for a Commercial Data & Insights Lead. This is an exciting new role to help us make better commercial decisions, faster.

This is a hands-on builder role with real impact.

Reporting to our CTO and working closely with Growth, Lending and Finance, you'll build the data, measurement, automation and intelligence that powers commercial decision-making across Jacaranda.

We're not looking for someone to simply produce dashboards or wait for reporting requests. We're looking for someone who gets close to the commercial problem, understands what decision needs to be made and builds the trusted information needed to make it.

Success is simple: the right answer reaches the right people before the decision is made.

The opportunity

You'll build and continuously improve the commercial data ecosystem that connects activity across the full customer journey, from acquisition and application through to approval, signing and funded loans.
You'll turn fragmented data into trusted commercial intelligence, automate work that shouldn't be manual and create systems that help our teams act with greater speed and confidence.
You'll be responsible for:
  • Building trusted commercial datasets across Growth, Lending and Finance.
  • Creating a consistent view of performance across the full commercial pipeline.
  • Connecting Growth activity and channel performance to funded outgoings.
  • Building automated commercial intelligence that surfaces important opportunities and risks.
  • Owning attribution, UTM governance, campaign tracking and commercial measurement standards.
  • Building automated reporting, workflows, operational tools and alerts.
  • Creating continuous optimisation loops that connect action, results and learning.
  • Applying AI practically across commercial operations and decision support.
  • Preparing audiences, segmentation and deployment-ready datasets when needed.
  • Reducing manual reporting, duplicated analysis and conflicting metrics.
  • Getting close enough to the commercial rhythm to anticipate questions before they become requests.
What you'll bring
  • Strong commercial and operational thinking.
  • Hands-on experience building data, measurement and reporting solutions.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with BI platforms and modern data tools.
  • A strong understanding of data modelling, joins, definitions, quality and reporting logic.
  • Experience with attribution, tracking and commercial measurement.
  • Experience connecting marketing, operational and financial data.
  • Experience building automated workflows or operational systems.
  • The judgement to know when to ship a fast answer and when to build something durable.
  • Comfort working with pace, ambiguity and changing commercial priorities.
  • A bias towards action, iteration and measurable impact.
Experience in consumer lending, financial services, analytics engineering, AI/LLMs, workflow automation or modern data architecture would be highly valued.

How you work

You're a builder.

You'd rather solve the problem than describe it.

You're comfortable writing queries, joining datasets, fixing measurement problems, building automation and getting into the detail yourself.

You don't wait for a perfect brief or perfect system before creating value.

You listen closely enough to understand what the business is trying to decide and build what will help it get there.

Most importantly, you're accountable for outcomes, not just outputs.

Why Jacaranda?

We're not your typical corporate. We're entrepreneurial, ambitious and action-oriented. Decisions are made quickly, people are trusted to take ownership, and we're always looking for ways to make things easier and get 1.1% better every day.
You'll receive:
  • A competitive, above-market base salary.
  • A monthly incentive scheme.
  • A $1,000 annual learning budget and access to Go1 Learning.
  • Career development and internal progression opportunities.
  • Birthday leave and a $500 annual leave bonus.
  • Free daily coffee from our local café.
  • Monthly Core Value Awards, with prize draws of up to $1,000.
  • Regular team events and volunteering opportunities.
  • Employee Assistance Program and wellbeing support.
  • Three much-loved office dogs: Toby, Polly and Monzi.
  • A Great Place to Work® certified culture where people are trusted to make decisions and deliver.
Before you apply

We're a predominantly in-office business because we believe collaboration, problem-solving and innovation happen best when we work side by side.
During probation, you'll work from our Milton office five days per week. Following successful completion of probation, you'll have the flexibility to work from home one day per week.

Ready to build what comes next?

If you love turning messy commercial questions into trusted data, useful systems and faster decisions — and you'd rather build the answer than spend weeks talking about it — we'd love to hear from you.
We may use AI-powered tools to support parts of our recruitment process, but all hiring decisions are made by people. Please contact us if you would like more information about how your data is handled.

title: Material Planner
description:
Since 1982, Sigma Engineered Solutions has been on an incredible journey. We started with just one plant in India and have expanded to 13 locations around the world. What began as a cost-effective supplier of low-voltage electrical products has grown into a global solutions provider of highly engineered, complex metal components, including machined parts and precision metal stampings.


At Sigma Engineered Solutions “your success is our mission.” It’s a promise we live by daily and it defines everything we do whether you are a team member or customer.


The Material Planner is responsible for ensuring the availability of raw materials, components, and purchased parts needed to support production schedules and customer delivery requirements. This role analyzes demand, inventory levels, capacity constraints, and supplier performance to develop and maintain effective material plans.


The Material Planner works closely with Production, Procurement, Customer Service, Warehouse, Engineering, and Suppliers to balance inventory investment, optimize material flow, and prevent supply disruptions within a fast-paced metal stamping manufacturing environment.


What you will be doing:

Demand and Material Planning

  • Analyze customer demand, forecasts, and production schedules both internal and external to determine material requirements.
  • Develop and maintain material planning parameters within the ERP system.
  • Generate and manage material requirements plans (MRP).
  • Monitor demand fluctuations and adjust material plans accordingly.
  • Ensure adequate material availability to support production and customer delivery commitments.
  • Identify potential material shortages and develop mitigation plans.

Inventory Management

  • Monitor inventory levels and ensure materials are available while minimizing excess inventory.
  • Analyze inventory performance, turns, and usage trends.
  • Identify and address excess, obsolete, and slow-moving inventory.
  • Support inventory reduction initiatives without impacting customer service levels.
  • Review safety stock levels and recommend adjustments based on business conditions.
  • Assist with physical inventory counts and inventory accuracy initiatives.

Production Planning Support

  • Collaborate with Production Planning to align material availability with manufacturing schedules.
  • Support schedule changes, customer demand fluctuations, and production priorities.
  • Communicate material constraints that may impact production or customer deliveries.
  • Assist in balancing inventory investment with operational requirements.

Supplier and Procurement Coordination

  • Work closely with Procurement to ensure timely ordering of materials.
  • Monitor supplier delivery performance and identify supply risks.
  • Expedite critical materials as required to support production schedules.
  • Communicate forecast and demand changes to suppliers.
  • Participate in supplier performance improvement activities.

Data Analysis and Reporting

  • Analyze material usage, consumption trends, and inventory data.
  • Develop reports and dashboards to support operational decision-making.
  • Monitor key supply chain metrics, including:
    • Inventory turns
    • Days Of Supply
    • Supplier performance
    • Inventory & Consumption accuracy
    • Forecast accuracy
    • Material shortages
  • Prepare recommendations to improve planning effectiveness and operational performance.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve planning processes and material flow.
  • Support lean manufacturing and inventory optimization initiatives.
  • Participate in cross-functional improvement projects.
  • Recommend enhancements to ERP planning parameters and processes.
  • Assist in developing best practices for materials management and planning.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Customer Service regarding customer demand changes.
  • Work with Engineering on new product launches and material requirements.
  • Collaborate with Production and Quality to resolve material-related issues.
  • Support Finance with inventory reporting and forecasting activities.
  • Participate in Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (S&OP) processes as needed.

Risk Management

  • Identify potential supply chain disruptions and material constraints.
  • Develop contingency plans to minimize business impact.
  • Monitor customer demand and supplier capacity for emerging risks.
  • Support business continuity planning related to material availability.

Other duties:

  • Follow safe work practices and keep the work area clean and organized.
  • Perform related duties as assigned.
  • Follow documented policies and procedures as designated by the company’s Employee Handbook and Local Work Rules. In addition, adhere to the proper Code of Conduct while on company property.

title: [쿠팡] 쿠팡이츠 카탈로그 운영 전략 및 정책 관리 팀장 (Catalog Growth & Excellence) (경력 10년이상)
description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

쿠팡이츠(Coupang Eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다.
쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다.
분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면, 지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요.

직무 소개

Catalog Growth & Excellence 팀은 고객 관점에서 ‘최상의 Eats Catalog 경험’이 무엇인지 정의하고, 이를 지속적으로 고도화하여 고객 WOW 경험과 리텐션 극대화를 만들어내는 조직입니다. 고객이 원하는 정보를 빠르고 정확하게 탐색할 수 있도록 Catalog 등록, 품질 관리, 검색 노출, 운영 정책, 모니터링 등 Catalog life cycle 전반의 운영 전략과 정책 체계를 총괄합니다. 또한 높은 수준의 catalog quality를 안정적으로 유지하면서도, 운영 생산성과 scalability를 동시에 달성할 수 있는 운영 구조를 구축합니다.

데이터 기반 인사이트, 프로세스 혁신, 자동화 기반으로 운영 효율을 극대화하며, Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance 등 다양한 유관 조직과 긴밀히 협업하여 지속 가능한 운영 체계와 고객 중심의 Catalog ecosystem을 만들어갑니다.

업무 내용

  • Merchant Catalog 운영 정책 및 프로세스를 설계하고 운영 생산성, SLA, 품질을 지속적으로 개선
  • Catalog 등록·수정 프로세스의 병목을 발굴하고 자동화 및 프로세스 개선을 통해 운영 효율과 Scalability를 향상
  • 고객 검색 행동, Zero Search, Catalog 품질 등을 분석하여 Search Experience 개선 과제 발굴
  • 글로벌 플랫폼 사례와 데이터 기반 인사이트를 바탕으로 Product 및 Engineering 조직과 협업하여 Search Experience 개선을 추진
  • 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하며 Catalog 및 Search 관련 Cross-functional 프로젝트의 End-to-End 리드

자격 요건

  • Program / Project Management, Product Management 또는 Operations 분야 10년 이상의 경력을 보유한 분
  • 대규모 운영 프로세스를 설계하고 개선한 경험이 있는 분
  • 데이터 기반으로 문제를 정의하고 의사결정을 수행한 경험이 있는 분
  • 다양한 이해관계자를 설득하고 협업하여 프로젝트를 추진한 경험이 있는 분
  • 변화하는 환경에서 우선순위를 설정하고 실행한 경험이 있는 분

우대 사항

  • E-commerce, Marketplace, Food Delivery Platform 등 대규모 플랫폼 운영 경험이 있는 분
  • Catalog Operations, Merchant Operations 또는 Search Optimization 경험이 있는 분
  • Search Relevance, Taxonomy, Metadata 등 Search 품질 개선 경험이 있는 분
  • 경쟁사 분석, 고객 행동 분석 등을 기반으로 새로운 Initiative를 발굴한 경험이 있는 분
  • Automation 또는 Process Innovation 프로젝트를 리드한 경험이 있는 분
  • 비즈니스 영어 커뮤니케이션이 가능한 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형(리크루터 사전 인터뷰) - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 - 레퍼런스체크 - 최종 결과
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Supporter Care and Fundraising Coordinator
location: VIC - SBK HWT Tower 40 City Road Southbank
description:
What's the role?

Looking for a role where every day brings something different—and where your work helps make a meaningful difference? Join the Good Friday Appeal team as a Supporter Care and Fundraising Coordinator and help create memorable experiences for the donors, fundraisers and volunteers who make our Appeal possible.

This is a fast-paced, people-focused entry-level role where you’ll be at the heart of the action. From responding to supporter enquiries and coordinating campaign resources to assisting with events, raffles and fundraising administration, you’ll gain broad experience across a dynamic, purpose-led organisation.

You’ll bring warmth, accuracy and calm problem-solving to every interaction, while working with digital, finance, marketing and fundraising teams to keep things moving. There’s plenty of variety, opportunities to learn and space to bring creativity and fresh ideas to the way we support our community and the Royal Children’s Hospital.

Role Responsibilities

  • Manage central contact and fundraising inboxes, serving as the main touchpoint for donor and volunteer inquiries.

  • Triage supporter registrations, resolve routine inquiries, and steward community fundraisers below specified thresholds.

  • Execute administrative tasks for campaigns, raffles, and events, including managing supplier approvals and collecting digital assets.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records in Salesforce, assist with basic reporting, and process donations.

  • Coordinate the distribution of event collateral, certificates, acknowledgments, fundraising resources and materials using established checklists.

  • Assist with the fundraising permit implementation process under the guidance of campaign managers.

  • Handle routine complaints constructively and escalate complex matters or sensitive issues to senior portfolio owners.

  • Deliver calm, supporter-centered service and operational backup during peak Good Friday Appeal periods.

Who are you?

  • Background in customer service, supporter care, or fundraising administration within an NFP or corporate setting.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with a warm, empathetic, and sensitive tone for diverse stakeholders.

  • Comfortable using Google Workspace, MS Office, and CRM tools, with experience in Salesforce, Funraisin, or Canva being a strong plus.

  • High level of organisational skill and accuracy when managing data entry, shared inbox queues, and administrative workflows.

  • Ability to triage incoming requests efficiently, follow standard operating procedures, and know when to escalate complex issues.

  • Composed, adaptable, and focused during high-volume, fast-paced Appeal periods.

  • Enjoys working across digital, finance, and marketing teams to build a connected supporter experience.

  • Passionate about supporting the Royal Children's Hospital community and upholding the values of the Good Friday Appeal.

Why this role matters

You’ll help turn every supporter interaction into a positive connection with the Good Friday Appeal. Whether you’re helping a first-time fundraiser get started, ensuring a volunteer has the right resources or resolving a donor enquiry with care, your work will help people feel valued, supported and part of something bigger.

With variety, purpose and the chance to learn across fundraising operations, this is a great opportunity to build your career while contributing to an iconic Appeal. Bring your curiosity, creativity and can-do spirit—we’ll bring the opportunity to make a difference.

Why News Corp Australia

Join a culture where innovation is our operating rhythm. You’ll work on a diverse portfolio of Australia’s most loved brands and play a pivotal role in leading the technological shift in how we create commercial content. Our vibrant, hybrid work environment and dynamic, values-driven culture empowers you to push boundaries, collaborate as one unified team, and make a positive, measurable impact for all Australians.

News Extras Benefits is a commitment to our people for their valued contribution to News, our audiences, clients and communities.

Our benefits include:

  • Exclusively ours - Access to publications and products from across the News Corp family

  • Perks & discounts - Exclusive offers across a range of products and services that deliver genuine cost savings and benefits

  • Health & wellbeing - Advice, support and facilities for healthy minds and bodies (including an onsite gym at our Adelaide, Brisbane & Sydney offices)

  • Time off - News offers a range of leave options to support your personal needs and moments that matter in life: Parental leave, Birthday leave, Volunteer leave, Career break and Compassionate leave.

  • Financial wellbeing - Support on making the most of your money

In addition to our perks and benefits, employees have access to a number of initiatives and programs that support their wellbeing and professional growth, such as:

  • Helping you grow - Access tailored development opportunities, including leadership programs, to cultivate your skills and support your career

  • Giving back - Make a difference to our communities through volunteer opportunities and company-organised charity drives

  • Workplace Inclusion and facilities – Engage with your passions through various employee-resource groups and accessibility to multi-faith quiet rooms & parents’ rooms

Who are we?

The Good Friday Appeal is an iconic not-for-profit charity established to raise funds for The Royal Children’s Hospital. Since 1931, the Appeal has raised $492 million to fund research, equipment, education, training and patient centred care programs at the hospital.
The Good Friday Appeal is supported by a small team who works closely with our generous partners, supporters, collection groups and volunteers who come together in the spirit of raising funds for the hospital.

What’s next?

Apply now or for more information on careers at News Corp Australia visit

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Diversity strengthens our national teams and newsroom as we seek to tell stories that represent the communities of Australia. Our people make us unique, and so we are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability or gender identity. Applicants of diverse backgrounds are encouraged to apply!

We are committed to ensuring an accessible and supportive recruitment process. If you require any adjustments or accommodations at any stage, please do not hesitate to let us know here. In order for us to assist you, please ensure you include the role title you are applying for in the subject line. For more information regarding Diversity at NewsCorp Australia please visit under the Diversity@News section.

title: Emergency Services Technician
description:
Overview

An emergency medical situation is unsettling for patients and their loved ones. As part of a specialty team you will ease fears while providing exceptional care under fast-paced conditions. If you want to use your talents and compassion to make a difference in the lives of children and adults in an emergency setting, we invite you to consider joining Legacy.

Legacy Good Samaritan Medical Center in Northwest Portland is known for its specialty programs and clinical excellence. Legacy Good Samaritan features nationally renowned doctors in cancer care, kidney transplantations, neurology, ophthalmology, weight-loss surgery, robotic surgery, rehabilitation and more, with access to emergency care if needed.

Responsibilities

The Emergency Services Technician participates as a member of the healthcare team by assisting the Licensed Independent Practitioner (L.I.P.), R.N. and Unit Secretary. The position is an integral part of the team approach to patient care and performs those tasks that contribute to the smooth and efficient flow of patients through the department.

  • PATIENT CARE: Provides patient care to newborn, child, adult and geriatric patients as delegated by and under the supervision of a registered nurse.
  • COMMUNICATION: Uses appropriate communication skills in dealing with patients, visitors, EMS personnel, hospital personnel.
  • ENVIRONMENTAL DUTIES: Demonstrates responsibility and accountability for maintenance and safety of unit equipment and supplies.
  • EDUCATION: Demonstrates and maintains active working knowledge of the Credentialing competencies for Emergency Services Techs. There will be a three-month leeway between time of hire and mandatory completion of competencies which will be turned in to nurse manager.
  • PROFESSIONAL BEHAVIOR: Demonstrates professionalism in appearance and actions.

Qualifications

Education:

  • High School diploma or equivalent.

Experience:

  • Previous patient care experience in an Emergency environment and/or with children strongly preferred

Skills:

  • Basic medical terminology.
  • Computer familiarity.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment with ability to prioritize multiple assignments.

Licensure

  • BLS for Providers certification from the American Heart Association required.
  • CNA, MA or EMT desired.

Pay Range

USD $21.70 - USD $29.39 /Hr.

Our Commitment to Health and Equal Opportunity

Our Legacy is good for health for Our People, Our Patients, Our Communities, Our World. Above all, we will do the right thing.

If you are passionate about our mission and believe you can contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply—even if you don't meet every qualification listed. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can grow and succeed.

Legacy Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits unlawful discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion or creed, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

To learn more about our employee benefits click here: www.legacyhealth.org/For-Health-Professionals/careers/benefiting-you

title: Project Manager Student Placement
description:
Company

ALPINE RACING LIMITED

Job Description

Duration: 1 year
Start Date: July 2027

About Us

We are a high-performance Formula One Team driven by innovation, precision, and a commitment to excellence. Within our Projects and Programme Management function, we play a critical role in coordinating the delivery of components and systems that directly contribute to race car performance.

As a Project Manager Placement Student, you’ll gain hands-on experience at the heart of how an F1 car is planned, built, and developed. This is a unique opportunity to support cross-functional engineering, production, and programme activities that keep our car development running at pace throughout the season.

The Role

As a Project Manager Placement Student, you will support other Project Managers and the wider team in planning, coordinating, and monitoring projects.

title: Climate, Communications & Corp Reporting Lead
description:
SPC Global (ASX:SPG) is an iconic food manufacturer with a 100-year commitment to playing a positive role in the Australian economy and manufacturing industry. Our commercial business office is located in Melbourne CBD and runs four Business Divisions – SPC, The Original Beverage Co, Nature One and Natural Ingredients.

Our Group has a portfolio of brands with a focus on providing nourishment and wellness for consumers globally. Our Group’s products span packaged fruit and tomatoes, baked beans and spaghetti, ready-made meals, beverages, juice and wellness shots, powdered milk products, and vegetable and fruit supplies to the food service industry.

With a strong heritage in Australia, and ambitious plans to grow both domestically and internationally, this is an exciting time to join our business.


The Opportunity:

This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in shaping SPC Global’s approach to climate reporting and sustainability, while working across the business to build capability and drive meaningful change.

The Climate, Communications & Corporate Reporting Lead supports SPC Global in meeting its evolving corporate reporting, governance and stakeholder communication requirements, with a particular focus on climate-related financial reporting.

The role will lead the coordination and implementation of the Group’s climate reporting
requirements, working across the organisation to establish the governance, processes, data and supporting documentation required for effective and compliant disclosure.

The role will also support broader sustainability and ESG reporting, including modern slavery reporting, together with selected governance, corporate reporting and general internal and external communications activities.

Reporting to the General Counsel & Company Secretary and working closely with Legal and Corporate Affairs team members along with Finance, People & Culture, Operations and other functions, the role will bring together information from across the Group and translate complex regulatory and business requirements into clear, accurate and timely reporting and communications

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the coordination and delivery of SPC Global’s mandatory climate-related financial reporting requirements.
  • Coordinate the development of climate-related disclosures across governance, strategy, risk management, metrics and targets.
  • Work with Finance and other functions to establish appropriate processes, data sources, controls, ownership and documentation to support reporting and assurance.
  • Coordinate climate risk and opportunity assessments, scenario analysis and other supporting activities.
  • Support appropriate management and Board governance and oversight of climate-related risks and opportunities.
  • Monitor changes to climate reporting standards, regulation and market practice and assess implications for the Group.
  • Coordinate relevant ESG and sustainability reporting requirements across the Group.
  • Lead the preparation and coordination of SPC Global’s Modern Slavery Statement and associated information gathering and reporting processes.
  • Support the development and maintenance of sustainability and responsible business frameworks, policies and reporting processes.
  • Coordinate responses to relevant stakeholder, customer, investor and other ESG-related information requests.
  • Support the ongoing development of the Group’s sustainability reporting approach as regulatory and business requirements evolve.
  • Support the General Counsel & Company Secretary with ASX and listed-company reporting and disclosure requirements, including coordination of relevant announcements, disclosures and supporting information.
  • Coordinate inputs to key corporate reporting, including the Annual Report, Corporate Governance Statement and other relevant disclosures.
  • Support the review, development and maintenance of governance policies, frameworks and associated reporting.
  • Monitor relevant regulatory and governance developments and support implementation of required changes.
  • Prepare and coordinate Board and Committee materials relating to matters within the role’s remit.
  • Provide general internal and external communications support across the business as required.
  • Draft, edit and coordinate a range of communications for employees, leaders and external stakeholders.
  • Support the preparation of corporate updates, announcements, presentations, website content and other communication materials.
  • Work collaboratively with the Head of Communications & Corporate Affairs to support delivery of communication priorities and ensure consistency of messaging and tone.
  • Assist with communication planning and coordination for key business initiatives, events and organisational updates.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional projects and workstreams, bringing together inputs from across the business to deliver agreed outcomes, reporting and governance requirements.
  • Drive project plans, timelines and accountabilities, proactively following up actions, resolving dependencies and maintaining momentum across multiple stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple workstreams, reporting cycles and deadlines with clear accountabilities and quality controls.
  • Coordinate external advisers and specialist providers as required.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, quality and maturity of climate, ESG, governance and corporate reporting processes.
  • Follow all safety procedures and protocols relevant to your role and work environment.
  • Actively identify and report physical and psychosocial hazards, near misses, or incidents
  • Participate in safety activities such as training, team talks, and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Contribute to a positive safety culture by looking out for other team members and speaking up when something doesn’t seem safe.
  • Maintain a clean, orderly, and safe work area, using equipment and tools responsibly.
  • Demonstrate care for your own safety and the safety of others in all aspects of your work.

The successful candidate will have:

  • Relevant tertiary qualification in sustainability, environmental management, finance, accounting, law, governance, communications, business or a related discipline.
  • Additional qualifications or professional development in climate reporting, sustainability, ESG, governance or corporate reporting will be highly regarded.
  • Strong knowledge of, or demonstrated experience working with, climate-related financial reporting requirements, including Australian sustainability reporting requirements and AASB S2.
  • Experience coordinating complex corporate, regulatory, sustainability or financial reporting processes involving multiple business functions.
  • Understanding of ESG and sustainability reporting frameworks and evolving regulatory requirements.
  • Knowledge of modern slavery reporting requirements and associated governance and due diligence processes.
  • Understanding of corporate governance principles and reporting requirements, ideally within an ASX-listed or similarly regulated environment.
  • Strong written communication and editing capability, with the ability to translate complex technical or regulatory information into clear and accessible content.
  • Strong project management, planning and coordination skills.
  • High level of attention to detail and confidence working with data, reporting frameworks, evidence and assurance processes.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills and confidence working with reporting and information management systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously and take ownership of complex workstreams.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence and coordinate across functions without direct authority.
  • Sound judgement and discretion when handling confidential, commercially sensitive or Board-level information.
  • Commercial and pragmatic approach, with the ability to balance regulatory requirements with business priorities.
  • Comfortable operating across a broad and evolving remit and adapting to changing regulatory and organisational requirements.
  • Collaborative approach and ability to work effectively across multiple stakeholders.

Our Culture:

Our employees come from all walks of life, across many cultures and backgrounds. The strength of our brands is supported through the strength of our people.

This is a rare opportunity to join a diverse, exciting workplace during a transformational period and make positive contributions to the growth of SPC Global.

You’ll be part of one of Australia’s most iconic businesses. You’ll work in a collaborative and supportive team environment with others who have a wealth of experience to share. We offer a competitive salary and opportunities for personal and career development.

You will be required to meet SPC Global’s employment criteria which will include pre-employment medical screening. Interested?

For more information visit spcglobalgroup.com and apply today!

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Business Intelligence Analyst

"Building financial foundations for families to empower them today and leave a legacy for tomorrow.”

Experior Financial Group is looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to build and maintain the reports and dashboards that help our teams understand and act on our data. You'll work directly with stakeholders across the organization to turn raw data into clear, reliable, and actionable insight, writing the queries that pull the data together and designing the Power BI dashboards that put it in front of decision-makers. This is a hands-on, technical role for someone who is as comfortable in a data model or a block of SQL as they are presenting a finished dashboard.

As a member of our team, you will enjoy a positive work environment and be part of a dynamic group that values dedication and enthusiasm. We offer excellent opportunities for career advancement to those who are committed and strive for excellence.

Responsibilities:

  • Write and optimize SQL queries against relational databases to extract, join, and aggregate data for reporting and analysis.

  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate them into clear, well-structured data visualizations.
  • Develop and maintain ETL/data pipelines to keep reporting data accurate, complete, and up to date.
  • Monitor data quality and troubleshoot discrepancies between source systems and reports.
  • Document data definitions, report logic, and dashboard usage so reporting stays consistent and maintainable over time.
  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring reports and streamline the reporting process.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience building reports and dashboards in Power BI (or a comparable BI tool such as Tableau or Looker), including DAX and data modeling.
  • Strong SQL skills, comfortable writing complex queries (joins, subqueries, window functions) against relational databases.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling concepts and best practices for structuring data for reporting (e.g., star schemas).
  • Experience working with data warehouses and/or ETL tools and processes.
  • Familiarity with IMO, Insurance Carrier, and/or financial services operations is strongly preferred.
  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
  • Familiarity with Power Query (M language) and Power BI Service administration (workspaces, gateways, row-level security) is an asset.
  • Exposure to Python or another scripting language for data processing or automation is an asset.
  • Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, Snowflake, or similar) is an asset.
  • Must reside and be authorized to work in the USA.

What Experior Financial Group Inc. can offer you:

  • Competitive compensation and a comprehensive total rewards package, including a 401(K) program, and group benefits coverage (health, vision, dental, and short-term disability), as well as access to mental health supports and an Employee Assistance Program.

  • Collaborative, supportive team environment where your contributions are recognized and valued.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Born out of Boston Children’s Hospital, we're a biofeedback game platform that teaches kids emotion calming skills through play. Kids wear our heart rate monitor while playing a library of biofeedback games and must regulate their heart rate to win. The games empower kids to practice self-calming skills that transfer to real-life situations. Additionally, our program supports parents with expert coaching. Three clinical trials with children with ADHD (ages 6-14) showed reduced oppositional behaviors, aggression, and family stress in just 12 weeks. We launched our first product in July 2017, reached over 3,000 families, and raised $9M from top venture capital and angel investors. Our mission is to empower millions of kids to become greater than their emotions.

Why is this role important?
We're growing every day, and we are seeking a creative and detail-oriented senior software engineer to join our growing product and engineering team. In this role, you will help drive the direction of our web product and bring it to the next level with features and robustness. You’ll do this by participating in whiteboard design discussions, designing solutions to take on problems at scale, building consumer-facing features, participating in code reviews, and tackling big architectural milestones on our engineering roadmap. A Few Projects on the Horizon:
o Parent reporting dashboard

o Customer management tools
o Expanding our RESTful API’s
o Scale our infrastructure: help us scale 10x with an eye towards 100x, 1000x
o Data management: manage data coming in, data going out, data storage, and data processing pipelines. We want you to come up with answers for how we empower our product teams to answer big questions with data.
o Usability: make sure that what we build delights our customers and is intuitive to use

Relevant experience and qualifications:
o Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent demonstrated experience.
o At least 2+ years of software development experience.
o Ability to thoroughly test your code and ensure it is a high-quality end product.

o Experience with microservices architecture.

title: GIS Analyst
description:
We are proud to become a new Australian Defence Force partner, offering career opportunities to support the maintenance of defence base services in the Northern Territory and South Australia.

We have a role available for a GIS Analyst. This is a permanent full-time position based in Melbourne, Victoria.

About us

Service Stream is an equal opportunity ASX-listed business that develops and operates Australia's essential services networks across telecommunications, utilities, transport, defence, and social infrastructure industries - we keep communities connected.

Your next role comes with these perks:

  • Flexible working - all flexibility requests are genuinely considered. This position offers hybrid working.

  • Career development – we offer growth opportunities and support internal mobility. Employees have access to skill enhancement through cross-training among service teams, as well as participation in mentoring and leadership development programs.

  • Access - discounts for hundreds of businesses such as Woolworths, Air BNB, The Iconic, JB HI-FI, Dan Murphys, Bupa Health Care, and Specsavers. We also offer access to novated leasing and a share matching program.

  • Paid leave - parental, cultural, community service, defence, study, corporate volunteering and purchased leave available.

About the role

The GIS Analyst supports Defence and Social Infrastructure projects by managing, analysing, and delivering spatial data. Using ArcGIS and the LISA platform, the role provides geospatial insights that support land management, environmental services, project delivery, planning, and asset management.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Collect, maintain, validate, and manage geospatial datasets, databases, and repositories, ensuring data quality, compliance, and accurate metadata.

  • Conduct spatial analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, providing geospatial insights to support planning, project delivery, operational readiness, and asset management.

  • Produce maps, dashboards, and other spatial products that effectively communicate infrastructure, asset, environmental, security, and project information to stakeholders.

  • Configure, maintain, and support ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Pro, LISA, web maps, applications, and map services, including user support and access management.

  • Develop and enhance automated GIS workflows using Python, FME, SQL, and ArcGIS tools to improve data processing, reporting, and map production efficiency.

About you

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Minimum 3 years' experience in a GIS, spatial analysis, geospatial data management, or related role.

  • Demonstrated experience using ESRI ArcGIS products, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, and enterprise geospatial solutions.

  • Experience managing, analysing, and maintaining spatial datasets for infrastructure, land management, environmental, or asset management projects.

  • Strong understanding of spatial data models, coordinate reference systems, geodatabases, and data quality assurance processes.

  • Experience integrating GIS data with business systems and presenting spatial information through maps, dashboards, and reports.

  • Experience using SQL and/or Python for data extraction, automation, and spatial analysis is highly desirable.

  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively with project teams, stakeholders, and technical specialists to deliver geospatial outcomes.

  • Diploma/Degree in GIS Systems highly regarded

You must be an Australian Citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Defence Security Clearance.

How to apply

Please submit your interest with the apply button where you will be directed to create a profile on our system.

We celebrate diversity at Service Stream and welcome applications from people who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander, people with a disability or neurodivergence, and those from LGBTIQA+, Veteran or other diverse groups. Applications are unable to be accepted via email. If you require any reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process, please email talent.defence@servicestream.com.au.

title: Education Specialist - N Thurston/Tumwater/Shelton SDs
description:
About Treehouse: We work to create opportunities for young people in foster care to thrive. We believe that every young person impacted by foster care determines their own future and can build the life of their dreams. Treehouse seeks to hire passionate individuals who understand the power of young people, celebrate diverse voices, and challenge themselves to do better. We are committed to providing opportunities for staff to learn and grow with the organization.


Pay Transparency: This position’s annual pay is $54,866.66 ($26.3782/hour).


Primary Worksite Location: We are hiring for an on-site position serving the following school districts: N. Thurston, Tumwater, and Shelton. This is not a remote work position.


**A submitted resume and cover letter are required as part of the application process for this position.*****Note that resumes/applications submitted for this position are reviewed on a rolling basis as received, until the positions are filled.***


Job Summary:


The Treehouse Education Specialist serves as a mission-driven, equity-centered staff member who contributes regularly to advance the organization’s commitment to anti-racism, social justice, and belonging by working closely with school administration, faculty, and staff, including foster care liaisons and school building points of contact, as well as the Department of Children, Youth & Families (DCYF), tribal social workers, and community partners, to support a caseload of youth experiencing foster care.


The Education Specialist helps to ensure the needs of the youth that Treehouse serves are met, aligning programmatic and operational goals through a culturally responsive and inclusive approach with acknowledgement of the trauma experienced by youth in care. The role seeks to help dismantle systemic inequities, promote psychological safety, engage in equitable practices across systems, and contribute to an organizational culture rooted in dignity, accountability, and care in service of the youth that Treehouse supports.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Manage an assigned caseload of youth 9th – 12th Grade, using established case procedures and ensuring equitable practices.
  • Provide support for up to one year post high school focused on adapting plans and addressing challenges related to education, career, and/or basic living skills.
  • Build trusting relationships with social workers, caregivers, school personnel, and other collaborators in an inclusive and welcoming manner to support youth holistically.
  • Analyze data (i.e. attendance, educational history, behaviors, performance, etc.) for assigned youth to create and inform educational plans.
  • Adhere to reporting mandates, policies, and procedures.
  • Coach youth on problem solving, self-advocacy, self-determination, academic mindset, self-regulation, persistence, and positive behavior to ensure that the youth have a safe, positive, and respectful experience, inclusive of all racial and gender identities, and with awareness of the trauma experienced by youth in care and historically marginalized communities.
  • Embrace transformation by seeking out perspectives across the organization and with partner organizations and communities to evolve how Treehouse serves youth with curiosity and openness to new ideas.
  • Collaborate with Treehouse Resource Navigation department to identify and refer youth to appropriate resources to support education, social/emotional development, and other needs in an equitable manner.
  • Review High School & Beyond Plan for integration in the student’s goals and student-centered planning.
  • Acquire easily accessible consent forms for each assigned youth and collect school records as needed.
  • Schedule and facilitate inter-agency meetings, notify and partner with the Foster Care Liaison to develop transportation plans, assist with credit transfer/retrieval, and negotiate services and disciplinary appeals, etc.
  • Collaborate regularly with the youth’s care team including, but not limited to: state, federal, or tribal social workers, community partners, caregivers, school personnel, and Treehouse leadership incorporating de-escalation, conflict resolution, culturally sensitive, and compassionate support to those who have experienced trauma or may be experiencing crisis.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and updated case records for each youth in the program’s database. Including consent forms as needed.
  • Partner with management to collect and provide recommendations on culturally diverse success stories, testimonials, and feedback that represent the organizational mission upon request.
  • Participate in cross-functional initiatives aimed at enhancing employee experience, workflow efficiency, and organizational culture.
  • Engage in ongoing education and reflection to strengthen Treehouse’s ability to support the growth, success, and well-being of the Black youth we serve.
  • Collaborate to build long-term, respectful partnerships with Tribal Nations and Indigenous-led organizations to ensure items offered to Indigenous youth are culturally grounded and community-informed.
  • Practice abundance by helping to steward resources thoughtfully, leveraging partnerships, and sharing excess resources with other nonprofits when possible
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Dual Study Program in Business Administration - International Business (B.A.)
description:
Make your mark for patients

Start date: 1 August 2027

Locations: Monheim am Rhein and Mannheim

Academic partner: Duale Hochschule Baden-Württemberg (DHBW)

Start your journey with UCB

Are you ready to launch your career after finishing school and looking for a hands-on degree program at an international company that combines innovation with a strong focus on patients? Would you like to take on responsibility, shape your own projects and become part of a committed team? Then UCB is the right place for you!

Starting on 1 August 2027, we are offering a practice-oriented dual study program in Business Administration – International Business (B.A.) in partnership with DHBW Mannheim.

How your study program works

  • Getting started in Monheim am Rhein: You will begin with a two-month onboarding period before your academic studies begin, giving you the opportunity to get to know UCB, your colleagues and your fellow dual students.

Your practical placements – varied and tailored to you

  • Human Resources (HR)
  • Finance
  • Marketing and Corporate Communications
  • Digitalisation and Operational Excellence
  • Market Access
  • Drug Safety
  • Medical and Quality
  • …and many other exciting departments!

What we offer

  • Attractive remuneration in line with the German chemical industry collective agreement
  • Monthly allowance to support living expenses, such as housing costs
  • Reimbursement of travel expenses for official transitions between academic and practical phases

  • Laptop for professional use

Your application process

  • Your CV in English

Once we have received your documents, we will send you a qualification form by email. Please complete the form and return it to us. We will then verify whether you meet the eligibility criteria for the dual study program based on your CV, certificates and the information provided in the form. If you meet the eligibility criteria, we will invite you to an online or in-person interview, depending on your location.

The interview will be conducted in German. To help you feel well prepared, we will provide you with a guide in advance. During the conversation, you will have the opportunity to learn more about UCB and our dual study program—and, of course, to ask any questions you may have.

The final stage of the application process is an online assessment center, which will also be conducted in German and usually takes place in a small group. If you reach this part of the process, we will provide you with all the relevant details in advance.

Ready to take the next step?

If you have any questions, please contact us: Dualstudyprogram@ucb.com

About us
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless expressly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

title: Network Automation & Reliability Engineer
description:
Overview
Ontrac Solutions is seeking a Network Automation & Reliability Engineer to operate and automate hyperscale data center, backbone, and out-of-band (OOB) networks. This is a Python-first role: you will spend more of your week writing code that operates the network than typing on a CLI. You will build the tooling, telemetry pipelines, and self-healing automation that keep a global fleet of data centers and POP sites running, and you will carry the on-call pager for the systems you build.
We are looking for an engineer who is genuinely production-grade on both sides of the job — deep routing and switching fundamentals and real, sustained Python software work. Candidates who are strong on one side and thin on the other will not clear screening.
What your application must clearly show
We screen against the requirements below exactly as written — your resume should make these easy to find:

  • Python you actually wrote, described as software, not as a skills keyword.Name the project, what it did, roughly how large it was, and who used it. "Python (scripting)" in a skills list will not clear this bar.A GitHub, GitLab, or public repo link is strongly preferred— we look at code.
  • Thespecific Python network librariesyou have used in production — for example Netmiko, NAPALM, Nornir, pyATS/Genie, Scrapli, ncclient, or a vendor SDK — and what you built with each.
  • BGP in production at scale.Name the policy work: local preference, MED, communities, import/export policy, route reflection, ECMP, or multihoming across carriers.
  • Hands-on withat least twoof Arista EOS, Juniper Junos (QFX / SRX / PTX / MX), or Cisco IOS-XR / NX-OS — named by platform, not just by vendor.
  • Telemetry and observabilityyou implemented: gNMI/gRPC, OpenConfig, streaming telemetry, flow telemetry, or SNMP-to-TSDB pipelines. Say what you subscribed to and what you did with the data.
  • Config-as-code:Jinja2 templating, NETCONF/YANG or REST-API-driven provisioning, golden configs, ZTP, and the Git/CI workflow you shipped changes through.
  • Yournetworking certifications, named, with dates and credential IDs or verification links— we verify certifications.
  • Whether you have carriedproduction on-call, and at what scale (sites, devices, or POPs).

Shortly after you apply you will receive a short role-specific questionnaire — completing it promptly is the fastest way to move into screening.
Required Qualifications:

  • Python — primary requirement:Demonstrated, sustained Python development in a production network or infrastructure environment. You have written and maintained tooling that other engineers depended on: config generation and validation, API integrations, telemetry collectors, automated remediation, or test harnesses. You are comfortable with modules, packaging, testing, code review, and version control — not just single-file scripts.
  • Routing & switching depth:Production experience with BGP (policy, path selection, multihoming), plus IS-IS or OSPF, ECMP, and VXLAN/EVPN or MPLS overlays.
  • Multi-vendor hardware:Hands-on operations across at least two of Arista EOS, Juniper Junos (QFX/SRX/PTX/MX), or Cisco IOS-XR / NX-OS.
  • Automation frameworks:Ansible and Jinja2, plus NETCONF/YANG, RESTCONF, or vendor REST APIs for model-driven configuration management.
  • Telemetry & monitoring:gNMI/gRPC streaming telemetry, OpenConfig models, SNMP, flow telemetry, and dashboarding/alerting on top of them.
  • Linux:Comfortable operating on Linux hosts — networking stack, packet capture, systemd services, and shell scripting.
  • Version control and CI:Git-based workflows with peer review; experience shipping network changes through a pipeline (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions).
  • Production on-call:Experience holding a 24x7 rotation for a live network, including incident command and root cause analysis.
  • Experience level:Roughly 2–5 years in a network production, network reliability, or network automation role. Exceptional early-career engineers with a strong Python portfolio and hyperscale or carrier exposure are encouraged to apply.
  • Location & work authorization:Must be located in the United States and authorized to work in the US.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Out-of-band network experience — console server fleets (ZPE Nodegrid, OpenGear), RS-232 configuration management, or OOB build-out for new data center capacity.
  • Data center or POP build-out and turn-up: new product introduction (NPI) for switching platforms, port channelization and optics selection, cabling and rack density planning, or hardware qualification and stress testing.
  • MACsec, IPsec at scale, or zero-trust segmentation with 802.1X and NAC.
  • Optical or transport exposure — DWDM, Ciena, PON/OLT/ONU, or IXIA/Spirent test automation.
  • Building or contributing to a networksource of truth(NetBox or in-house) aggregating BGP, link-state, and drain-state data.
  • Applying LLM or agentic tooling to on-call workflows — automated triage, runbook execution, or incident summarization.
  • A master's degree in Network Engineering, Telecommunications, or Computer Science.

Key Responsibilities — Network Automation & Tooling (primary focus):

  • Design, write, and maintain Python tooling that provisions, validates, and audits network devices across the global fleet.
  • Build model-driven provisioning libraries using Jinja2 templating with NETCONF/YANG or REST APIs to codify golden configurations and eliminate configuration drift.
  • Develop automated remediation for recurring failure classes — route flaps, hardware faults, optical degradation — triggered by syslog and telemetry.
  • Reduce operational toil: identify manual runbook steps that recur, and replace them with tested, reviewed code.

Key Responsibilities — Backbone, Data Center & Out-of-Band Operations:

  • Operate and scale data center fabrics, backbone links, and out-of-band management networks across a global footprint of data centers and POP sites.
  • Design and tune BGP policy — local preference, MED, communities, import/export policy, default-route propagation — to control path selection and eliminate single-carrier points of failure.
  • Support capacity expansion and site turn-ups: high-level design, port channelization, optics and cabling standards, and hardware qualification.
  • Execute zero-downtime change management in production, including hitless migrations and staged rollbacks.

Key Responsibilities — Telemetry, Observability & Reliability:

  • Operationalize multi-vendor streaming telemetry (gNMI/gRPC, OpenConfig) and tune subscription jobs for signal quality and management-plane efficiency.
  • Build and maintain observability that supports hop-by-hop path tracing, multi-layer fault isolation, and fast root cause analysis.
  • Contribute to a real-time network source of truth aggregating BGP, link-state, and drain-state data.
  • Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation; lead incident response, write RCAs, and drive the follow-up automation that prevents recurrence.

Key Responsibilities — Security & Change Governance:

  • Maintain and optimize firewall and ACL policy across multi-vendor platforms, keeping rule sets scoped and performant.
  • Support SIRT/PSIRT CVE remediation through automated regression testing and config-as-code pipelines.
  • Author and maintain technical documentation — designs, runbooks, and API contracts — for the tooling and networks you own.

title: Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) Engineer
description:
Capgemini Government Solutions (CGS) LLC Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) Engineer is responsible for designing, deploying, configuring, and supporting enterprise-wide Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions using the SailPoint platform (IdentityIQ and/or Identity Security Cloud). This role plays a critical part in strengthening enterprise cybersecurity postures, automating the identity lifecycle (Joiner/Mover/Leaver workflows), enforcing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and aligning identity operations with federal mandates and Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) initiatives. Working closely with security architects, systems administrators, and application owners, the SailPoint Engineer ensures seamless integration, compliance automation, and robust operational resilience.

Job Responsibilities

As Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) Engineer, you will be responsible for:

  • Design, configure, deploy, and maintain SailPoint IdentityIQ (IIQ) or SailPoint Identity Security Cloud platforms. Develop custom workflows, rules, forms, policies, and Beanshell/Java scripts.
  • Integrate enterprise applications, databases, directories (Active Directory, Entra ID, LDAP), and cloud services with SailPoint using out-of-the-box and custom web services/REST APIs/SCIM connectors.
  • Build and maintain automated provisioning and de-provisioning processes for Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) events across hybrid infrastructures.
  • Configure and manage periodic access certification campaigns, entitlement catalog structures, and Separation of Duties (SoD) enforcement policies.
  • Support the design, implementation, and maintenance of Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) models to reduce over-privileged user access.
  • Perform system health checks, performance tuning, patching, version upgrades, and database maintenance across non-production and production SailPoint environments.
  • Ensure SailPoint configurations align with DoD/Federal cybersecurity standards (STIG compliance, NIST SP 800-53 controls) and support Authority to Operate (ATO) assessments.
  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point for complex provisioning errors, identity synchronization bugs, connector failures, and performance bottlenecks.

Required Qualifications

  • Have an active Secret or higher-level Government security clearance that requires U.S. citizenship
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum of six (6) years of dedicated experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), with at least four (4) years of hands-on engineering, configuration, and administration of SailPoint IdentityIQ or SailPoint Identity Security Cloud.
  • Active CompTIA Security+ CE certification (or higher DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II compliant certification, such as CYSA+, GSEC, or CISSP).
  • Superior analytical, troubleshooting, and collaboration skills, with a proven history of managing complex technical deliverables independently.

Technical Expertise:

  • Advanced capability in developing Java, BeanShell, and XML components within the SailPoint IdentityIQ framework.
  • Demonstrated experience building RESTful APIs, SCIM interfaces, JDBC connectors, and custom application integrations.
  • Deep understanding of core identity protocols and directories: SAML 2.0, OAuth, OIDC, Active Directory, LDAP, and PKI/CAC/PIV integrations.
  • Solid working knowledge of relational database management systems (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and SQL query writing.
  • Direct experience implementing SailPoint solutions within Federal/DoD ICAM programs or Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) environments.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform) and containerized application deployments.
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps, automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, and version control systems (Git).
  • Hands-on integration experience pairing SailPoint with Privileged Access Management (PAM) tools (e.g., BeyondTrust) or Identity Providers (e.g. Ping, Entra ID)
