Integrity and maintainability of the Group ERP template; quality and timeliness of Design Authority decisions; material design issues caught before build or production; cross-module coherence; successful SIT handover to the internal SIT Lead; internal leads ready to design independently; usable architecture standards and reduced dependency on external consulting.

title: UX Lead
description:
IBMC is assisting a client in hiring a vital UX Lead to drive a high-impact research and prototyping mandate for an extremely complex risk and fraud management platform. This is not a generic UI/UX Designer vacancy or a visual production role. It is a senior, hands-on, individual-contributor mandate embedded within a strong, established product and engineering team.

Your mission is to personally research professional Risk Managers, understand how they monitor, investigate, and act within high-consequence environments, and turn that evidence into tested, interactive prototypes. Acting as the vital bridge between domain experts, product managers, and software engineers, you will establish an evidence-backed model of complex user journeys to ensure the team implements the right product direction.

Qualitative UX Research: Personally plan, recruit, and conduct in-depth qualitative research (interviews, contextual inquiry, usability testing) with specialist, professional users (Risk Managers).

Journey Mapping & Synthesis: Map complex workflows, workarounds, decision points, and failure points; synthesize findings into documented user segments, contexts, and prioritized journeys.

Hands-On Prototyping: Turn research findings into high-fidelity information architecture, interaction models, and realistic interactive prototypes (including edge cases and complex states) using Figma or equivalent tools.

Iterative Validation: Conduct multi-iteration testing with representative risk professionals to validate concepts, refine workflows, and document rationale for implementation.

Product Alignment & Challenge: Serve as an autonomous thought partner across product, engineering, and domain experts; challenge existing assumptions and propose improved structures based strictly on evidence.

Cross-Functional Handoff: Partner directly with Product Managers and engineers through the build phase, ensuring findings and decisions are thoroughly documented for seamless technical execution.

Requirements

Professional Experience: 5 to 10+ years of relevant hands-on experience in UX research and interactive product design (typically 7–12 years target range).

Research Ownership: Proven track record of personally planning, executing, and synthesizing qualitative research with specialist or professional users performing complex tasks.

Complex Systems Experience: Strong systems-thinking capability with experience designing for dense data environments, multi-step decisions, and high-consequence workflows.

Hands-On Prototyping Skills: Demonstrated expertise in building complex, data-heavy interactive prototypes from scratch.

Iterative Impact: Clear portfolio evidence showing how user research directly transformed a design iteration and led to a successfully implemented product outcome.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Experience working side-by-side with Product Managers and software engineers through to production build.

Language Proficiency: Fluent, professional spoken and written English skills to interview international users and present clear findings to a distributed team.

Location & Employment: Based in Indonesia and available for a full-time, 6-month fixed-term contract (PKWT).

Do’s (Role Expectations)

  • Do focus heavily on deep research, evidence gathering, and complex workflow mapping over visual production.
  • Do challenge current product terminology, structures, and assumptions if research data supports doing so.
  • Do present tested interactive prototypes that cover edge cases, failure points, and handoffs.
  • Do ensure every submitted case study clearly demonstrates research methodology, user evidence, iteration, and implemented outcomes.

Nice-to-Haves / Bonus Points

  • Experience in risk management, fraud detection, financial crime, AML/KYC, cybersecurity, compliance, or expert-user B2B SaaS.
  • Background in trading platforms, banking, payments, or complex data analytics tools.

Benefits

Contract Duration: 6-month fixed-term contract (PKWT).

Compensation Package: Competitive monthly salary aligned with candidate experience and standard local employment benefits.

High-Impact Autonomy: Lead a defined transformation mandate shaping a core, high-stakes product without management overhead or generic production tickets.

title: Senior Full-Stack Cloud Engineer
description:
Role Summary

OnTrac is seeking an experienced Senior Full-Stack Cloud Engineer to support our digital platform initiatives. In this role, you will design, build, test, and deploy modern full-stack application features spanning a React frontend, a Node.js REST API, and a PostgreSQL database. Working alongside internal engineering resources and partner teams, you will also manage cloud deployments, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD pipelines on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using Terraform and Docker.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Google Cloud Certification: Active certification as a GCP Associate Cloud Engineer or Professional Cloud Developer (or equivalent demonstrated depth on Google Cloud).
  • Containerization: Hands-on experience with Docker for containerizing Node.js applications and managing containerized runtime environments.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Solid proficiency writing and managing Terraform scripts to provision GCP infrastructure.
  • CI/CD Expertise: Proven ability to configure and maintain automated build, test, and deployment pipelines using Google Cloud Build or GitHub Actions.
  • Full-Stack Proficiency:
    • Frontend: Strong experience building modern, responsive UI components in React directly from Figma designs.
    • Backend: Expertise designing, building, and securing RESTful APIs with Node.js.
    • Database: Deep knowledge of PostgreSQL, including relational data modeling, writing SQL queries, and managing schema migration scripts.
  • Testing Beyond Unit Level: Hands-on experience implementing integration and end-to-end (E2E) testing strategies (e.g., Cypress, Playwright, Supertest) alongside standard unit testing.

Key Responsibilities

Application Engineering & Interface Development

  • Design and implement full-stack application features across the React frontend, Node.js backend, and PostgreSQL schema.
  • Translate design team mockups from Figma into clean, responsive, and reusable React components and views.
  • Build and maintain the REST API layer handling communication between frontend and backend services.

Database Design & Schema Management

  • Design and evolve the PostgreSQL relational data model to support new application capabilities.
  • Author SQL queries and write schema migration scripts to execute database updates safely across environments.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Write unit tests for new and modified code as a standard part of the software development lifecycle.
  • Build and maintain integration and end-to-end (E2E) tests to validate user journeys and system interactions beyond the unit level.

GCP Infrastructure & DevOps

  • Provision, deploy, and configure application components on Google Cloud Platform—including runtime services, managed PostgreSQL (Cloud SQL), and Cloud Storage—using Terraform.
  • Set up, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines covering automated builds, test execution, container image generation, and deployments.

Technical Alignment & Documentation

  • Participate in collaborative working sessions with OnTrac project teams and external partner stakeholders (such as SADA) to define requirements and establish technical approaches.
  • Author and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including system architecture, API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), and data models.

title: Trainee
company: German Marshall Fund of the United States
description:
TUPP is a groundbreaking two-week program that was launched in 2017. It was initially designed to enhance the understanding of Taiwan among future US policy leaders. Beginning in 2022, the program was expanded to include future European policy leaders. TUPP consists of two consecutive components: seminars in Washington, D.C. and a research trip to Taiwan. TUPP provides a unique opportunity for the emerging leaders from the United States and Europe to gain the necessary personal experiences in Taiwan that will enable them to appreciate Taiwan’s perspectives on cross-strait matters, Taiwan’s role in the world, and the importance of US-Taiwan relations.


Each year, the program begins with three days in Washington, D.C. where the delegation is briefed by US officials, academics, and think tank experts. This is followed by the Taiwan leg of the trip, where TUPP fellows visit several cities and meet with individuals from government, business, non-governmental organizations, and academia. The trip involves exposure to Taiwan’s culture, history, and politics.


TUPP fellows are expected to have a demonstrated history of professional achievement and interest in policy. Applicants should be between 28 and 43 years old, and have functional and/or regional expertise. Stipends are not provided, but all program-related expenses are covered. This year, TUPP will take place from February 15 – March 1, 2027.


The program offers an unparalleled opportunity for future policy leaders from the United States and Europe to benefit from exposure to Taiwan. Each participant will gain transformative in-country knowledge that will empower them to analyze future challenges involving Taiwan and undertake informed policy analysis.


Funding for TUPP is generously provided by the Henry Luce Foundation, the Taiwan Foundation for Democracy, and the Global Taiwan Institute. For any questions on the application process, please contact Jennifer Nguyen (jnguyen@gmfus.org).

title: Senior Development Associate
description:
About Bellwether

Bellwether is a national nonprofit that exists to transform education to ensure students furthest from opportunity achieve outcomes that lead to fulfilling lives and flourishing communities. We work hand in hand with education leaders and organizations to accelerate their impact, inform and influence policy and program design, and share what we learn along the way.

We are a remote-first team, and our work is national in scope, so our flexible working style allows our professionals to work where they have built their lives, which means Bellwether can hire the best person for each role, regardless of geography. This role can be based anywhere in the United States. Up to approximately 10-15% travel may be required.

Our philanthropic revenue comes almost exclusively from institutional foundation grants across 15 portfolios of work.

---

About the Role

Bellwether seeks a Senior Development Associate to join our development team. This role reports to the Senior Development Manager and works in close partnership with the Senior Director of Development and Program Team colleagues.

Bellwether’s grant portfolio is growing. This role exists to make sure growth is matched by strong reporting, clean data, and a clear view of our funder pipeline. It serves as the connective tissue between our funder relationships and our systems of record. You’ll own grant reporting end to end, build the systems that keep 15 portfolios coordinated, and give the team a reliable picture of each funder relationship.

Core Responsibilities

Grant Reporting (40%)

  • Own the full grant reporting lifecycle, from deliverable tracking through submission, ensuring every report is accurate, high-quality, and on time.
  • Collect and synthesize input from project leads, finance, and senior leadership that connects work completed to stated grant outcomes.
  • Manage the reporting calendar and funder portal logistics, including deadlines, requirements, credentials, and submission status.

Pipeline and Moves Management (20%)

  • Log funder interactions, meetings, and next steps to build institutional knowledge of these relationships.
  • Track cultivation moves against stage, owner, amount, and timing; surface stalled opportunities before they go cold.
  • Produce pipeline summaries and revenue snapshots for team meetings, board reporting, and planning cycles.

Systems and Grant Operations (20%)

  • Build and maintain the trackers, templates, and documentation that keep grant coordination consistent across the entire grant portfolio.
  • Maintain data hygiene in Salesforce for grants, funder records, and opportunity stages.
  • Write and update a grants procedure manual so processes are documented and repeatable.
  • Partner with finance to reconcile grant payments and issue timely acknowledgments.

Prospect Research (10%)

  • Identify and qualify new institutional funding prospects aligned with Bellwether’s priority areas.
  • Write concise prospect memos covering funder priorities, giving history, and recommended entry points.
  • Monitor funder announcements, requests for proposal (RFPs), and leadership changes, flagging time-sensitive opportunities for the team.

Team Contribution (10%)

  • Use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to raise the quality and speed of research, drafting, and data work, with judgment about when human review is essential.
  • Build trusted working relationships with leaders across the organization.
  • Contribute to team meetings and planning for development and external relations.
  • Travel two to four times per year for team and organization-wide convenings.

Recommended Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of nonprofit development experience, or equivalent experience.
  • Education sector and institutional/foundation giving preferred but not required.
  • Strong writing and communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex program, budget, and outcomes information into clear, compelling narratives for funder audiences.
  • Demonstrated experience with grant reporting, prospect research, and pipeline coordination.
  • Proven project management skills, including the ability to manage a high volume of deliverables, competing deadlines, and multiple stakeholders independently.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to operational detail, including managing calendars, keeping accurate records, and maintaining consistent processes and documentation.
  • Sound judgment in using AI tools, including appropriate verification of AI-generated content and careful handling of sensitive donor and organizational information.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace; Claude/ChatGPT and Salesforce experience strongly preferred.

Compensation

The base salary range for incoming team members in this role is $77,250 to $82,250 annually, with eligibility for an annual performance bonus targeted at $4,113 based on individual and organizational success. While the final offer amount will be determined by multiple factors — including previous experience and content knowledge — and may vary from the stated range, Bellwether is committed to transparency, and all offers align with our compensation philosophy.

Bellwether provides competitive compensation and an attractive benefits package that includes a performance bonus based on individual and organizational success, healthcare coverage, and a 401(k) plan with matching employer contributions.

To Apply

Use your online application — a custom letter of interest and a current resume — to show us you have the skills listed here or why the skills you have are the ones we actually need. You should also use your application materials to highlight how your background and experience align with Bellwether’s mission, including our commitment to helping young people furthest from opportunity. This role has a priority application deadline of September 17, 2026. While we prioritize applications received on or before that date, we will review applications as we receive them until the position is filled.

Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Use of AI in Hiring

Our team may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, summarizing interviews, or assessing responses. These tools help our teams work efficiently, but they never replace human judgment. Our team makes every final hiring decision. If you have questions about how we process candidate data, please reach out to us at careers@bellwether.org.

Bellwether is committed to providing equal opportunities. It is our policy to ensure that all individuals with whom we are in contact are not discriminated against based on age, race, ethnicity, color, disability, gender identity, gender expression, political viewpoint, marital status, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, or veteran status. Further, as described above, Bellwether is committed to building a diverse team and strongly encourages individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

In 2007, two software engineers and serial entrepreneurs founded our company. We’re building a best-in-class data warehousing solution, and we need a data architect to partner with the product and other teams to own the overall data architecture and data models. We push ourselves every day to get more data, create a fantastic data analytics and data science experience for our users and craft real-world solutions to unlock the value of our information.
What you’ll do:
  • Lead the architecture, design, and governance of our big data strategy
  • Implement measures to organize and model our data, ensuring the accessibility, accuracy, security, and completeness are accounted for
  • Research and suggest tools and technologies to improve data lake access, ingestion, storage, and processing methods
  • Collaborate with product, software and architecture teams to review and make recommendations about the distributed data model for our products
  • Stay up to date about compliance, regulatory and emerging industry standards and their impacts on our data solutions
  • Monitor, refine and report on the performance of data management systems
  • Work closely with and support our data consumers to develop data solutions and algorithms that make their jobs easier
  • Treat data quality as a 1st class deliverable, because it is
You have:
  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 7+ years architecting and delivering commercial cloud-based data lake solutions
  • Extensive hands-on experience with SQL and database technologies, including data modeling at the business, logical, and physical levels
  • Hands-on experience with a Big Data ecosystem using technologies such as Snowflake and/or RedShift
  • Experience implementing data acquisition solutions using a variety of software solutions
  • Experience with enterprise-scale BI and ML software solutions (e.g., Tableau, AWS Sagemaker, Periscope, Looker)
  • Highly analytical, proactive, and detail-oriented, with a deep interest in data

  • Experience in metadata management, data lineage, data governance, and data security preferred
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, demonstrating thought leadership across multiple technical and business stakeholders and leaders
What you’ll get from us:
Importantly, you’ll get a tremendous amount of authority and autonomy. You’ll own your outcomes and see measurable results for your efforts. With our unmatched transparency and trust, you’ll have open access to the data that drives our decisions.
At the same time, you’ll get sane working hours and a huge amount of flexibility around work/life balance. Have people in your life – of any age – who always, often, or sometimes need your help? We make room for that. Have a bad thing or a good thing happen to you? We make room for that, too.
Oh, and here’s what else you’ll get: Market salary, stock options you’ll help make worth a lot, the usual holidays, all-you-can-eat vacation, 401K, health/dental/FSA, long-term disability insurance, subsidized T-passes, a great office in the heart of Boston, a tremendous amount of responsibility and autonomy, wicked awesome co-workers, cupcakes (and many more goodies), and knowing that you helped get this rocket ship to the moon.

title: Dual Study Program in Business Administration - Digital Business Management (B.A.)
description:
Make your mark for patients

Start date: 1 August 2027

Locations: Monheim am Rhein and Mannheim

Academic partner: Duale Hochschule Baden-Württemberg (DHBW)

Start your journey with UCB

Are you ready to launch your career after finishing school and looking for a hands-on degree program at an international company that combines innovation with a strong focus on patients? Would you like to take on responsibility, shape your own projects and become part of a committed team? Then UCB is the right place for you!

Starting on 1 August 2027, we are offering a practice-oriented dual study program in Business Administration – Digital Business Management (B.A.) in partnership with DHBW Mannheim.

How your study program works

Getting started in Monheim am Rhein: You will begin with a two-month onboarding period before your academic studies begin, giving you the opportunity to get to know UCB, your colleagues and your fellow dual students.

Alternating theory and practice: Every three months, you will alternate between academic phases at DHBW in Mannheim and practical placements at UCB in Monheim.

Program duration: 6 semesters (3 years)

Start of studies at DHBW: October or November 2027, depending on the degree programme

Your practical placements – varied and tailored to you

Your training plan will be tailored to your interests and strengths. You will gain insight into a range of business functions, including:

  • Human Resources (HR)
  • Finance
  • Marketing and Corporate Communications
  • Digitalisation and Operational Excellence
  • Market Access
  • Drug Safety
  • Medical and Quality
  • …and many other exciting departments!

What we offer

  • Attractive remuneration in line with the German chemical industry collective agreement
  • Monthly allowance to support living expenses, such as housing cost
  • Reimbursement of travel expenses for official transitions between academic and practical phases
  • Holiday and Christmas bonuses
  • Laptop for professional use
  • Personal support from a buddy and mentor
  • Training opportunities and seminars
  • Subsidised meals in the company canteen
  • Subsidised membership with a corporate fitness provider
  • An agile, digital working environment with modern tools

What you bring

  • A general higher education entrance qualification (Abitur) or a university of applied sciences entrance qualification (Fachhochschulreife)
  • Good to very good mathematics skills
  • Good to very good written and spoken English
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint
  • The ability to work independently and some initial professional experience, for example through internships or part-time jobs
  • Active involvement in school or in extracurricular activities
  • Motivation, a willingness to learn and a goal-oriented mindset
  • A collaborative mindset, initiative and the ability to think outside the box

Important information

  • German language skills are essential, as most communication and teaching throughout the dual study program will be in German.
  • Applicants who are not German citizens or do not hold permanent residency must have a valid residence and work permit at the time of application.

Your application process

As a first step in the application process, please submit the following documents:

  • Your CV in English
  • Your most recent school reports, graduation certificate or transcript of records in German or English

Once we have received your documents, we will send you a qualification form by email. Please complete the form and return it to us. We will then verify whether you meet the eligibility criteria for the dual study program based on your CV, certificates and the information provided in the form.

If you meet the eligibility criteria, we will invite you to an online or in-person interview, depending on your location. The interview will be conducted in German. To help you feel well prepared, we will provide you with a guide in advance. During the conversation, you will have the opportunity to learn more about UCB and our dual study program—and, of course, to ask any questions you may have.

The final stage of the application process is an online assessment center, which will also be conducted in German and usually takes place in a small group. If you reach this part of the process, we will provide you with all the relevant details in advance.

Ready to take the next step?

We look forward to receiving your application and wish you every success in the selection process!

If you have any questions, please contact us: Dualstudyprogram@ucb.com

About us
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless expressly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Should you require any adjustments to our process to assist you in demonstrating your strengths and capabilities contact us on EMEA-Reasonable_Accommodation@ucb.com. Please note should your enquiry not relate to adjustments; we will not be able to support you through this channel.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
We are working to harness nature to sustainably feed the planet. We have discovered a transformational opportunity to improve global crop yield and reduce the use of agricultural chemicals and fertilizers by utilizing the core microbiome inside plants to confer material yield and crop protection benefits across a variety of crops, geographies and stresses. The challenge and opportunity for us is to gain critical first mover advantages by scaling quickly and effectively (~$1B 2020 revenue.)
The Data Scientist will enable optimal data-driven decision making and dramatically improving farmers’ outcomes.
The Data Scientist will analyze and model expected crop yield under various scenarios. Using large-scale cloud and machine learning algorithms, the Data Scientist will construct data preprocessing pipelines, predictive models, optimization algorithms, and decision support systems.
Key Outcomes:
  • Collect and preprocess IoT-scale data from on-farm and remote monitoring equipment including: yield, farm treatments, irrigation, soils, satellite and drone imagery
  • Analyze agricultural data to understand the impact of agronomic decisions on crop health and crop yield.
  • Use state-of-the-art machine learning tools to understand crop yields as a function of microbiome, crop, planting conditions, soil, weather, farm treatments, and farm conditions
  • Produce compelling and clear visualizations of agronomic and statistical findings.
  • Partner closely with Software Development to turn Data Science products into best-in-class end-user applications.
Key Competencies:
  • Masters Degree + 2-5 years industry experience in a relevant field such as applied computer science, machine learning, mathematics, statistics, quantitative agronomy, environmental science, applied physics or engineering.
  • Outstanding communication skills - Outgoing and enthusiastically enjoys explaining statistical analyses and methods to customers and decision makers throughout the organization.
  • Experience in and/or eagerness to learn about agriculture, agronomy, GIS, spatial statistics, plant biology, microbiology, agricultural economics, and the plant microbiome.
  • Absolutely high fluency with R and/or Python and Bayesian MCMC tools such as JAGS or STAN, as well as conventional statistical analyses, machine learning, and GIS. Strong ability to produce lucid graphical plots, maps, and highly interactive visualizations. Experience working in various computational environments, such Linux, ec2, S3, Spark, and H2O.
  • Team player – someone who thrives working in cross functional teams throughout the organization.
  • A curious, scientific mind dedicated to teasing apart new results through careful, quantitative analysis joined with sound scientific practice.
  • Extremely strong customer focus, seeing growers and agronomists as our key end users, and grower success as our ultimate goal.
  • Easily adapts to new types of problems and questions. Flexible to different types of analysis and different stakeholders (e.g. lab science, field trials, commercial team).
  • Experience working in industry and a dedication to Data Science performed in an industrial setting.
  • Deep understanding of modern Bayesian statistics, ensemble classifiers, regression algorithms, as well as off the shelf machine learning techniques. Experience with model validation and evaluation, and data imputation.
  • Familiarity with SQL as well as NoSQL columnar databases. Experience with MILP, combinatorial optimization, metaheuristics, and other types of optimization are an added advantage.
  • Experience with agronomy or ecology work including modeling, forecasting, decision support, and optimization

title: Research Engineer – Machine Learning, Java, Computational Linguistics
description:
Overview:

We're seeking a mid-level Research Engineer to help build out some very exciting capabilities. This is an applied research and development position. The Research Engineer will work on machine learning, computational linguistics, graph analytics, predictive analytics, knowledge representation, and generally advanced analytics for recruiting-oriented AI. This role requires an ability to recommend and implement appropriate modeling approaches and communicate and share findings. This position reports to the Head of AI.

Responsibilities:
  • Apply quantitative, analytical, and creative skills to design, develop, and test projects independently and jointly with other team members to deliver powerful functionalities for generating recruiting automation systems.
  • Explore applied research ideas and formulate and execute R&D projects in machine learning, computational linguistics, knowledge representation, advanced analytics, predictive analytics, and graph analytics.
  • Research, design, and develop novel algorithms.
  • Collaborate with architects, software developers, and product management to design and program innovative strategic and tactical solutions that meet market needs with respect to functionality, performance, reliability, realistic implementation schedules, and adherence to development goals and principles.
  • Take ownership of certain parts of our platform, especially ones you pioneer.
  • Integrate our platform with open-source and other third-party components in the machine learning, computational linguistics, advanced analytics, and unstructured analytics domains.
  • Gather and determine requirements for new features.
  • Develop and document intellectual property.
  • Effectively communicate product architectures, design proposals, and discuss option tradeoffs with AI management, engineering management, and team members.
  • Help to train new and existing talent in research, engineering, and solutions.

Required Skills:
  • Knowledge of machine learning fundamentals and implementation.
  • Experience in two or more of the following areas: machine learning, statistical modeling, computational linguistics, optimization, algorithms, analytics software development, big data analytics, natural language processing, data mining, or predictive analytics.
  • Strong statistical/math/analytical abilities and exceptional problem solving skills.
  • Expertise in object-oriented design methodology and software development in Java.
  • Solid computing background with a thorough understanding of the fundamentals of computer science, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Excellent communication, teamwork, and technical writing skills.

Required Education and Experience Level:
  • Master’s degree, or equivalent, in Computer Science. Exceptional candidates with Statistics, Math, Linguistics, Operations Research, Engineering, or related fields may also be considered.
  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in progressively more responsible research engineering roles.

Preferred, But Optional, Skills:
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, TensorBoard, Keras, or dl4j.
  • Significant experience writing code is preferred.
  • Staying in touch with the latest findings, trends, best emerging practices, and techniques in machine learning, data mining, search, graph analytics, computational linguistics, knowledge representation, big data analytics, and/or statistics.
  • Java threading, concurrency, locking, and using shared resources.
  • Experience developing semantic search capabilities.
  • Understanding of graph analytics and graph algorithms.
  • Exposure to rule mining, semantic vector spaces, entity recognition, dialogue systems, and text analytics.
  • Experience in using semantics, e.g. ontologies, knowledgebases, knowledge graph approaches.
  • Strong in linear algebra and/or multivariate statistics.
  • Experience with both approximate algorithms and exact analytical methods.
  • Experience working with rules engines or the semantic web.
  • Strong in regular expressions.
  • Expertise in statistical modeling techniques such as clustering, classification, regression, recommenders, dimensionality reduction, feature creation, feature selection, and advanced statistical models in general.
  • Knowledge of indices such as Solr, Lucene, or ElasticSearch.
  • Evaluation of fits, error metrics, and model diagnostics to assess model performance.
  • Experience exploring large datasets, identifying key patterns and structures that can be exploited or modeled to create features and improve forecasting performance.
  • Javascript-heavy front-end development experience.
  • Experience as a developer on large software development projects.

description:

To protect the interests of all parties, Canopy Connect will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. description:

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:

Our system currently accepts orders from a number of different sources including our Android tablets (keyed by waitstaff), consumers (online orders) and partners (via our APIs). This code is executed multiple times by every single order that enters the system. We are dealing with problems of scale and representing billions of dollars in value to our customers. As we continue to grow, we expect the demands for orders and entry points into our system to increase rapidly. In order (pardon the pun) to meet these demands, we will need to build a system that is both increasingly extensible, robust, scalable and deliverable continuously. We need your help to improve our platform and add the next generation of features to this absolutely mission critical part of our product.
Some projects we’ve been working on recently include:
  • Creating a unified Pricing Module to be shared across all clients powered by our system
  • Pluggable, modular, configurable Taxation Module to support a much wider variety of different tax codes (at the local / state level)
  • Re-architect how we deal with historical orders using immutable data; allowing archival of historical data to separate analytics data store
  • Tooling which allows for the running of millions of historical checks against new Pricing algorithms to compare differences
  • Expanding functionality of our APIs to support more and more clients
As a staff software engineer on the orders team, you will be:
  • Designing, building and maintaining high performance, flexible and highly scalable web and mobile applications
  • Participating in designing, estimating effort, implementing, testing, debugging, configuring, integrating and documenting database, middle-tier and front-end code

  • Actively contributing to product design and feature selection discussions
  • Participating in code reviews to ensure technical implementations meet functional requirements

If you’re someone that is:
  • Proficient in Java
  • Well-versed in tiered web application architecture and databases
  • Passionate about building great software
  • A lifelong learner
  • Known for having a get unblocked attitude
Bonus Points (but not necessary):

title: Engagement Lead
description:
ORCID is seeking an experienced and enthusiastic professional for the position of fully remote Engagement Lead. If you like the flexibility of a remote organization and the public-service orientation of a non-profit, join us on our mission to connect research and researchers!

The Role

ORCID is seeking an Engagement Lead to drive community growth, membership, and product adoption within North America. The role focuses on fostering member relationships, managing new membership development, and ensuring member success to support ORCID's sustainability, mission, and core strategies.

The position will be part of our Engagement team, reporting to the Director of Engagement and is full time (40 hours/week).

Like all positions at ORCID, the role is fully remote. Candidates must be able to work during eastern US standard business hours (Mon-Fri) with at least four hours daily between 9:00 AM-2:00 PM ET, with some recurring meetings between 10:00 AM-1:00 PM ET. Outside of these parameters, ORCID offers flexibility with your schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Member Engagement & Growth
    • Foster and manage relationships with members and stakeholders in assigned segments in North America to ensure renewals.
    • New membership development: Identify, develop, and close new membership opportunities.
    • Integration development: Increase the depth, number and diversity of integrations to improve data contribution.
    • Member support: Coordinate and execute member support requests in collaboration with other ORCID staff where relevant, to ensure high member satisfaction and value.
    • Consortium Lead engagement: Coordinate and align with assigned Consortium Lead organizations through regular meetings and strategic planning, to advance ORCID’s mission, grow memberships, and increase adoption, ensuring a consistently collaborative approach.
    • Advise your manager on strategic opportunities & direction: Provide insights and recommendations related to your assigned members and region(s), to inform strategic decision making.
  • Community Building & Outreach
    • Fostering the core values of ORCID: Build global "communities of practice" within your assigned segments and/or regions.
    • Events strategy and outreach coordination: Assist in defining and executing outreach initiatives, collaborating with various ORCID teams as needed.
    • Events participation: Present and represent ORCID at in-person and virtual events where needed, manage travel and administration as required, and handle abstract submission and application processes where needed
  • Operational Excellence & Collaboration
    • Process Management: Consistently follow and execute on defined processes and procedures. Actively contribute to identifying opportunities for process improvement and collaborate with colleagues to enhance operational efficiency.
    • "One ORCID team": Actively cooperate with and inform colleagues to foster transparency, collaboration, and achieve the best outcomes for the organization.
    • Cross-Team Collaboration: Participate in cross-team initiatives and projects, collaborating with colleagues in other ORCID teams as needed to support shared goals.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • 3+ years experience in a consultative business development, account management or externally facing product-related role
  • Proven track record in developing and maintaining new organizational relationships
  • 2+ plus years of experience working with the Scholarly Community, ideally within open research or open scholarly infrastructure
  • Experience setting, coordinating and achieving strategic goals with external partners
  • Experience working and engaging in global, multicultural, and virtual team environments
  • Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills
  • Knowledge of CRM tools (e.g. Salesforce)
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and balance competing priorities
  • Fluency in English. Additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to travel based upon business needs (less than 25%)

To Apply: Please submit your CV and a cover letter via Bamboo. In your cover letter, outline how your experience aligns with the roles and responsibilities of this position. ORCID encourages applicants who meet some, but not all of the requirements and qualifications, to apply.

Who We Are

ORCID is a mission-driven, member-supported, community-governed non-profit organization. Our vision is a world where all who participate in research, scholarship, and innovation are uniquely identified and connected to their contributions across disciplines, borders, and time. Every one of ORCID’s employees is committed to that vision as well.

We believe in and operate by our three values. ORCID strives to be:

  • Inclusive: We make decisions collaboratively, involving our staff, Board, those who support our mission, and the researchers and community that are the purpose of our work. We take a global view.
  • Trusted: Privacy and researcher control underscores everything we do.
  • Open: Our work is open, transparent, and non-proprietary.

Where We’re Located

As a fully-remote organization serving researchers everywhere, ORCID is able to hire talented individuals all over the globe, and we aim to have our people located in the communities that we serve. For this position, we are focusing on people located in the United States.

Our Culture

ORCID has been a global, 100% remote organization since our founding in 2012. This has enabled us to build a team of the best and brightest minds in the industry. ORCID staff are curious and collaborative, and we strive to maintain a culture of learning. We offer programs like individually-focused professional development planning, monthly “Food for Thought” learning sessions on a wide variety of topics, and access to a digital learning platform, Udemy for Business. We are flexible and family-friendly, allowing staff to shift their schedules as needed, flex their time across the calendar month, and take an hour-long paid break each day (not to mention OFF– see the benefits we provide below).

As an organization, we are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion (DEI). We invite you to read our DEI statement and principles as well as learn about internal and external DEI initiatives we support here. Read more about our culture here.

Although we are geographically diverse, we are a small, cohesive community dedicated to our mission and to each other.

As an open organization valuing trust and transparency, we have an employee and contractor privacy policy describing how we handle applicant, employee and contractor data that we invite you to review if interested.

We provide:

A family-friendly, flexible working environment, including:

  • Flexible work hours and the ability to work fully from home (when not traveling)
  • A committed and awesome team serving a community-driven organization
  • Competitive compensation & benefits, including a generous annual leave allowance, leave for Family & Compassionate Care, and an ORCID-wide day off on the Fourth Friday of each month
  • A continuous learning environment with opportunities for training & professional development
  • Tools to support our virtual office environment, including a monthly remote working stipend.
  • An annual in-person all staff retreat plus optional virtual social events throughout the year.

Compensation

ORCID’s compensation strategy considers an applicant’s skills and experience, geographic location, as well as internal equity when assessing salary. Because we are remote and hire staff all over the globe, our salary ranges will vary by location for any given role.

The compensation for this role will be $60-$90k USD annually, or local equivalent, depending upon location, skills, and experience.

Salary: $60-$90k USD annually, or local equivalent, depending upon location, skills, and experience

title: Senior Backend Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Our platform runs on .NET microservices. How those services are cut, how data flows between them, and how they reach production is decided by the people who build them — and we'd like you to be one of them.

You'll work closely with our software architects, product owners, and fellow developers: code reviews, pair programming, and the technical decisions that stick around.

  • You design and build microservices in C# and .NET Core 10 that carry our core business processes.
  • You own the data model: schemas in Postgres, caching in Redis where it pays off, reliable messaging over RabbitMQ.
  • You take services to production and keep the CI/CD pipeline fast enough that nobody avoids it.
  • You catch bottlenecks, security risks, and failure modes before users do.
  • You push for clean code and automated testing, and you share what you know instead of sitting on it.
  • You use coding agents as part of your daily workflow — directing their work, reviewing their output, and fixing what doesn't hold up. Writing code matters; knowing what good code looks like matters more.
  • You've spent several years building backend services in C# and .NET.
  • You've worked with microservice architectures and run Postgres, Redis, and RabbitMQ in production.
  • You know your way around architecture principles, performance optimization, and secure scalability.
  • You work well in agile teams (Scrum/Kanban), you write clearly, and you're comfortable in English.
  • You have a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field — or the experience that makes one unnecessary.
  • You've worked with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. We're not in the cloud yet, so this is a plus, not a requirement.
We care as much about how you approach a problem as about which frameworks you know. You look past the edges of your own ticket: you notice when a fix really belongs in a different service, you question a process once it has stopped making sense, and you judge your work by whether the whole system got better — not by whether your part shipped. "Not my code" isn't a sentence we use much around here. You're joining at a point where the engineering foundations themselves are being rebuilt around AI-native workflows — not retrofitted onto legacy decisions, but designed now, while the architecture is still being shaped. That means you don't inherit someone else's five-year-old choices: you help make the calls on how services are split, where AI agents fit into the workflow, and what "good" looks like technically around here. Few Senior roles hand you this much real influence over the foundation rather than the features on top of it.
On the practical side: 30 days of vacation, up to 50 workation days a year, a sabbatical option, Hansefit, pension contributions and an employee loan program, plus a range of travel-industry discounts on your own trips. Fully remote with no relocation required, a hiring process that's three steps end to end, and no bureaucratic layers slowing down a "yes." We're rated 4.7/5 on Trustpilot — what you build ships to real people, not into the void. We're fully remote, so you work from wherever you do your best thinking. Agentic coding is part of our day-to-day, not a side experiment: we work with Claude Code across the team, and we'd want you to have an opinion about where it helps, where it doesn't, and how to review what it produces. If that's already your workflow, you'll feel at home. If it isn't yet, you'll pick it up here. Three steps, no surprises:
  1. Online interview with HR
  2. Online interview with our Head of Engineering
  3. On-site interview with the team

title: Security Architect | AI & Cloud Platforms
description:
Salary: Competitive Day Rate

Are you an experienced Security Architect or Senior Security Engineer with strong zero-trust multi-tenancy and confidential computing experience, looking to shape the security of advanced AI and cloud platforms?

Would you like to combine hands-on technical delivery with architecture ownership in a specialist role open to candidates across Australia?

Please note: Practical experience in BOTH zero-trust multi-tenancy and confidential computing is essential and non-negotiable. Senior and Principal Security Engineers ready to step into an architecture role are encouraged to apply.

Our client is delivering advanced AI infrastructure and cloud platforms and is seeking a Domain Architect | AI Security to lead security design and implementation across shared infrastructure, platform services and AI workloads.

You do not need to have held this exact job title. We understand this is an emerging area and your most recent experience may not yet be reflected on your CV. We are interested in what you have designed, implemented and secured.

THE ROLE
You will act as a key technical authority for security, working closely with platform, infrastructure and solutions teams to translate architectural designs into practical controls.

The role combines approximately 60% hands-on delivery and implementation with 40% technical advisory and pre-sales support, including client workshops, solution scoping and estimates.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Designing and enforcing zero-trust tenant isolation across shared infrastructure
  • Implementing confidential computing to protect data during processing through attested, encrypted-in-use execution
  • Validating tenant isolation and preventing cross-tenant access before onboarding
  • Securing Kubernetes and OpenShift environments through access controls, admission policies and platform hardening
  • Implementing secrets management, identity federation and workload identity
  • Embedding security controls through automation, policy-as-code and GitOps
  • Strengthening AI workload protection, software supply chain security and runtime threat detection
  • Leading technical discussions with clients and contributing to solution designs, statements of work and delivery estimates
You will work across an environment that includes NVIDIA BlueField/DOCA, NVIDIA Confidential Computing, Kubernetes/OpenShift, HashiCorp Vault, OPA/Kyverno and AI security tooling.

ABOUT YOU
You will be technically strong, comfortable working hands-on and confident explaining security decisions to engineers and senior stakeholders.
You may currently be a Security Architect, Principal Security Engineer, Senior Cloud Security Engineer or Platform Security Lead with the experience and capability to take on broader architectural responsibility.

You must bring:
  • Zero-trust multi-tenancy experience, including tenant isolation, micro-segmentation, access boundaries and validation of separation between tenants
  • Confidential computing experience, including attested execution and protecting data in use
  • Strong Kubernetes or container platform security expertise
  • Experience with identity, access controls, secrets management and workload security
  • Security automation experience using tools such as Python, Ansible, Helm or GitOps
  • The ability to turn security requirements into practical, repeatable technical controls
  • Strong communication skills and confidence leading technical discussions
Experience with NVIDIA security technologies, AI workload protection, model security, runtime detection or software supply chain controls will be particularly relevant.

Experience within a systems integrator or delivering solutions for regulated or sovereign environments would also be advantageous.

ROLE DETAILS
  • 12-month contract with view for extension
  • Australia-wide opportunity with remote options
  • ASAP start
  • Competitive contract rate, negotiable based on specialist expertise
  • Hands-on architecture ownership across advanced AI infrastructure
  • A combination of technical delivery, client advisory and solution design
This is an opportunity to apply deep security engineering expertise to an emerging area of AI infrastructure and take ownership of how complex platforms are secured.

If your relevant experience is not yet on your CV, please include a brief note outlining your work in zero-trust multi-tenancy and confidential computing, the technologies involved and your personal contribution.

For a confidential discussion, please hit APPLY or contact Georgia Engel at Northbridge Recruitment on 0485 029 335.

title: Software Engineer/Data Scientist
description:
The New Technologies teaml is a small unit of creative engineers and scientists who work on the mission of passive sensing: extracting weather-related information from anything. We especially like the “a-ha” look on people’s faces when they say “Wait a minute! That’s a really cool way to figure out if it’s raining or not!”

If you are a hands-on problem solver, a data geek, and love to test, build, and see results, we want you on our team.

As a New Technologies Software Engineer/Data Scientist, you will run and own data verticals, execute proof-of-concept experiments, and prepare the sources for deployment into our product. You will use your very strong coding skills to gain a deep understanding of the product and build the data acquisition and analysis methodology. You will develop ways to leverage public and proprietary data to predict weather conditions using statistical methods, signal processing, and machine learning; you will find innovative ways to leverage data for weather prediction; and you will take your ideas from experimentation/prototype to production.


We have:
  • A top-notch web application and API using many, many different data sources.
  • We move fast. Very fast. Like a cheetah. Or faster. What’s the fastest animal? A peregrine falcon. We move like a peregrine falcon.
  • An idea meritocracy - an open mind to any idea, from anyone, on any level, in any part of the organization.
  • A team of do-ers and go-getters with a “can- do” attitude.
You have:
  • Strong facility with some combination of: machine learning techniques (neural networks/deep learning, Gaussian processes, etc.), ML software frameworks (TensorFlow, Torch, etc.), statistics, and/or signal processing, ideally in a geospatial environment.
  • 3+ years prior industry experience as a data scientist or software engineer. You think in a modular way that creates clear interfaces between your building blocks.
  • Python expertise and familiarity leveraging the Python stack (pandas, scikit-learn, xarray, dask, numba, etc.) to build analysis tools and data processing pipelines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
You might also have:
  • Experience with recognition and classification algorithms for video, audio, and images.
  • Experience in developing large-scale, customer-facing web applications and APIs using cloud services.
  • Knowledge of distributed data systems (Hadoop, Spark, MapReduce).
  • Familiarity with computing on the cloud.
  • An advanced degree in EE/CS, physics, applied math, or a similar technical field.

title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer/DevOps
description:
We’re looking for a top-notch, hands-on SRE to lead our small and talented infrastructure engineering team and help us elevate our game when it comes to designing, building and operating high-performance and highly-available systems.
Every engineer is responsible for the software they build, and SREs play a critical part in providing the tools, practices, and expertise to support them.
Our production systems are hosted in AWS data centers running a large Ruby on Rails web application and a handful of smaller services in Ruby, Node.js, and Java. We currently deploy an average of 5 times a day. Our systems are stable and fire drills are rare.

Technologies we’re currently using include:
  • Amazon Web Services (EC2, ELB, S3, RDS, ElastiCache) and Ubuntu Linux
  • Postgres, Redis, Memcached, ElasticSearch
  • Chef, ServerSpec, Terraform, NewRelic, DataDog, Sumo Logic and Test Kitchen

In this mission-critical role, what you'll do:

  • Design, build and maintain the core infrastructure
  • Actively manage the backlog for our infrastructure team and work closely with other SREs on the team to provide coaching and mentorship
  • Help us increase developer productivity and get to true continuous delivery
  • Develop operational and security standards and champion operational excellence and secure coding practices
  • Partner with engineering teams closely to educate and consult
  • Participate in solution design for new features, products, systems, and tooling
  • Debug complex problems across the whole stack
  • Continually monitor application/system performance and costs, generate actionable insights and either implement or advocate for them
  • Participate in on-call rotations, along with every member of the engineering team
  • Ruthlessly eliminate repetitive manual tasks and recurring errors
  • Ensure we are always employing best-of-breed tooling for all our infrastructure and automation needs
  • Collaboratively plot course for the maturing and growth of our infrastructure
  • Participate (and sometimes run point) in handling production incidents
  • Work closely with engineering teams to conduct root cause analysis for production incidents, and evolve infrastructure and tooling.

This role might be that rare opportunity if you have:

  • Thrive in a highly collaborative, no red-tape, rapid-growth environment
  • Love building tooling and infrastructure to help developers be more productive
  • Love eliminating repetitive manual tasks through automation
  • Have a healthy appreciation of what it means to work in production
  • Have solid Unix command line and systems chops
  • Have experience with substantial, distributed SaaS or eCommerce systems
  • Can point to a solid track record of success leading small-to-medium infrastructure teams
  • Have vision and well-informed opinions about how to build infrastructure for a high-growth, technology-driven company that’s headed towards the $1B mark

What you’ll get from us:

Importantly, you’ll get sane working hours and a huge amount of flexibility around work/life balance. Have people in your life – of any age – who always, often, or sometimes need your help? We make room for that. Have a bad thing or a good thing happen to you? We make room for that, too.
Oh, and here’s what else you’ll get: Market salary, stock options you’ll help make worth a lot, the usual holidays, all-you-can-eat vacation, 401K, health/dental/FSA, long-term disability insurance, subsidized T-passes, a great office smack-dab in Boston’s Downtown Crossing, a tremendous amount of responsibility and autonomy, wicked awesome co-workers, cupcakes (and many more goodies), and knowing that you helped get this rocket ship to the moon.

Product Experience - Owning and optimizing the frontend experience of our app in conjunction with the Product team, ensuring existing features remain best-in-class while continually launching new capabilities allowing marketers to easily make data-driven decisions, and send targeted communication.

Integrations - Operating a reliable and scalable system to handle the chaotic world of 3rd party integrations. We integrates with 50+ discrete 3rd party platforms hitting tens of thousands of unique API endpoints on the web daily. We’re continually pulling billions of data points monthly, and are looking for a polyglot lead to manage our extensions and integrations.

Analytics & Segmentation - Scaling a data pipeline & storage system already processing billions of events and doubling year over year. We are challenged to perform real-time segmentation of hundreds of millions of users, enabling our teams and our customers to answer complex queries in fixed time to gain insight.

Lead Engineers are expected to spend the majority of their time coding while also working to level up the engineers on their team. Opportunities are available both for Lead Engineers that want to manage team members and grow in people management skills and responsibilities, as well as those that strictly desire to progress on a technical leadership track.

What you’ll be doing:
  • Have the chance to wholly own features that thousands of our customers rely on daily to reach 100,000,000+ of consumers to drive their business forward.
  • Work on crafting our highly scalable real-time data pipeline that processes billions of events monthly across data sets growing to petabyte scale.
  • Lead your team by example, working with them to level up their code quality through code reviews and 1on1 mentorship, creating & vetting technical architectures, and writing code yourself that raises the bar for engineering.
  • Be empowered to own the mission, technical direction and operations of projects that have immediate impact.
  • Advance your technical skills in all facets ranging from front end web development and user experience to machine learning and massively parallelized data pipelines.
  • Contribute to the company as a subject matter expert in multiple areas, constantly pushing yourself to be a better engineer and to level up all of your peers within your team and within our organization.
Technologies We Use:

We operate a real-time data platform coded in Python built for massive scale on Amazon Web Services (AWS). Engineers come here with experience in a variety of languages and from a number of disciplines. The core platform is comprised of the following components that all engineers are expected to become extremely proficient:

Python, Django, Celery
MySQL, Cassandra, RabbitMQ, Redis
HTML, JavaScript, LESS, Backbone.js, React
Amazon Web Services (EC2, RDS, Aurora, etc.)Terraform, Ansible, Packer, and other DevOps tools

Problems We’re Solving

As a high growth startup we look for candidates that can rise to any occasion and seek out new opportunities to make their mark on our product. The following are examples of exciting projects the engineering team is working on:

Scaling our data processing systems to handle orders of magnitude more data and perform advanced analytics of billions of events in real time by innovating on event-driven data pipelines and building robust distributed data stores

Overhauling our frontend interfaces to dramatically increase information density and capabilities of our analytics and reporting system. We will enable powerful, expressive and flexible querying of our data sets without compromising the ease of use of the experience

Reliably integrating with 10s of thousands of remote API endpoints to process ecommerce data for historical and real-time syncs

title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
Do you enjoy taking ownership to ensure you get the job done?

Partner with the best

Fuel your passion

· Hold a diploma or above. Major in Mechanical, Manufacturing Engineering, or related disciplines.

· Have experience in manufacturing industry. Minimum of one year of experience in mechanical products or quality inspection.

· Have ability to read/interpret machining and engineering drawings. Be proficient in the use of various measuring instruments and inspection tools.

· Have comprehensive knowledge of inspection methods and quality control practices.

· Be Familiar with ISO 9000 Quality Management System standards and procedures.

· Have basic English and fluent Mandarin communication skills. Be proficient in Microsoft Office.

· Have good attention to detail with a high level of accuracy. Solid teamwork and collaboration skills. Hardworking, self-motivated, and results-driven.

Work in a way that works for you

· This role is a Full Time Regular, with normal office-based working hours; Monday - Friday, 8:30 AM - 5 PM.

Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:

· Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities

title: Aero Modelling Student Placement
description:
Company

ALPINE RACING LIMITED

Job Description

Duration: 1 year
Start Date: July 2027

About Us

We are a high-performance Formula One team driven by innovation, precision, and passion. Our Aerodynamic Modelling group plays a key role in understanding and predicting airflow behaviour around the car, enabling data-driven decisions that shape aerodynamic development. As an Aero Modelling Student Placement, you’ll be part of a team that combines physics, simulation, and data science to support the design and optimisation of aerodynamic concepts.

The Role

As an Aero Modelling Student Placement, you’ll support the development and refinement of aerodynamic models and tools used to predict and analyse car performance across testing domains. You’ll research, implement and deploy solutions utilising a range of statistical analysis, ML & AI techniques to extract performance-targeted insights from our aerodynamic datasets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in developing and validating aerodynamic models and simulation tools

  • Help analyse airflow behaviour and aerodynamic performance trends

  • Contribute to the development of data analysis and visualisation workflows

  • Collaborate with design and performance teams to ensure aerodynamic insights are effectively applied

Who We’re Looking For

  • Currently studying for a degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Engineering, Maths, Physics) and seeking an industry placement in your penultimate year of university

  • Strong understanding of fluid dynamics and aerodynamic principles

  • A demonstrable interest in developing statistical modelling and analysis solutions to real world problems, with significant programming experience in Python (or Matlab)

  • Familiarity with vehicle dynamics and race-car performance factors is beneficial

  • Passion for motorsport and a proactive, analytical mindset

  • You must have the right to work in the UK, as we cannot provide sponsorship for this role

  • Be available to attend onsite for an assessment centre in September

What We Offer in Return

At Alpine Formula One Team, you won’t just contribute; you’ll make a direct impact on race car performance at the pinnacle of motorsport. Working alongside some of the most talented individuals in the industry, you’ll help shape innovation on a global stage.

Our purpose-built facilities in Enstone provide the perfect environment to thrive. We offer a competitive salary, private medical healthcare, full access to our free on-site gym, a fully catered canteen with a daily allowance and a wide range of additional benefits designed to support your wellbeing and growth.

Beyond the perks, you’ll be part of a team that’s pushing boundaries in Formula One. The thrill of pioneering cutting-edge technology, combined with a collaborative and inclusive culture, creates unmatched opportunities for career development and personal achievement.

Take the next step in your career and play your part in shaping the future of Formula One.

Diversity and Inclusion

At Alpine F1 Team, we celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can be their true selves. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, ethnicities, cultures, and experiences. We are committed to leading by example in promoting diversity, inclusion, and belonging in our society.

Alpine Racing UK

We find strength in our diversity and we are engaged to ensure equal employment opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, etc. If you have a disability or special need requiring layout of the workstation or work schedule, please let us know by completing this form.

title: EMT-B
description:
Procare is hiring EMTs for our Dedicated Ambulance Services Programs and Other Shifts! Procare has been providing MIH services since April 2020, giving our clinicians an opportunity to care for our patients in the comfort of their own homes and helping to reduce unnecessary hospital admissions and readmissions, and reducing hospital lengths of stay! We are making a difference here at Procare! We are looking for safe, professional, skilled, kind and caring EMTs and EMRs to serve alongside a cohesive family of everyday heroes. Through our Work/Life Balance program, we provide our employees with flexible scheduling, paid time off, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), an anonymous compliance hotline, seated massage, meditation sessions, and a supportive working environment with a responsive management team. · National Certification preferred.

· Experience in providing care in an inter-facility transport environment preferred.

· For drivers, a valid Driving License with no points on your driving record.

· Operating within certification level at all times.

· Demonstrate values of Safety, Quality, Compliance and Teamwork.

· Ability to safely lift 150 lbs. and move patients of all shapes and sizes.

· Ability to navigate stretchers safely in unknown environments such as hospitals, facilities, nursing homes, doctor's offices and residences, including moving stretchers safely up and down ramps and over rough or uneven terrain.

· Treat all patients equally, with professionalism, dignity, and respect.

· Complete end of shift requirements in accordance with policies and procedures.

title: Senior Director, Quality Control
description:
Associate Director, Chemical Engineering

Nurix Therapeutics is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of targeted protein degradation medicines, the next frontier in innovative drug design aimed at improving treatment options for patients with cancer and inflammatory diseases. Powered by a fully AI-integrated discovery engine capable of tackling any protein class, and coupled with unparalleled ligase expertise, Nurix’s dedicated team has built a formidable advantage in translating the science of targeted protein degradation into clinical advancements. Nurix aims to establish degrader-based treatments at the forefront of patient care, writing medicine’s next chapter with a new script to outmatch disease.

Position Description

Nurix is seeking an experienced, independent, and highly motivated individual who will be accountable for end‑to‑end chemical engineering support of bexobrutideg (NX-5948) drug substance (DS) from late‑stage development through commercial launch, including oversight of external manufacturing sites. The Associate Director, Chemical Engineering will work closely with the CMC team and colleagues in cross-functional departments to provide scientific, technical, and hands-on leadership and oversight of facility and equipment operations at Contract Development Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs) to support bexobrutideg drug substance manufacturing process optimization and scale-up. The position will report to the Director, Chemical Development.

Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

  • Provide engineering leadership to design, develop and optimize scalable routes for small-molecule DS manufacturing, including demonstrated knowledge in unit operation design, process modeling, process equipment selection and scale-up methodologies.
  • Review equipment configurations, qualification packages, and maintenance records at CDMOs to ensure equipment trains are properly qualified, maintained and operating at optimal performance to support Nurix manufacturing operations.
  • Oversee equipment engineering and scale-up operations at DS CDMOs, including hands‑on process troubleshooting during engineering, clinical, registration and PPQ batches.
  • Lead technology transfer to CDMOs including scale-up and demonstration of new chemical processes in development and commercial equipment.
  • Coordinate with CDMOs and Nurix Quality Assurance, and Global Supply Chain functions to ensure timely manufacture and release of DS lots.
  • Partner within Nurix CMC to drive process understanding (critical process parameters, critical quality attributes, control strategy) using engineering principles, DoE and QbD concepts.
  • Review and approve Master Batch Records, campaign reports, deviation investigations and change controls for drug substance operations.
  • Ensure manufacturing operations adhere to company quality, safety and regulatory standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, cGMP).
  • Provide regular Person-In-Plant support for DS manufacturing and ongoing performance monitoring of key facility and operational KPIs across manufacturing sites, including schedule adherence, batch performance, deviation trends, and inspection readiness.
  • Author and review CMC sections of regulatory filings including INDs/IMPD, and NDA/MAA, including responses to Health Authority queries.
  • Define and drive the long‑term engineering strategy for bexobrutideg DS, including process robustness, lifecycle management, and cost‑of‑goods optimization.
  • Represent Chemical Engineering on CMC and cross‑functional program teams, providing input to development strategy, risk assessments, and timelines.
  • Manage and provide technical mentorship of scientists and engineers.

Required Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in chemical engineering, or related field with at least 5 years (M.S. with 10 years or B.S. with 15 years) of industrial, late-phase, small-molecule drug substance development experience
  • Extensive knowledge and experience in GMP drug substance manufacturing, characterization, process development, equipment evaluation/selection, scale up and process validation.
  • Knowledge of solid‑state properties, polymorphism, and crystallization principles relevant to small‑molecule drug substance.
  • Extensive third-party drug substance CDMO management experience including tech transfer activities, QbD and DoE studies, clinical supply production, registration batch production and commercial launch activities.
  • In-depth knowledge of relevant cGMP, ICH, FDA and EMA guidelines.
  • Proven track record of effective internal and external collaboration.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, interpersonal skills and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to multi-task, manage conflict and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of their time.

Fit with Nurix Culture and Values

  • Strong team orientation; highly collaborative
  • Solutions and results-oriented focus
  • Hands-on approach; resourceful and open to diverse points of view

Salary Range: $189,800 - $216,700

Location: Brisbane, CA - Onsite
