title: Production Planner
description:
Company Overview


Spike Electric Controls is a switchgear manufacturer supporting complex power distribution projects. The Production Control organization converts customer commitments, engineering releases, material availability, vendor performance, and shop capacity into executable plans that support predictable delivery, controlled material flow, and reliable production readiness.


Position Summary


The Production Planner is responsible for translating the company master schedule into detailed, executable plans for Fabrication, Procurement, and Outsourced Operations. This role turns high-level schedule requirements into clear priorities, work packages, material readiness plans, and department-level execution plans that support on-time production and project delivery.


The Production Planner works closely with the Master Scheduling function, PMO, Production Control Manager, Fabrication, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, outside vendors, and project stakeholders to anticipate constraints, resolve shortages, coordinate priorities, and ensure that work is released to Production only when it is ready to execute.


Why This Role Matters


This role is a critical control point between the company schedule and the shop floor. The Planner protects schedule integrity by ensuring that work is properly planned, sequenced, resourced, and authorized before it reaches Production. Nothing is issued to Production without Planner sign-off.


Key Responsibilities


Schedule Translation and Execution Planning


· Break down the master schedule into smaller, executable plans for Fabrication, Procurement, and Outsourced Operations.


· Develop clear daily, weekly, and project-level priorities that are usable by departments and execution teams.


· Sequence work based on schedule requirements, department capacity, material availability, engineering readiness, and downstream assembly needs.


· Ensure work packages are complete, accurate, and ready before release to Production.


· Maintain visibility to what is coming to fabrication and production, what is currently in process, and what is moving toward final assembly.


Procurement and Outsource Planning


· Plan and monitor all purchased commercial material, raw materials, and outsourced work required to support assigned projects.


· Coordinate with Buyers, Procurement, and vendors to validate material status and schedule impact; Buyers place purchase orders, while Planners verify status, check alignment to schedule, and escalate or expedite as needed.


· Coordinate outsourced fabrication, welding, painting, bending, and other vendor-performed operations that augment internal capabilities.


· Identify vendor-related risks early and communicate recovery needs to the appropriate stakeholders.


Material Readiness and Production Release


· Confirm that material, drawings, travelers, BOMs, routing, and required documentation are ready before releasing work to Production.


· Coordinate with Material Coordinators to ensure execution plans are understood and actionable.


· Authorize material delivery to Production for final assembly when project requirements and readiness checks are satisfied.


· Protect the rule that nothing is issued to Production without Planner sign-off.


Shortage, Rework, and Returned Material Control


· Identify, track, and drive resolution of shortages, incorrect material, damaged material, rework parts, and replacement needs.


· Work with Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Material Coordinators, and Expeditors to resolve issues that threaten schedule execution.


· Coordinate the removal, disposition, and system accuracy of returned or excess material after job completion and shipment.


Communication, Reporting, and Schedule Feedback


· Provide accurate and timely status updates to the Master Scheduling function and Project Managers.


· Identify schedule variances, material risks, and execution constraints; recommend recovery actions where needed.


· Participate in production, engineering, procurement, and capacity planning meetings as required.


· Maintain accurate data in ERP/MRP, planning tools, trackers, and other company systems.


Continuous Improvement


· Support the development of standard work packages, planning templates, and repeatable planning processes.


· Use ERP/MRP tools to improve material visibility, demand alignment, and planning accuracy.


· Participate in continuous improvement efforts related to flow, schedule adherence, material readiness, and cross-functional execution.


Required Qualifications


· 2+ years of experience in production planning, production control, scheduling, material planning, or a related manufacturing role.


· Experience working in a manufacturing, fabrication, engineered-to-order, project-based, or industrial production environment.


· Working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems, production schedules, BOMs, routers, travelers, and material status tracking.


· Ability to coordinate across Production, Procurement, Engineering, Quality, vendors, and project stakeholders.


· Strong organizational skills, follow-up discipline, and ability to manage competing priorities across multiple projects.


· Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and common business systems.


Preferred Qualifications


· Experience in switchgear, electrical equipment, metal fabrication, panel manufacturing, or related industrial manufacturing.


· Experience coordinating outsourced fabrication, coating, welding, bending, machining, or vendor-performed production activities.


· Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, visual management, or production flow improvement methods.


· Experience supporting high-mix, low-to-medium volume, engineered-to-order production environments.


Key Competencies


· Proactive planning mindset and strong sense of ownership.


· Ability to influence without direct authority.


· High sense of urgency paired with disciplined decision-making.


· Strong conflict resolution skills across cross-functional teams.


· Ability to translate complex schedules into clear execution priorities.


· Detail-oriented, data-driven, and comfortable holding others accountable to process.


Work Environment and Physical Requirements


· Onsite role supporting both office and manufacturing-floor environments.


· Regular walking of production, fabrication, and material staging areas may be required.


· Must be able to operate effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment with shifting priorities.


Success Measures


· Accurate and executable department-level plans.


· Improved material readiness and fewer production disruptions.


· Timely visibility to shortages, risks, and recovery plans.


· Strong alignment between planning, material control, production, and project needs.


· Consistent enforcement of Planner sign-off before Production release.


Equal Employment Opportunity and Disclaimer


Spike Electric Controls is an Equal Opportunity Employer. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Responsibilities may evolve based on business needs.

title: Senior Engineer - Full Stack (React/Kotlin/Perl)
description:
Salary: $140K-$160K

Reapit – Who are we?

Reapit is the original, end-to-end business technology provider for estate agencies of all sizes. We’ve been helping sales and lettings agents to build relationships and grow their businesses for more than 25 years. Our technology connects property professionals in Europe, the Middle East, Australia, and New Zealand with buyers, sellers, tenants and landlords to power the relationships that change lives.

In Australia, Reapit stands as the preferred technology choice among the nation's leading estate agents and agencies. Tailored to the unique demands of the Australian property market, Reapit provides successful leaders with unparalleled tools across sales, property management, client relations, and data analytics, reinforcing their position at the pinnacle of real estate excellence.

What you’ll be doing

The Senior Engineer will provide specialist full stack engineering and production support for one of Reapit's financial transaction products. This role suits a strong React front-end engineer with backend experience, or a Kotlin/Java microservices engineer comfortable across modern front-end development, who also has an aptitude for troubleshooting, root cause analysis and production support.

The role will involve working across React, TypeScript, Kotlin/Java microservices, APIs and transaction-processing workflows, with a preference for candidates who have prior experience supporting or building financial transaction, payments, billing or reconciliation systems, where accuracy, auditability and reliability are critical.

The role will also involve operational support and maintenance of a Perl based financial transaction product which has connections to AWS and third party payment providers.

Key Responsibilities:

Planning and Requirement Analysis:

  • Collaborate Across Departments: Work closely with product managers, quality assurance, Operations and Finance to define technical project specifications and requirements for the financial transaction product.

  • Requirement Analysis and Estimation: Lead the team in analysing technical requirements, conducting research, and estimating effort for support and enhancement work.

System Design:

  • Technical Design and Implementation: Design scalable, secure and maintainable solutions across React front-end applications, Kotlin/Java microservices, REST APIs and integration points that support financial transaction processing.

Implementation:

  • Code Development and Review: Actively write production-quality React, TypeScript and Kotlin code, participate in code reviews, and uphold engineering standards across front-end and backend services.

  • Testing and Validation: Perform rigorous testing and validation of solutions, including transaction integrity and reconciliation scenarios, to ensure the quality of deliverables.

  • Production Support and Troubleshooting: Act as a specialist point of escalation for issues affecting the financial transaction product, diagnosing and resolving defects across front-end, backend and integration layers.

  • Root Cause Analysis: Investigate transaction failures, reconciliation discrepancies and data integrity issues, working with Operations and Finance teams to identify root cause and implement fixes.

  • Documentation: Develop and maintain accurate documentation and runbooks for engineering and support processes, ensuring all necessary materials are produced and maintained for future reference and compliance

Project Delivery:

  • Agile Participation: Actively participate in agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews.

  • Project Delivery: Ensure support and enhancement work is completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.

Maintenance:

  • Technical Guidance: Provide technical guidance and support to team members on best practices and technical issues.

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify and implement opportunities for improving performance, maintainability, and reducing recurring incidents.

Operations:

  • Support: Own the end-to-end management of the financial transaction product, including debugging and fixing production issues, liaising with technical contacts from third-parties, and handle the resubmission of transactions.

  • Incident Management: Own the end-to-end management of incidents affecting the financial transaction product, including triage, communicating updates to stakeholders, and coordinating fixes, ensuring minimal impact to customers and financial accuracy.

Who we're looking for

At Reapit, we prioritise hiring individuals who share our values and possess the right attitudes and behaviours for success. Whilst some of the listed requirements may be important, don’t worry if you don’t meet all of them, we’d still like to hear from you.

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field.

  • 7+ years in software development, with strong experience in either modern React front-end development or Kotlin/Java backend microservice development, and the ability to contribute effectively across the full stack - Essential

  • Strong expertise in either React/TypeScript or Kotlin/Java microservices, with practical experience or a willingness to work across the other side of the stack - Essential

  • Experience troubleshooting and resolving production incidents in complex, distributed systems - Essential

  • Experience supporting or building financial transaction, payments, billing or reconciliation systems, where accuracy, auditability and reliability are critical – Preferred

Technical Skills:

  • Strong React and TypeScript experience, including component design, state management, front-end testing and accessible user experiences.

  • Knowledge of relational and non-relational databases.

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, REST APIs and event-based architecture.

  • Hands-on Kotlin and/or Java experience, ideally with Spring Boot, service-to-service communication, API design and production support of backend services.

  • Understanding of financial transaction processing concepts, such as payment flows, reconciliation, ledgers, idempotency and audit trails, is highly regarded.

  • Experience using observability and monitoring tools (logging, tracing, alerting, dashboards) to diagnose and resolve issues in production.

  • Experience with testing methodologies (unit/integration/E2E testing, mocking, shift-left) including using test harnesses, continuous integration, and code coverage tools

  • Exposure to public cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and familiarity with IaC tools like CloudFormation, CDK, and Docker.

  • Experience with a command-line Unix/Linux based environment, basic scripting languages, and debugging Perl/bash/sftp/gpg processes.

  • Experience with AI-enabled and agentic development practices is preferred, including use of coding assistants, agentic workflows for development and testing, prompt/tool design, evaluation, guardrails and safe adoption patterns.

  • Understanding of SOLID design principles.

What your impact and success looks like

We expect your success and impact in the early stages of your career with us to look something like this:

Within 1 month:

  • You will be making a positive contribution on smaller React, Kotlin or Java work items to introduce you to the technology stack, the product domain and the financial transaction flows it processes.

  • You will participate in planning and estimation sessions, technical scoping exercises, and code reviews from day one, to help understand both the domain and the code, and provide your own feedback from your prior experience.

  • You will begin learning the team's existing support processes, runbooks, escalation paths and the common issue types affecting the financial transaction product.

  • You will begin building relationships and trust with team members, as well as building an understanding of individual strengths, weaknesses and goals.

  • You will begin building strong relationships with other departments including Product, Design, QA, Operations and Finance.

  • You will have familiarised yourself with the financial transaction product, including transactional flow, file formats, and processes.

Within 3 months:

  • You will feel comfortable with the domain and Reapit's products & services.

  • You will be able to demonstrate a strong understanding of the React front end, Kotlin/Java microservices, and the financial transaction processing flows and the systems that depend on themc.

  • You will be independently contributing ideas for improvements both for the product and team processes.

  • You will be actively contributing to the team's output, quality and culture.

  • You will be working collaboratively with the Product and Operations departments to understand requirements and plan work.

  • You will be taking a share of production support and incident response duties for the financial transaction product, with reducing need for oversight.

Within 6 months:

  • Your contributions will be helping to shape the backlog and future direction of the product.

  • You will be delivering complex support and enhancement work with a high level of autonomy across front-end, backend and integration work.

  • You will be participating in agile processes, technical planning and design conversations, and helping the team make practical delivery decisions.

  • You will be contributing to a positive, collaborative team culture, promoting participation, teamwork, innovation and continuous improvement.

  • You will be ensuring quality and use of best practices within the team, from requirements gathering & analysis, through solutions design, documentation, implementation, and testing.

  • You will be acting as a trusted specialist for the financial transaction product, capable of leading investigation and resolution of complex production issues with minimal supervision.

We operate a Flexible Working Policy and you are free to determine where you work from, be that from home or in the Sydney or Brisbane offices, and how often, but we certainly recommend a balance.

Don't tick all the boxes? Neither do we

We care about our industry and want it to become a more inclusive and diverse place to work. So, we’re driven by hiring not only by experience and relevance for the role but by sharing our values and the right attitudes and behaviours for success. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. We feel we have an empowering environment where everyone is supported and respected, and we want you to feel this too. We welcome new ideas, thinking and approaches, whilst listening to all our employees.

title: Cloud Cost Optimization Program Manager
description:
Cloud Cost Optimization Program Manager

About Virtasant

Virtasant is a global technology services company with a network of over 4,000 technology professionals across 130+ countries. We specialize in cloud architecture, infrastructure, migration, and optimization, helping enterprises scale efficiently while maintaining cost control.

Our clients range from Fortune 500 companies to fast-growing startups, relying on us to build high-performance infrastructure, optimize cloud environments, and enable continuous delivery at scale.

About the role

We are looking for a senior Cloud Cost Optimization Program Manager (FinOps) to support a large-scale cloud optimization program for a Fortune 50 technology organization.

This role sits at the intersection of FinOps, cloud infrastructure, data, and technical program management. You will work directly with Cloud Service Provider (CSP) partners, engineering teams, and senior leadership to identify cloud savings opportunities, drive optimization initiatives through execution, and establish scalable processes for cloud cost governance.

This is not a reporting-only FinOps role. We’re looking for someone who can understand the technical and financial drivers of cloud spend, turn data into actionable initiatives, and influence engineering teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

This opportunity is open to candidates based in the United States and Canada and requires significant overlap with Pacific Time (PST/PDT).

For US-based candidates, this is a W-2 contract opportunity. We are unable to provide current or future employment visa sponsorship for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner directly with AWS and GCP account and technical teams to identify savings opportunities, resolve billing or data issues, and drive optimization commitments through completion.

  • Build and manage a pipeline of cloud cost reduction initiatives across compute, storage, networking, and platform services.

  • Partner with engineering teams to scope, prioritize, and track initiatives such as rightsizing, commitment optimization, architecture changes, and workload migrations.

  • Monitor cloud spend, anomalies, forecasts, and optimization opportunities, proactively identifying risks and areas for improvement.

  • Work with cloud billing, usage, tagging, and allocation data to support cost analysis and savings validation.

  • Prepare financial analyses, business cases, forecasts, and savings reports for senior and executive stakeholders.

  • Translate complex cloud infrastructure and financial data into clear recommendations and decision-making narratives.

  • Own recurring cloud cost governance and reporting cadences across engineering and leadership teams.

  • Improve processes around tagging, forecasting, cost allocation, savings validation, and optimization tracking.

  • Manage timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables across multiple engineering and business teams.

  • Drive execution through influence and strong stakeholder relationships rather than direct authority.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Have Experience

  • 14+ years of professional experience, including significant experience leading complex technical programs in large enterprise environments.

  • Strong experience with FinOps, cloud cost optimization, cloud economics, or cloud financial management.

  • Strong knowledge of AWS and/or GCP, including cloud infrastructure, pricing, billing, usage, and cost optimization concepts.

  • Demonstrated experience driving measurable cloud cost optimization initiatives with engineering or infrastructure teams.

  • Strong Technical Program Management experience across complex, cross-functional engineering initiatives.

  • Experience partnering directly with Cloud Service Providers and/or managing CSP-related technical and cost initiatives.

  • Ability to work with cloud cost and usage data, with working knowledge of SQL, scripting, data pipelines, and/or data modeling.

  • Experience developing financial analyses, forecasts, business cases, savings reporting, and executive-level communications.

  • Proven ability to influence engineering teams and drive delivery without direct management authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior and executive stakeholders.

  • Based in the United States or Canada with availability for significant Pacific Time overlap.

  • For US candidates, existing authorization to work in the United States without current or future employment visa sponsorship.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Apptio Cloudability, VMware CloudHealth, or similar FinOps platforms.

  • Experience with AWS Cost Explorer, AWS Cost and Usage Reports (CUR), GCP Cloud Billing, or equivalent native CSP tooling.

  • FinOps Foundation certification or other formal FinOps training.

  • Experience supporting cloud environments operating at significant enterprise scale.

  • Experience designing or improving tagging, cost allocation, forecasting, anomaly management, or cloud governance processes.

  • Exposure to multi-cloud cost optimization across both AWS and GCP.

Tools and Environment

  • AWS

  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

  • Apptio Cloudability / CloudHealth

  • Native CSP billing and cost-management tools

  • SQL and cloud cost/usage datasets

  • Data pipelines and reporting platforms

  • FinOps frameworks and practices

Why This Role is Exciting

You’ll have the opportunity to influence cloud economics at significant enterprise scale, working directly with engineering organizations, CSP partners, and executive stakeholders.

Rather than simply identifying savings opportunities, you’ll help turn them into measurable results — shaping how cloud optimization initiatives are prioritized, executed, measured, and scaled across a complex technology organization.

This role offers substantial ownership and visibility for someone who enjoys combining technical understanding, financial analysis, program leadership, and stakeholder influence.

What we offer

  • Remote opportunity for candidates based in the United States and Canada.

  • For US-based candidates, W-2 contract engagement.

  • Paid time off after the first 3 months of engagement, including applicable local holidays.

  • Long-term opportunity supporting a large-scale global technology organization.

  • Collaboration with senior engineering leaders, cloud specialists, CSP partners, and executive stakeholders.

  • High-impact work with direct, measurable influence on cloud optimization and operational efficiency.

title: Data Engineer
description:

Specific duties will include developing enhancements to our Hadoop/Hive based data pipeline and extend to streamed data processing; contributing to data reporting projects including generating internal and external reports or visualizations (CSV, Excel, PDF, interactive web graphics and others) and data distribution / reporting components, real-time bidding or optimization algo using a combination of SQL, Ruby, R, Go, Javascript, D3, Bourne shell scripts, cron jobs, and other relevant technologies. Will also be expected to implement new services and algorithms to improve our product.
The ideal candidate has hands-on data processing experience. Candidate must be familiar with current distributed computing data technologies on commodity servers and have experience with 24×7 production needs.
Requirements
• Strong SQL skills on large-scale databases, knowledge of any of the following RDBMS such as MySQL, Postgres, Redshift, Hive or others.
• Experience with Linux or Unix based systems – including Bourne shell, cron and other Unix utilities.
• Strong software development skills, including experience with Java.
• Degree in Computer Science or a related field

• Experience with Hadoop/MapReduce and/or EMR, including experience in developing MapReduce Jobs in Java or developing Hive UDF.
• ETL experience maintaining multiple data systems.
• Experience with Ooozie or other Hadoop workflow solutions and experience developing complex data processing pipelines, including experience developing regressions tests and deployment strategies for such environments.
• Experience with data reporting solutions – either developed in house or with 3rd party solutions.
• Working experience developing and supporting 24×7 production data services and pipelines on Linux systems – including experience being on-call supporting such services. Experience with AWS preferred.
Challenges we are tackling
• Reliably processing billions of events per day with no data loss 24×7 on commodity hardware.
• Processing events in near real-time
• Building for the fragility of cloud and distributed services
• Complex processing of large amounts of data in an efficient manner.
• Reporting, distribution of data, data analysis, data visualization and machine learning algorithms.
• Low latency data stores for use in bidding or algo optimization.

title: Dual Study Program in Business Administration - Health Care Management (B.A.)
description:
Make your mark for patients

Start date: 1 August 2027

Locations: Monheim am Rhein and Mannheim

Academic partner: Duale Hochschule Baden-Württemberg (DHBW)

Start your journey with UCB

Are you ready to launch your career after finishing school and looking for a hands-on degree program at an international company that combines innovation with a strong focus on patients? Would you like to take on responsibility, shape your own projects and become part of a committed team? Then UCB is the right place for you!

Starting on 1 August 2027, we are offering a practice-oriented dual study program in Business Administration - Health Care Management (B.A.) in partnership with DHBW Mannheim.

How your study program works

  • Getting started in Monheim am Rhein: You will begin with a two-month onboarding period before your academic studies begin, giving you the opportunity to get to know UCB, your colleagues, and your fellow dual students.
  • Alternating theory and practice: Every three months, you will alternate between academic phases at DHBW in Mannheim and practical placements at UCB in Monheim.
  • Program duration: 6 semesters (3 years)
  • Start of studies at DHBW: October or November 2027, depending on the degree programme

Your practical placements – varied and tailored to you

Your training plan will be tailored to your interests and strengths. You will gain insight into a range of business functions, including:

  • Human Resources (HR)
  • Finance
  • Marketing and Corporate Communications
  • Digitalisation and Operational Excellence
  • Market Access
  • Drug Safety
  • Medical and Quality
  • …and many other exciting departments!

What we offer

  • Attractive remuneration in line with the German chemical industry collective agreement
  • Monthly allowance to support living expenses, such as housing costs
  • Reimbursement of travel expenses for official transitions between academic and practical phases
  • Holiday and Christmas bonuses
  • Laptop for professional use
  • Personal support from a buddy and mentor
  • Training opportunities and seminars
  • Subsidised meals in the company canteen
  • Subsidised membership with a corporate fitness provider
  • An agile, digital working environment with modern tools

What you bring

  • A general higher education entrance qualification (Abitur) or a university of applied sciences entrance qualification (Fachhochschulreife)
  • Good to very good mathematics skills
  • Good to very good written and spoken English
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
  • The ability to work independently and some initial professional experience, for example through internships or part-time jobs
  • Active involvement in school or extracurricular activities
  • Motivation, a willingness to learn, and a goal-oriented mindset
  • A collaborative mindset, initiative, and the ability to think outside the box

Important information

  • German language skills are essential, as most communication and teaching throughout the dual study program will be in German.
  • Applicants who are not German citizens and do not hold permanent residency must have a valid residence and work permit at the time of application.

Your application process

As a first step in the application process, please submit the following documents:

  • Your CV in English
  • Your most recent school reports, graduation certificate or transcript of records in German or English

Once we have received your documents, we will send you a qualification form by email. Please complete the form and return it to us. We will then verify whether you meet the eligibility criteria for the dual study program based on your CV, certificates and the information provided in the form.

If you meet the eligibility criteria, we will invite you to an online or in-person interview, depending on your location. The interview will be conducted in German. To help you feel well prepared, we will provide you with a guide in advance. During the conversation, you will have the opportunity to learn more about UCB and our dual study program—and, of course, to ask any questions you may have.

The final stage of the application process is an online assessment center, which will also be conducted in German and usually takes place in a small group. If you reach this part of the process, we will provide you with all the relevant details in advance.

Ready to take the next step?

We look forward to receiving your application and wish you every success in the selection process!

If you have any questions, please contact us: Dualstudyprogram@ucb.com

About us
UCB is a global biopharmaceutical company, focusing on neurology and immunology. We are over 9.000 people in all four corners of the globe, inspired by patients and driven by science.

Why work with us?
At UCB, we don’t just complete tasks, we create value. We aren’t afraid to push forward, collaborate, and innovate to make our mark for patients. We have a caring, supportive culture where everyone feels included, respected, and has equal opportunities to do their best work. We ‘go beyond’ to create value for our patients, and always with a human focus, whether that’s on our patients, our employees, or our planet. Working for us, you will discover a place where you can grow, and have the freedom to carve your own career path to achieve your full potential.

At UCB, we’ve embraced a hybrid-first approach to work, bringing teams together in local hubs to foster collaborative curiosity. Unless expressly stated in the description or precluded by the nature of the position, roles are hybrid with 40% of your time spent in the office.

UCB is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions will be made without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable laws.

Should you require any adjustments to our process to assist you in demonstrating your strengths and capabilities contact us on EMEA-Reasonable_Accommodation@ucb.com. Please note should your enquiry not relate to adjustments; we will not be able to support you through this channel.

title: 3670 Rework Crew Leader I-Day Shift
description:
We have an internal opening for a Rework Crew Leader-Day Shift at the Distribution Center.

Summary

Performs a variety of inventory control and clerical functions to support rework operations. Responsible for executing accurate inventory transactions to ensure proper tracking and control of all products handled by rework teams. This includes red-carded product, shippers, and any product designated for inspection or additional review.

Updates QC and Inventory Control team of product handled each day.

Tracks and reports staffing to timekeepers and supervisors each day.

Provides instruction to other team members of the order product should be reworked and handled.

Verify all packaging materials and ensure the quantity is enough to handle product scheduled for rework.

Document all product movements and provide support to team leads and supervisor.

Have the ability to receive email and follow instruction through email.

Duties and Responsibilities

Essential Functions

Inspects individual jars and pallets of finished goods for damage to be reworked or discarded. Reworks items according to standard procedures established by Quality Control and FDA guidelines

Standing at worktable or pallet, removes jars or cases of product to be reworked. Uses judgment to divide jars or cases of finished goods into two categories: those to be discarded and those to go to a food bank.

Places unacceptable product (unfit for human consumption) into bins for disposal.

Reworks items going to food bank by cleaning the outside of the jars and repacking them into trays. Packs, codes and labels reworked jars. Important to determine that labels are applied properly on jar and that all jars in tray case have identifiable code dates. Prepares trays according to rework items and stencils description, item and UPC codes on carton. Records number of items and cases reworked.

Cleans work area or other assigned areas daily.

Uses WMS scanner in performing some job tasks.

Receives verbal instructions from supervisor on above tasks and performs other work as directed by Supervisor.

Maintains and supplies the daily red card pallets and all shippers, bundles and giftpaks that may be scheduled as line 9. In addition, the materials needed to correct or pack them like trays, boxes, stands, sleeves and labels.

Must be trained and able to work our RF gun and WMS system both on the RF Gun and on computer. Need to be familiar with our email and voicemail systems and able to read reports in excel or other formats.

Handles contacting the Inventory Control supervision when we have shakeout or product that is dispositioned to be dumped to trash. Schedule date and time to carry outside to dumpster area and assist with dumping of product.

Maintains and reports accurately data for all product handled in the rework area, Including Red Card, Shippers, product staged for shipments and product returned.

Restack damaged pallets of finish goods.

Clean floors in rework area.

Follows safety rules and company policies.

Must have a valid NC driver’s license and good driving record.

Other Duties

Participates in training, employee meetings, committees, project teams, etc. as appropriate.

Receives written or verbal instructions from supervisor on above tasks and performs other work as directed by supervisor.

title: HR Student Placement
description:
Company

We are a high-performance Formula One Team driven by innovation, precision, and commitment to developing our people. Our Human Resources team partners closely with departments across the organisation to support talent development, organisational capability, and a high performance culture.

Take the next step in your career and play your part in shaping the future of Formula One.

title: Batch Operator
description:
Broad Function and Purpose of Position:

Batch Operators are responsible for the daily operation of complex chemistry processes at the Marion Plant. Batch Operators execute daily production requirements, achieving safety, housekeeping, quality, rate objectives and participating in continuous improvement activities as directed. Batch Operators must be able to work independently within the framework of a team while demonstrating a positive attitude.

Specific Responsibilities:

  • Actively participate in the plants Sika SAFE Program.
  • Understand, comply, and regularly inspect the work area to ensure all safety policies and practices are followed and a high degree of industrial housekeeping is maintained at all times.
  • Oversee and operate packaging equipment to ensure that all area specific functions conform to process and procedure specifications.
  • Drive cultural change and initiatives which emphasize safety, communication, co-operation, development, teamwork, environmental compliance, quality, productivity and waste elimination.
  • Perform inventory check of raw materials and packaging materials for daily production schedule.
  • Oversee and operate mixing equipment to ensure that all area specific functions conform to process and procedure specifications.
  • Ensure mixing equipment is running smoothly, within validated parameters, and in compliance with SOP’s.
  • Ensure mixing processes are carried out and documented within a high level of compliance including but not limited to order of addition, mixing times, and other designated set points.
  • Performs line change overs and simple-to-moderate equipment adjustments and troubleshooting.
  • Understand, comply, and ensure that packaged products meet quality standards of customers including but not limited to product weight tolerances, overall appearance, DOT Labeling, and batch/identification numbers.
  • Uses PLC and observes flowmeters and pressure gauges, turn valves, and start pumps to transfer fluid chemicals to or from specified tanks and to processing areas.
  • Guide, assist and train new and temporary employees.
  • Demonstrates ability to use a computer and various computer programs including SAP and PLC programs.
  • To execute other projects or activities to-be-determined as directed by Plant Leadership.

Qualifications/Experience:

  • Education: High school diploma or GED required.
  • Experience: 3+ year experience in an industrial environment/manufacturing environment.

Special Requirements/Competencies:

  • Must be able to read, write, speak and comprehend English.
  • Must have good math skills, including the ability to work with fractions, decimals and percentages.
  • Must have the ability to develop process expertise in order to facilitate troubleshooting.
  • Must be able to maintain an excellent attendance record.
  • Must be flexible to work any shift and overtime as business requires.
  • Must be self-motivated and able to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others.
  • Must be able to operate a forklift and other equipment as trained.

title: Product UX/UI Designer
description:

We are looking for a Product UX/UI Designer to join our product team and help design, improve, and scale digital products for a leading African telecom & fintech group, with a strong focus on mobile transactional experiences and the client's flagship mobile merchant/agent app.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong product mindset, excellent UX fundamentals, and solid UI execution capabilities. You will work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment alongside product managers, developers, business stakeholders, and marketing teams to create scalable, user-centric mobile experiences across multiple countries.

We value designers who prioritize usability over aesthetics, think in systems, and understand the connection between design, product strategy, and delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Product UX Design

  • Understand user needs, product challenges, and business constraints
  • Design intuitive, scalable, and efficient user journeys
  • Create user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes
  • Contribute to product thinking and UX decision-making
  • Apply UX best practices around usability, accessibility, information architecture, and interaction logic
  • Identify friction points and continuously improve the user experience

User Testing & UX Validation

  • Prepare and conduct user testing sessions
  • Build feedback frameworks and UX questionnaires
  • Analyze user behaviors and product usage patterns
  • Translate user insights into actionable product improvements
  • Collaborate with product teams to prioritize UX enhancements

Mobile UI Production

  • Design clean, structured, and consistent mobile interfaces
  • Produce high-quality UI mockups in Figma
  • Respect and extend existing design standards and components
  • Ensure visual quality while maintaining a pragmatic product-oriented approach
  • Deliver realistic and implementation-ready interfaces

Design System & Scalability

  • Work within and contribute to the existing design system
  • Structure components and variants in Figma
  • Ensure consistency across products and countries
  • Understand maintainability and scalability principles
  • Collaborate with developers on Design System → Code workflows

Product & Technical Collaboration

  • Work closely with developers to ensure feasibility and consistency
  • Participate in product discussions and functional trade-offs
  • Understand mobile technical constraints and integrate them into designs
  • Contribute to improving design/product/development workflows

AI-Enhanced Workflow

  • Integrate AI tools into design and production workflows
  • Use AI to improve velocity, consistency, and exploration of UX/UI solutions
  • Maintain a critical and structured approach when leveraging AI tools

Requirements

Experience

  • 3–5+ years of experience in UX/UI Design or Product Design
  • Experience designing mobile applications or evolving digital products
  • Previous experience in product companies, startups, agencies, or software factories
  • Experience in telecom or super apps is a plus

UX & Product Skills

  • Strong ability to design complex user journeys
  • Solid understanding of:
    • usability
    • ergonomics
    • user-centered design
    • information hierarchy
  • Understanding of transactional mobile products
  • Strong product thinking and continuous improvement mindset

User Testing & Research

  • Experience conducting or leveraging user testing
  • Familiarity with UX research and validation methodologies
  • Experience with tools such as:
    • Maze
    • FigJam
    • Dovetail
    • or equivalent

UI & Design Systems

  • Advanced proficiency in Figma:
    • components
    • variants
    • auto-layout
    • design systems
  • Ability to create structured and scalable mobile UI
  • Understanding of responsive and cross-device constraints
  • Familiarity with Design System → Code principles

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Comfortable working in scalable, multi-country product environments
  • Strong collaboration skills across product, design, and engineering teams
  • Understanding of industrialized UX/UI workflows

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong user empathy (“useful before beautiful” mindset)
  • Product-oriented problem solver
  • Team player with humility and openness to feedback
  • Strong attention to detail and autonomy
  • Ability to propose ideas collaboratively
  • Curiosity and continuous learning mindset

Nice to Have

  • Experience with super apps or transactional mobile platforms
  • Large-scale Design System experience
  • Knowledge of Agile, Product, or Design Thinking methodologies
  • Experience with AI tools applied to design workflows
  • Front-end sensitivity (HTML/CSS)
  • Product analytics exposure (Amplitude, Hotjar, Firebase Analytics, etc.)

Languages

  • French: Professional fluency required
  • English: Professional working proficiency recommended

title: Senior BigPanda Engineer / AIOps Subject Matter Expert

title: Oracle Fusion Finance Consultant

Purpose of the Role

Provide senior Oracle Fusion Financials expertise to protect the quality of the Group ERP template, review and challenge the implementation partner's work, and progressively support internal ownership of Finance configuration and country rollouts. Key Responsibilities

  • Configuration and internal delivery: configure Oracle Fusion Financials directly as delivery responsibility transfers in-house — from review and supervision, through shadowing, to joint and internally led delivery; maintain workbooks and support defect analysis, regression, cutover readiness and go-live assessments.
  • Process design: design and optimise Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Asset-to-Retire, Cash, Tax and closing processes; define standard controls, reconciliations and approval workflows aligned with Group Finance policies.
  • Data migration and testing: support Finance mapping, transformation rules and validation (suppliers, customers, banks, assets, opening balances, open AR / AP, tax, master data); mock and cutover loads, reconciliation and sign-off; prepare and review test scenarios, SIT execution, defect triage and UAT preparation; validate OTBI / BI Publisher outputs and Finance interfaces (OIC).
  • Knowledge transfer: maintain design decisions and the Design Deviation Log; produce reusable Finance playbooks, testing packs, cutover checklists and runbooks; mentor the internal Finance Lead and academy resources and support their Oracle certification readiness.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree (Finance, Accounting, IS, Business or Engineering); significant Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials implementation experience with at least two complete lifecycles, in multi-entity, multi-ledger or multi-country environments.
  • Strong knowledge of several Financials modules (GL, AP, AR, Cash, FA, Expenses, Tax, Lease Accounting, intercompany); hands-on Functional Setup Manager configuration, fit-to-standard workshops and configuration workbooks.
  • Finance data migration and FBDI; SIT / UAT / regression and defect management; roles, access and segregation-of-duties awareness; integration mapping, OTBI / BI Publisher requirements, cutover and reconciliation.
  • Experience quality-assuring an implementation partner's work, with the credibility to challenge constructively and protect template integrity; strong documentation discipline and a coaching mindset; English fluent, working French a strong advantage.
  • Certifications: at least one active Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Certified Implementation Professional credential aligned with the assigned modules; General Ledger certification mandatory for the lead GL profile; Payables, Receivables or Accounting Hub credentials strongly preferred.

Success Indicators

Quality and completeness of Financials design reviews; material gaps caught before production; configurations compliant with the approved Group template; fewer unresolved defects at SIT / UAT entry; quality of data mapping, migration and reconciliation; internal Finance Lead and academy resources ready to work independently; usable Finance playbooks and reduced dependency on external consulting.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
description:
The Data Infrastructure teams are responsible for building and maintaining data storage technologies across the product. Teams work with a variety of open source technologies like MySQL, Vitess, Hadoop HBase, Kafka, Spark, and Elastic Search all running on AWS.
One of the primary objectives is to automate the deployments, configuration, and recoverability of data stores to efficiently scale storage systems. Teams also take on projects to improve the client-side interaction with the data stores with analysis tools and wrapper client interfaces. A number of our teams are active contributors to the Open Source projects that they work on.
We’re operationally responsible for a huge volume of traffic to and from these data stores. Our HBase clusters serve over 3 million requests/second across 220+ tables, while our ElasticSearch clusters serve over 20k searches/second and 50k indexes/second to 90+ billion documents.
Streaming that data to and from applications amounts to more than 3 GB/sec of data through our Kafka clusters, with hundreds of producers and consumers.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for talented software engineers to help us build the vision of making our database access simple, intuitive, highly performant and highly reliable to our customers and ohapplication developers.
The goal of the team is to implement a comprehensive set of intelligent features that will drive the productivity of using any of our data stores at scale and with the highest possible reliability.
Bonus points for being:
  • Someone with experience developing automation or is a power user of one or more of the above-mentioned data storage technologies.
  • Willingness and ability to work with the user base, in this case, other developers, to define and build tools that make the lives of application developers easier and their code less error-prone through automation.
  • Interested in working with and supporting infrastructure at scale.
  • Someone who has shown that they can solve complicated technical problems and analyze tradeoffs with empathy for the developers, yet building creative solutions.
  • Able to demonstrate pragmatic decision making and problem-solving abilities.

About Us

We help millions of organizations grow better, and we’d love to grow better with you. Our business builds the software and systems that power the world’s small to medium-sized businesses. Our company culture builds connections, careers, and employee growth. How? By creating a workplace that values flexibility, autonomy, and transparency. If that sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’d love to hear from you.

$250,000 to $350,000 base salary, based on qualifications and experience, plus competitive equity. This role is on-site five days per week in San Francisco. Existing visa transfers, including OPT and H-1B transfers, may be considered.

title: Solution Architect
description:
Salary: $225k-$230k + Super

About the Company
Our client is a global SaaS business providing a cloud native banking platform to banks and financial institutions worldwide. Backed by significant scale and a flat, fast moving culture, they are now growing across Australia and New Zealand from a Sydney CBD base.

About the Role
Sitting between clients and engineering, the Solution Architect leads technical design through implementation and supports the sales phase. You will work with client stakeholders, SI partners and an Australian engineering team of 20 to 25, translating business requirements into technical direction. Travel across Australia and New Zealand is required.

Duties / Key Responsibilities
  • Lead technical design through the implementation phase, working alongside client engineering leads and SI partners on estates that range from greenfield builds to systems 30 and 40 years old
  • Sit in the room with client engineers on the technical detail, using API specifications, sequence diagrams and documentation, then carry that back to the internal engineering team
  • Move between audiences in the same day, explaining to senior business stakeholders what can and cannot be done, why, and what the workable alternative looks like
  • Support the sales phase with the Business Development team, uncovering client requirements and shaping what a solution looks like
  • Document scope and roadmap decisions, and feed client requirements back into the product roadmap with Product Owners and engineering
Skills and Experience
  • A consulting background is essential. Senior manager level in a consultancy, or equivalent client facing delivery experience within a SaaS business
  • End to end solution architecture across the software delivery lifecycle, with enough technical depth to engage engineers at a low level on API specifications, webhooks, data and cloud
  • Software service design and integration experience, including RESTful APIs, OpenAPI specification and sequence diagrams
  • Cloud infrastructure and large scale cloud applications
  • Proven ability to shift communication style between detailed technical conversation with engineers and business language with senior stakeholders, and to build those senior relationships
  • Comfortable taking the whiteboard in a room of people you have not met and giving direction
  • This is not a hands on coding role, and it is not an enterprise architecture role. It sits between the two, close enough to the detail to be credible with engineers without owning the keyboard
  • Nice to have: retail, business or core banking, card processing or payments experience, delivery of core banking or large scale digital transformation programmes, commercial acumen and business case experience, and knowledge of financial regulations
  • Comfortable travelling nationally and internationally
Conor is recruiting for this role on behalf of Allura Partners.
If you're interested in this opportunity and feel you're the right fit, please click "Apply" or contact Conor Smyth at conor.smyth@allurapartners.com.au.

About Allura Partners
Allura Partners was founded to support private equity firms by placing C-Suites to lead, transform, and scale portfolio companies. Today, in addition to our proven private equity specialisation, we've become a trusted partner for major ASX-listed and private enterprises in Australia, offering executive search, recruitment, and business transformation. Known for integrity, reliability, and results, our expertise spans Executive Search, Accounting & Finance, Transformation & Change, and Technology & Digital. We connect businesses and top-tier talent, exceeding expectations and driving lasting impact.

title: Account Management Director
description:

• Coordinate design reviews, technical discussions, program milestones, manufacturing readiness, and risk management

• Advocate for partner needs and keep complex 12 to 18 month programs moving toward production

title: Service Worker III - Service Center
description:
Position Title: SERVICE WORKER

Department: Service Department

Status: Full-Time

Classification: Non-Exempt, Hourly

Reports To: Department Superintendent and/or designated supervisor

________________________________________

The following duties are normal for this position. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the classification if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment to the position. Other duties may be required, assigned, and expected commensurate with the operational needs of the City.


POSITION OVERVIEW

The Service Worker performs a variety of skilled and semi-skilled duties involving the maintenance, repair, construction, operation, and improvement of City infrastructure, facilities, equipment, utilities, and public property. Service Workers support the daily operations of the City's Streets, Water Distribution, Sanitary Sewer, Parks, and Facilities functions as assigned.


Work involves operating vehicles and equipment, performing physical labor, responding to emergencies, participating in snow and ice control operations, maintaining public infrastructure and facilities, and providing services to residents and businesses. Employees are expected to work safely, perform duties independently or as part of a team, and demonstrate professionalism while interacting with coworkers, contractors, vendors, and the public.


Service Workers may be assigned to specific departments and are expected to develop and maintain proficiency in the equipment, operations, regulations, certifications, and responsibilities associated with their assigned area.

________________________________________

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Operations & Maintenance

  • Perform maintenance, repair, construction, inspection, and operational duties associated with City infrastructure, utilities, facilities, parks, equipment, and public property.
  • Assist with the installation, maintenance, repair, and replacement of infrastructure, equipment, facilities, and related systems.
  • Perform routine inspections and preventative maintenance activities.
  • Operate hand tools, power tools, equipment, vehicles, and machinery necessary to perform assigned work.
  • Perform excavation, grading, landscaping, site restoration, material handling, and general labor activities as required.
  • Assist with special projects, seasonal operations, and emergency repairs.

Equipment Operation & Maintenance

  • Operate assigned vehicles, trucks, trailers, heavy equipment, and specialized machinery safely and efficiently.
  • Conduct routine inspections, preventative maintenance, cleaning, and minor repairs on assigned equipment.
  • Identify and report equipment deficiencies, maintenance needs, and safety concerns.
  • Maintain equipment, tools, vehicles, and work areas in a clean and safe condition.


Emergency Response & Seasonal Operations

  • Participate in snow and ice control operations, including plowing, salting, equipment operation, and emergency call-out assignments.
  • Respond to after-hours emergencies, weather events, utility failures, infrastructure issues, and other operational incidents.
  • Assist other departments during emergencies, special projects, staffing needs, and operational requirements.


Safety & Regulatory Compliance

  • Follow all applicable federal, state, local, and departmental safety policies, procedures, and regulations.
  • Utilize appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) and safety equipment.
  • Participate in required safety meetings, certifications, continuing education, and training programs.
  • Perform work in compliance with applicable environmental, operational, and regulatory requirements.


Customer Service & Teamwork

  • Interact professionally with residents, businesses, contractors, vendors, utility customers, coworkers, and other stakeholders.
  • Assist in documenting work activities, inspections, maintenance records, and operational reports.
  • Work cooperatively with employees across departments to support City operations.
  • Assist in training and mentoring employees as assigned.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

________________________________________

CLASSIFICATION LEVEL

Service Worker III

  • Fully proficient classification.
  • Performs the full range of departmental duties independently.
  • Operates specialized equipment and performs advanced assignments.
  • Assists with training and supporting less experienced employees.

________________________________________

DEPARTMENT ASSIGNMENTS

SANITARY SEWER ASSIGNMENT

Employees assigned to the Sanitary Sewer Department are responsible for the operation, maintenance, repair, inspection, and improvement of the City's sanitary sewer collection system and associated infrastructure.


Typical duties include:

  • Maintaining, repairing, and replacing sanitary sewer mains, manholes, service laterals, and related infrastructure.
  • Performing sewer cleaning, flushing, televising, smoke testing, dye testing, and inspections.
  • Operating jet trucks, vacuum trucks, CCTV equipment, pumps, and related specialized equipment.
  • Maintaining lift stations and associated facilities.
  • Responding to sewer backups, overflows, customer concerns, and emergency situations.
  • Locating underground utilities and responding to OUPS requests.
  • Performing excavation, trenching, backfilling, pavement restoration, and site restoration.
  • Assisting with sewer construction projects, service installations, and infrastructure improvements.
  • Employees assigned to this department may be required to assist other City departments, participate in snow and ice control operations, respond to emergencies, and perform duties outside their primary assignment as operational needs dictate.

________________________________________

WATER DISTRIBUTION ASSIGNMENT

Employees assigned to the Water Distribution Department are responsible for the operation, maintenance, repair, inspection, and construction of the City's water distribution system.


Typical duties include:

  • Installing, repairing, maintaining, and replacing water mains, valves, hydrants, service lines, and related infrastructure.
  • Performing hydrant maintenance, valve maintenance, leak detection, water service taps, and water main repairs.
  • Operating excavation equipment, service trucks, loaders, and related equipment.
  • Responding to water emergencies, service interruptions, and customer concerns.
  • Conducting system flushing and assisting with water quality maintenance activities.
  • Locating underground utilities and responding to OUPS requests.
  • Reading and interpreting utility maps and infrastructure records.
  • Assisting with water system construction projects and infrastructure improvements.
  • Employees assigned to this department may be required to assist other City departments, participate in snow and ice control operations, respond to emergencies, and perform duties outside their primary assignment as operational needs dictate.

________________________________________

STREETS ASSIGNMENT

Employees assigned to the Street Department are responsible for maintaining, repairing, and improving City streets, rights-of-way, drainage systems, and traffic control infrastructure.


Typical duties include:

  • Performing roadway maintenance, patching, paving, resurfacing, and reconstruction activities.
  • Installing, maintaining, and repairing traffic signs, pavement markings, guardrails, and traffic control devices.
  • Maintaining storm drainage systems, culverts, catch basins, ditches, and rights-of-way.
  • Operating trucks, loaders, excavators, paving equipment, rollers, and other heavy equipment.
  • Performing vegetation management, roadside maintenance, and brush removal.
  • Establishing and maintaining work zone traffic control.
  • Assisting with infrastructure improvement projects and emergency roadway repairs.
  • Employees assigned to this department may be required to assist other City departments, participate in snow and ice control operations, respond to emergencies, and perform duties outside their primary assignment as operational needs dictate.

________________________________________

PARKS & FACILITIES ASSIGNMENT

Employees assigned to the Parks & Facilities Department are responsible for maintaining City parks, recreational facilities, public buildings, grounds, athletic fields, playgrounds, and related amenities.


Typical duties include:

  • Maintaining parks, athletic fields, playgrounds, trails, landscaping, and recreational facilities.
  • Performing mowing, trimming, planting, fertilizing, irrigation maintenance, and vegetation management.
  • Maintaining City buildings, shelters, restrooms, and related facilities.
  • Performing minor carpentry, painting, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and building maintenance work within training and skill levels.
  • Inspecting and maintaining playground equipment, park amenities, and recreational infrastructure.
  • Assisting with special events, community programs, and facility setup activities.
  • Operating mowers, tractors, utility vehicles, trucks, loaders, and related equipment.
  • Maintaining grounds, facilities, equipment, and inventories.
  • Employees assigned to this department may be required to assist other City departments, participate in snow and ice control operations, respond to emergencies, and perform duties outside their primary assignment as operational needs dictate.

________________________________________

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • Valid Ohio Driver's License required.
  • Possession of a valid Ohio Commercial Driver's License (CDL) is strongly preferred at the time of hire.
  • Employees must obtain and maintain a Commercial Driver's License (CDL) in accordance with the Collective Bargaining Agreement, departmental requirements, and timelines established by the City.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain certifications, licenses, and training required by the City and assigned department.
  • Ability to safely operate vehicles, equipment, tools, and machinery associated with assigned duties.
  • Ability to read and follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to perform physically demanding work in a variety of environmental conditions.

________________________________________

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Work is performed both indoors and outdoors and may involve exposure to varying weather conditions, traffic, construction sites, utilities, equipment, noise, dust, chemicals, wastewater, confined spaces, heights, uneven terrain, and other conditions associated with municipal operations.


The position requires standing, walking, climbing, kneeling, crouching, lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling, digging, and operating equipment for extended periods. Employees must be capable of performing strenuous physical labor and handling materials, tools, and equipment associated with assigned duties.


Participation in after-hours call-outs, emergency response activities, and snow and ice control operations is required.



________________________________________

This job description outlines the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this position and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Management reserves the right to modify or assign additional duties as necessary to meet the operational needs of the City. The City of North Canton is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Diversion Specialist
description:
Job Summary: The purpose of this position is to provide resources and social services navigation support to families and individuals that are in unstable housing or unhoused. The goal is that families using our diversion services can self-identify and target the most appropriate pathways to stability for themselves. This may be within our Vision House transitional housing, or it may be with a different provider, or even public housing. The Diversion Specialist must bring a combination of persistence, active listening, and research skills to each case. The Diversion Specialist role is to help encourage each applicant to work from their strengths, while recognizing their challenges. A Diversion Specialist is someone who enjoys problem solving with a team, learning something new every day, and engaging one on one with people living in complex circumstances.


REPORTS TO: Site Lead

HOURS: 40 hours per week, hourly, Monday-Friday based on program needs

LOCATION: Renton, WA


Our new Diversion Specialist will enjoy the following benefits:

  • Starting Pay: $24.00-$27.00 per hour DOE
  • Health insurance: Medical $65–$150/month, Dental $13/month, Vision $2/month (family rates available)
  • Retirement plan with up to 3% employer match
  • Generous paid time off: 3 weeks vacation to start, 13 paid holidays, and 9 days of sick leave (separate from PFML & FMLA)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Employer-sponsored life insurance
  • Childcare tuition assistance

At Vision House, we serve populations from a variety of backgrounds. We strongly value diversity and actively seek applicants that will balance our employment workforce to align with the populations we serve. Questions regarding our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion can be directed towards our HR department.


As a Diversion Specialist you will:

  • Maintain the call intake list on a daily basis, ensuring accurate and up-to-date records.
  • Partners with housing specialist on low-income permanent housing for clients
  • Partners with family program to bring new families into the Vision House transitional housing program.
  • Manages/Supports diversion calendar for their assigned center, coordinating appointments and services.
  • Conduct trauma-informed diversion conversations with clients, helping them assess their strengths and challenges to identify housing options
  • Maintain a regular caseload, checking in with clients and offering ongoing support.
  • Inputs data into system on weekly basis
  • Builds relationships with other resource providers and attends monthly provider meetings and resource fairs
  • Attends and participates in family transition meetings
  • Supports family services teams with current resident resources when needed
  • Other duties as assigned

title: Senior Database Engineer
description:
Description

You’re a talented database developer who is passionate about coding. You excel at getting from feature request to implementation plan. You go beyond just getting the job done to slaying technical debt and developing code that is well-structured, well commented, and reasonably futureproof. You consistently pay attention both to the details and to the big picture, and you help everyone to keep them in line. You’re at your best when you have real ownership of your projects.
You will join a dynamic team of highly skilled players who are building the best e-commerce platform in the space. You will build software that is actually used by our customers and impacts our bottom line. As part of a team practicing agile development, you will work with a variety of team members, and you will be encouraged to reach into multiple layers of our technology stack while contributing to key projects that will help both us and you grow.
As a Senior Database Developer, you will be expected to grow into architectural and development ownership over significant components of our platform. You will take on interesting architectural and programming challenges, building out new platform features, enhancing our capacity to configure behaviors through metadata, and interfacing our systems with those of our clients and partners. You might even learn a bit about furniture, like what settees and fainting couches are.
Required Skills & Expertise:
  • 5+ years of software development experience
  • Advanced working knowledge of SQL Server and Microsoft Transact-SQL.
  • Ability to investigate and diagnose the unexpected in unfamiliar data and code.
Responsibilities:
  • Develop actionable implementation plans to fulfill change requests, and restructure such plans when requirements and understandings change.
  • Develop and implement solutions of high quality and clarity, making sure they meet project requirements.
  • Participate effectively in our peer code review process, catching mistakes, offering optimizations, and learning from each other.
  • Ensure that your code products are readily accessible to other developers through good use of company naming conventions, in-code comments, and supporting documentation.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and with other departments through various media such as email, instant messaging, whiteboard meetings, work tracking tickets, code reviews, and wikis.
  • Develop and implement tests to confirm success and reveal defects in developed solutions.
  • Observe code release and deployment protocols that coordinate changes and implementations to protect our shared development and production environments.
  • Participate effectively in agile ceremonies including standups, sprint planning, and sprint retrospectives.
  • Prioritize effort to enable the team to complete sprint goals.
  • Code safely to protect the viability of our data resources and systems.
Additional Skills & Expertise of Value:
  • Experience with agile/scrum development methodologies
  • Experience with ecommerce-related technologies such as shopping cart, faceted search, catalog building, CMS and payment APIs.
  • Familiarity with using a source control system, especially git and BitBucket.
  • Experience with SSIS
  • Experience with Oracle
We strive to create an environment where people with these qualities thrive:

  • Productivity – You are biased towards action, with a primary goal of rapidly building and deploying working software in increments that deliver business value. You accomplish an impressive amount of important and relevant work, and do not create unnecessary work for others or yourself. People see that you are consistent in your performance and are comfortable relying on you.
  • Entrepreneurial Impact – You challenge the current way of doing things when warranted and suggest better approaches. You generate and share new, useful ideas.
  • Boldness – You are not afraid to jump into working on complex projects. You make tough decisions without agonizing, and own these choices, regardless of the outcome. You take smart risks.
  • Honesty – You are quick to admit and own your mistakes.
Local candidates only please. Must be eligible to work in the US.

This is an on-site, full-time, permanent position conveniently located in Boston’s historic and beautiful South End. We’re growing and looking for talent to take us to the next level. Our fun and highly collaborative work environment allows our employees to feel supported by the company each and every day. title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
Make a meaningful difference with us

We’re looking for someone who wants to make the world a little better through small moments that leave big impacts. To build meaningful relationships and make a difference in the lives of others.

What makes a difference for us?

  • Strong experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria and business requirements documentation.

Highly regarded:

  • Understanding of cloud-based environments such as Azure or other cloud platforms.

  • Experience working within Agile product


What makes a difference for you?

The opportunity to be part of the second-largest Queensland employer who has been leading by example for more than 100 years. Joining our team, you’ll be welcomed as part of the UnitingCare family. We’re a proud not-for-profit with more than 16,500 staff and 9,000 volunteers across our brands of BlueCare, Lifeline, ARRCS, The Wesley Hospital, Buderim Private Hospital, St Stephen’s Hospital, and St Andrew’s War Memorial Hospital.

  • Flexible work arrangements to support work-life balance
